title: (Mover/Breaker) Skater

title: (Mover) Featherweight

title: (Mover) Stamina
description_plain:
You possess a limitless amount of physical and mental stamina, applying to all natural forms of exertion—including any effort enhanced by powers—so long as that exertion remains fundamentally tied to your own body or mind.

If you have a power that lets you run faster, punch harder, or think more clearly, and it still depends on your muscles or mental focus, you can sustain it indefinitely. Fatigue, exhaustion, and burnout are no longer part of your existence. You can run, lift, concentrate, or push yourself at full intensity forever, without your will faltering or your performance fading. This doesn’t enhance your raw strength, speed, or intelligence; it simply means you’ll never tire, no matter the duration or effort involved.

However, for powers that use stamina as a discrete resource and don’t rely directly on your body or mind, you aren’t treated as having infinite reserves. Instead, your stamina pool is multiplied by ten and regenerates at one hundred times the normal rate. If this pool is ever fully depleted, you suffer no lasting fatigue—only the temporary inability to power that specific ability until it replenishes.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Portal

The more accurate your knowledge of a location is, the quicker it is to make portals that connect to it, with locations you can directly perceive being instant. title: (Mover/Thinker) Kinesiologist
description_plain:
You find your bodily movement and awareness heightened to a superhuman degree. Your proprioception and sense of every avenue of mobility result in a parahuman talent that allows you to move and traverse any environment, using it to your advantage. You intuitively adapt to obstacles with fluidity and continuity of movement, seamlessly transitioning from one type of movement to another, performing athletic feats at near-ludicrous speeds and reflexes. To maintain this, you gain a parahuman level of athleticism.

Your talent extends to any tool that facilitates movement, as you instinctively relate your movements to these tools. This includes conventional means of transportation (land, marine, and aerial vehicles, to name a few) as well as unusual rails, ropes, and anything else that assists your mobility.

title: (Mover) Cheshire
description_plain:
You can make your body disappear a portion at a time, each reappearing somewhere else of your choosing within a 15-meter radius. The portions of your body can either float independent of anything else, or move as if they were still a part of you, such as an arm twirling 360 degrees in place before acting like it has proper leverage on a punch or grapple. Your sensory organs can also be shifted around using this power. Using both of your eyes, you could daisy chain them somewhere useful before teleporting one eye back to your body while using the other one to spy.

The speed at which your body’s portions can move depends on how fast you yourself could move, either floating or fixed to your ‘body’. You also gain a heightened sense of proprioception or body position and movement to help move each portion of your body independently.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Tether
description_plain:
As long as you have it in your line of sight - or are aware of it as a static element (like a building) - you can visualize an intangible tether perceptible only to you. This tether can connect any two objects, allowing you to mentally pull or push them in either direction, or even both at once. For example, you might push a gun out of a criminal’s hand to prevent them from grabbing it, yank yourself toward a building like a swinging rope, or pull two cars together to collide.

The mass, existing counter-acting momentum, and resistance of the objects you affect determine how much mental will you must exert, with the intended force acting as a multiplying factor. You could affect only one side of the tether so that it pushes away or pulls toward the other direction of the tether, though alternatively, you may affect both directions so that both objects pull together or push away like magnetic poles. You may instantly switch which two objects your tether connects to, and any object will retain the momentum of your exertion. If the tethered object exits your line of sight, you can continue using the tether as long as you don’t switch it.

You start with the capability to levitate a human body ten feet in the air by keeping them pushed away from the ground or restrain someone on the ceiling against gravity with manageable effort, enough that it would take a day of constant use before exhaustion sets in. More intense uses increase the strain, though you can train yourself to handle greater feats. Notably, moving your own body toward something requires no mental strain - only pulling something toward yourself does. Anything you carry by your own strength is also strain-free. This power physically adapts your body to prevent injury from these movements and grants a natural talent for maneuvering yourself like the iconic Spider-Man, so you won’t accidentally kill yourself using it.

title: (Mover/Brute) Castling
description_plain:
You can teleport to anyone you can see, appearing within five meters of them and positioning yourself between them and the nearest enemy.

When you teleport, your durability increases based on three factors: how strong and close the nearest enemy is, how weak the person you teleported to is, and if the enemy is in the middle of an attack. This boost is strongest when the threat is highest, allowing you to shield the person teleported to effectively.

The durability boost fades if you move more than five meters away from the person you teleported to.

title: (Mover/Trump) Winged One
description_plain:
You have wings for every power in your possession, including ones that are gifted by others or temporary, but you can only use the wings of one power at a time. You don't need to have your wings out 24/7, as you can hide them. The maximum wingspan is slightly bigger than the size you would need if those wings needed to flap to give you flight. The base appearance of those wings can be that of any being that exists in your world, be it in reality or in fiction, but the biggest influence on their appearance is the powers they come from. Wings that come from a power that allows you to use multiple powers will have their appearance affected by the currently active powers.

Those wings help a power by offering utility or boosting its potency if it is unable to do the former. An example would be if you had the capacity to control fire but no ability to make it. You could have a pair of wings that are made of fire that can overlap, with the amount of fire increasing at a reasonable pace, allowing you to have a wing-shaped stockpile of flames to use. Another example would be a tinker power. Using Bonesaw as an example, your pair's wings could be made of metal and would have inside them surgical tools and long, thin robot arms to manipulate those tools, helping with self-surgery.

Depending on the Tinker's power, it may come with very basic tinkertech in its specialty, like tiny, plain drones from Remote Control. Tactile Telekinesis could give you a pair of invisible and intangible wings that apply your Tactile Telekinesis to whatever is touching it or inside it. Fairy Queen could give you a pair of wings for every shade, giving you the capacity to shoot needles made of black energy from them that kill any Parahumans and steal their powers, and aid or boost the power of the shades, depending on what they have.

The wings give you the capacity to fly 100mph at base, increasing depending on the power they come from and decreasing the less of your wings you have connected to you. If you were to detach the entirety of your wings from you to use for a power, like ferrokinesis, you would only regrow the wings if 5 minutes passed, upon which the iron can no longer be returned to its position, or if they were destroyed, upon which the destroyed material would be regenerated.

title: (Mover/Breaker) On Paper Wings
description_plain:
Your body can generate a pair of lightweight, incredibly durable wings that look like they were made from paper, with all the creases and folds that would require their form. These wings allow you to glide through the air and maneuver with incredible precision; you might not be able to fly immediately, but by god will it take a herculean effort to catch you on the ground before you get going.

Your wings aren’t rigid in form,  though as durable as steel, they share many of the same qualities of paper, such as the weight and flexibility. With simple little shifts in structure, you could optimize them for speed by flicking them into sharp ‘dart’ wings, maneuverability by spreading them wide into ‘branches’, or controlled descent by simply making them wider and more concave. They also absorb impacts incredibly well, taking force and distributing it across themselves.

Lastly, your weight shifts whenever you’re airborne. You weigh the same as normal when your feet are on the ground, but when both feet are off, you become as weightless as your wings, making you exceptionally difficult to ground until both feet touch a surface, at which point your weight returns. Naturally, killer dropkicks. With a strong enough leap, you could ride air currents indefinitely, carrying you across cities if you’re high enough. Your wings can also be used as both barrier and bladed implements when combat is required, needing you to simply change their forms to do so.

title: (Mover/Breaker) Speed Connect
description_plain:
You can intuitively "connect" with inorganic and organic beings of your choice, allowing you to exchange their current acceleration and velocity at your behest. For instance, you can go abnormally fast by linking yourself to a moving car or plane at the expense of making them immobile. You could abuse this to slow people down by linking them to objects in their rest state. Your mind and body gain the necessary physiology to react and adapt to the changing speeds. However, the longer you attempt to maintain it, the more likely you will suffer from mental and physical damage.

Note: Trying to attach yourself to photons in an attempt to move at light speed would only go horribly wrong, as your body would be rendered nearly massless, leaving your mind in a vegetative state.

title: (Mover) Sadako
description_plain:
You gain the ability to enter virtual worlds. The way this works is simple: by touching a screen that has an active video playing on it, you can enter a simulated version of said video. From an outside perspective, you will look like you have entered the screen and can be seen interacting with the video from the screen itself. Inside the simulated world, you can interact with the people and environment as if they were all real, allowing you to alter the "plot" of the video. title: (Mover) Clock Up
description_plain:
You can accelerate your own flow of time, making it flow 100 times faster than the current flow of time around you, allowing you to move and act at 100 times the speed to an outside observer.

However, this is not the same as super speed. It doesn't allow you to perform feats like punching at 100 times the force of a normal punch thanks to the speed increase, running up walls using inertia, or building momentum for extraordinary jumps.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Kid Velocity
description_plain:
You have the power of super speed! Although your powers are different from the norm, as your powers work off a form of kinetic energy absorption, which grants you your speed. When you run, your ability to absorb kinetic energy expands in scope and becomes stronger. Your average speed without absorption leaves you running at 200 mph, as well as your absorption being in a diameter of five meters and draining a tenth of the surrounding kinetic energy.

However, using absorbed kinetic energy will allow for an exponential increase in speed until the limit on both range and absorption rate is reached—this limit being one mile and all of the surrounding kinetic energy. At optimal kinetic absorption, the world around you will appear at a standstill. The absorption field around you will hold for 5 minutes once you stop moving at super speed and will quickly begin to peter out to zero thereafter.

Additionally, your ability to interact with the physical world is not hindered like Velocity; moreover, it is enhanced with the kinetic energy that you absorb! This allows you, when in your field or when moving at super speed, to have an approximation of super strength by way of transferring energy into what you touch to either move or damage it.

You have an array of secondary Thinker abilities that grant you the superhuman sensory input, perception, comprehension, as well as the enhanced spatial and situational awareness needed to use this ability to its fullest.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Move Cancel
description_plain:
Within a 100m radius, you can branch out your movement and/or actions by splitting one’s possible movement within your area, and taking one maneuver as the “real” move before and once it’s canceled. The magic happens when choosing to cancel or select another branch of movement, that is, turning a branch to a “real” one and vice versa, i.e., effectively overwriting a sprint to a clothesline as if it always was the plan, or immediately selecting your retreat branch as the “real” branch.

This puts a strain on your body, however, as you can’t consecutively and indefinitely “branch out” and need to be on a stable “real” branch after 30s, only doing dozens to a couple of branches depending on your endurance. Doing consecutive “branches” under the time limit doesn’t hurt, luckily enough, only limited by what’s possibly available as a movement and action, nearing a hundred possibilities.

These branches are still tangible and can act on an action or deed, their results and outcomes remaining regardless of collapsing the branch; this also implies you inherit your branches’ experiences or gains once you collapse them, while also receiving their injuries or fatigues, what have you, albeit balanced by your “real” state’s health or state of mind, if you're in good health, it’s halved by half i.e. doing a full routine on a “branch” while you rest on the “real” one, merging your "branch" you receive the branch’s gains, receiving half the strain and fatigue.

title: (Mover/Striker) Asynchronous Spacetime
description_plain:
You can manipulate space or time around you, but you must choose which one to control at any given moment. When you control space, you gain an aura that glows red, and when you control time, it glows blue. However, your range is limited to just a few inches from your skin.

While controlling space, you can manipulate objects and even redirect them in your small range. You can prevent attacks from ever reaching you by warping space itself or even teleporting short distances. When you teleport, you can instantly move to any location you can see within range, even if it's behind you or in a different direction. You can even alter the distance you travel in a single step, making each movement more efficient and extending it for a greater distance.

When controlling time, you can accelerate yourself or decelerate anyone or anything within range. For example, you can move faster than the eye can follow, or slow down the actions of opponents or projectiles. Time manipulation works in a way that you can affect anyone or anything within range for a short duration, even if they manage to escape your immediate reach. However, once your influence fades, their movements return to normal speed.

title: (Mover/Stranger) Shadow Diver
description_plain:
Once cloaked in darkness, you may transform into an intangible, fluid-like substance, merging seamlessly within the shadows. Within this form, you swim and dive through the darkness as effortlessly as a shark navigates the open ocean. Movement within this shadowy domain is an alien experience—less like swimming and more akin to floating weightlessly through the void.

This shadowy expanse—a pocket dimension sustained by your shard—exists as an otherworldly reflection of reality, directly tied to the shadows it originates from. The size and depth of this shadow sea mirror the dimensions of the casting shadow: the larger and darker the umbra, the more expansive and profound the realm becomes.

Skimming the surface of this stygian sea allows you to observe and eavesdrop on the physical world through the shadow's origin. Beneath this surface, however, the sea reveals its true mysteries—hidden fissures and caverns leading to other shadows across reality, connected to distant pockets of darkness. While submerged, you remain utterly undetectable, eluding powers designed to pierce through concealment.

Yet, this shadowy sanctuary is not without its limits. Your presence within any single shade is finite, forcing you to constantly move in shallower shadows or risk ejection if you linger too long. While deeper, darker shadows grant extended respite without disruption.

As you descend into the shadowy abyss, you'll find your perception of reality warping as the fabric of reality begins to twist and distort. Near the surface, the effects are subtle, with only minor disruptions to time and space. But the deeper you venture, the more profound the distortion becomes. Distant locations may take less or more time than reason would logically dictate.

This dissonance creates a surreal, dreamlike journey through the shadow's unfathomable depths, where the boundaries of reality blur and yield to your passage.

description_plain: You can open portals to anywhere your friends are, no matter the distance, no matter the universe. Your portals have to be within 5 meters of the person you wish to teleport to, and can't be opened inside of them (unless they have any holes in their body big enough for you to enter; in which case, you can open your portals inside of those.)

title: (Mover/Striker) Dimensional Shunter
description_plain:
You are capable of teleporting yourself and/or anything you’re touching to the same place in another known dimension.

You cannot teleport into an occupied location. You instinctively know if attempting a teleport will take you to a place that is guaranteed to kill you (dangerous/no atmosphere, heavy radiation, into lava, etc.), although you do not know what the danger is.

You can preview any position you can teleport to with this power, so long as it is in a known dimension.

A dimension becomes known if you either have been there or viewed it directly through some form of Thinker power.

You can also blindly teleport to an unknown dimension that is “adjacent” to the current dimension you are in.

For the purposes of blind teleporting, there are two adjacent dimensions to every dimension for this power, forming a chain that contains every dimension in the multiverse not locked off by the entities (so blind jumping will never land you in Shardspace).

After blind teleporting, you will be unable to teleport using this power for a minute.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Spider's Web
description_plain:

These will merge into stronger and thicker strings if they come into contact with each other once broken by someone. 10 strings would become as strong and persistent as spider silk when broken by a hand, while 100 strings would merge to become as strong as steel, though they’d become clearly visible in such quantities.

Your body cannot interact with these strings except to summon or dismiss them, meaning you could walk through hundreds of them without any of them breaking or moving.

They’ll remain for a day once created, then decay into nothing.

By radiating your emotions, you can impart happiness, sadness, anger, or any emotion you are experiencing to those around you. As long as you are confident, you can share that confidence with others. Few powers are able to resist this, as even Alexandria would be affected.

The strength of these effects increases as the night progresses and peaks at midnight, creating a surreal and disorienting environment.

title: (Shaker) Warding
description_plain:
You can inscribe a mark onto an object or surface, anchoring a protective field around it. At its base strength, the mark projects a 10-meter radius zone of influence, though the radius can be expanded with greater time, focus, and effort during its creation.

Within this zone, nothing, whether living, dead, or otherwise, can enter if it carries hostile, malicious, or harmful intent toward anyone inside. The field works on both physical and psychological levels. It does not repel with violence or alarms; instead, it simply unravels the desire to approach. Intruders find themselves hesitating, turning back, or losing track of why they wanted to get close in the first place. In some, the thought of entering the space may provoke unease, confusion, or sudden distraction. For others, it’s like the place doesn’t even exist—an unnoticed gap in perception.

If a being with insidious intent is already inside the ward when it’s activated, their harmful thoughts are dulled, pushed to the background of their mind, as if their aggression is muffled beneath a heavy weight. Rage becomes apathy, malice becomes confusion.

The mark is immobile once placed, and its strength depends on how carefully it was made.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Level 1 Crook
description_plain:
The more people genuinely believe you are new, untrained, or unfamiliar with a particular topic, skill, or field, the more power you draw from the phenomenon of “beginner’s luck.”

Your advantage manifests in subtle, layered ways. Mishaps that should trip you up instead slip past you. Opportunities that should statistically pass you by instead seem to land effortlessly in your lap. People cut you slack without realizing it. They instinctively excuse your failures, assume your missteps are harmless, and lower their guard around you. Systems and processes that should punish you instead soften, their consequences dulling when aimed your way. Training phases accelerate unnaturally for you, your learning curve steepening as your body and mind adapt with unusual speed. Tools, equipment, and situations that should resist or fail instead work smoothly in your hands, as if chance itself has quietly chosen your side.

This power hinges entirely on perception. People’s belief in your inexperience actively fuels this power. If those around you think you don’t know what you’re doing—even if you’re faking—you gain the full benefit. The less competent they perceive you to be, the more heavily the odds tilt in your favor. You can be an expert in secret, but as long as those around you still see you as a rookie, the effect remains in full force. The moment your cover is blown—when people genuinely believe you’re experienced—you lose the beginner’s edge, and the strange force that once protected you vanishes.

title: (Shaker) Rub A Dub Dub
description_plain:
By rubbing two nonliving surfaces together, you can cause them to gradually exchange physical properties in a guided manner. For example, if you rub a magnet with a shard of glass, you could cause the glass to temporarily become magnetic, but at the cost of the magnet itself becoming less so for the same duration.

Properties are exchanged in a manner similar to heat, so that if there is a cold object (surface lacking property) and a hot object (surface with property) they will eventually equalize (both having 50% of property) given enough time, with the rate of exchange proportional to the contact area.

The effect generally lasts about five additional seconds for every one second of rubbing, but if a property is continuously maintained then it may become permanent over long periods of time.

title: (Shaker) Electromagnetic Warping
description_plain: You can slowly manipulate electromagnetic fields, allowing you to warp the surroundings in anomalous ways. This would allow you to levitate objects, induce electric currents, or even create illusions. There is a somatic component to this power, requiring that you gradually bend and layer electromagnetic fields with your bare hands. This grants advanced knowledge of electromagnetism, as well as a basic electromagnetic sense with which you may perceive the world. Due to your manipulation's slow and somatic nature, this power is not feasible for fast-paced combat.

title: (Shaker) Beartrap
description_plain:
Within 100m², you can cage any living thing, putting them in place in unseen bear-trap constructs enveloping them like a springlock iron maiden suit. It’s especially constricting around their vulnerable areas, with the victims particularly aware of the plight, feeling as if spikes and toothpicks are almost piercing their skin. This immobilizes them at that last minute before they weren’t close to you.

Testing their luck by trying to move will crush and impale them, and once one is set off, the rest will follow… in a slow and steady pace. Quite a horrible way to die.

title: (Shaker) Loot Drop
description_plain:
When you take down an opponent, they drop loot based on their strength. Beating regular people usually gives you basic items like money, tools, or jewelry, depending on their status. Stronger or more skilled individuals might drop better things, like advanced weapons or rare materials. Parahumans drop the best loot, often related to their powers, such as unique gear that can boost your own abilities. If you choose to kill instead of just incapacitating them, the loot increases in quality or quantity by a single magnitude.

Repeatedly targeting the same individual within a short timeframe results in diminishing returns, as the quantity/quality of the loot decreases.

You can stop time, halt the forward motion towards the end of all things, for exactly 5 seconds, and you  can do it again after 60 seconds. Within these 5 seconds, you can move, stab, shoot, jump, even interact with a phone normally!

 Anything that is in contact with you will join your stopped time for as long they stay in contact. Yes, including people and uninvited guests. If you throw something, it will move a few meters, but it will still carry it's forward motion for when time resumes once more.

Now you can achieve the greatest feat of them all: putting people back down the stairs.

description_plain: You emit a field that enhances someone’s pain receptors ranging in an area of 50m²: a paper cut feels as if they’ve been slashed by a sword, a mere touch causes discomfort, and any movement provokes a stab of pain of false alarms to their body, resulting on sensory overload or burning out the nervous system or parts of the brain if done constantly (Regent, anyone?). title: (Shaker) Why So Serious?
description_plain:
You can generate a gas that induces uncontrollable, involuntary laughter in anyone who inhales it. This is a deep, violent, full-body laughter that hijacks the mind and refuses to let go. Once inhaled, the gas immediately interferes with the subject’s brain chemistry, flooding it with an overwhelming surge of dopamine, serotonin, and other euphoric compounds. The effect is instantaneous and self-perpetuating: as soon as the subject finds anything remotely funny—even a passing thought—their laugher continues and grows. And under the influence of the gas, everything becomes funny.

It doesn’t matter how grim or neutral a situation is; to the affected, it’s all hilarious. Their sense of judgment is chemically compromised, bent and warped until even the act of laughing itself feeds the cycle. They laugh until they can’t breathe, through cracked ribs, spasms and tremors, their lungs fighting for air even as their faces split into rictus grins. The longer they remain in the gas, the worse it gets. Cognitive function deteriorates rapidly, pain is reinterpreted as humor, and panic is dismissed as absurdity. Some claw at their own throats trying to breathe, still laughing. Others collapse, eyes wide with manic glee, locked in terminal hysterics.

Exposure can lead to suffocation, internal damage, ruptured vessels, and in extreme cases, death from sheer neurological and respiratory exhaustion. Even a brief exposure—a single breath or passing whiff—is enough to seed the effect deep into the body. Once inside, it lingers for days, embedded in the bloodstream and brain chemistry. During that time, the individual must do everything in their power not to laugh, even once. A single giggle, a single slip into humor, even an accidental smirk at the wrong moment can reignite the effect, spiraling them back into lethal hysterics.

title: (Shaker) Sandstorm
description_plain:
You control all sand within a 25-meter radius as a single, cohesive mass, directing it with broad commands like waves, walls, or engulfing clouds rather than micromanaging individual grains. A vague tactile sense extends through any sand you're actively controlling, letting you feel shapes, movements, and textures pressed against it, though this feedback remains blurry and impressionistic rather than precise.

Your power scales exponentially with volume; a handful of sand is sluggish and difficult to move with any force, but a bucketful becomes responsive, a roomful becomes an extension of your will, and at maximum saturation you can compress drifting grains into dense, temporary sandstone hard enough to crush steel or support collapsing structures.

title: (Shaker) Healing Circle
description_plain:
You can exude an aura that heals others in a 10-meter radius around yourself.

Within this area of effect, vitality is refreshed, pain is relieved, open wounds visibly close, and infections are eliminated. Bones will even set properly given enough time in your aura. The more serious the injury, the more difficult it is, and longer it takes to heal.

You can, with enough focus, exempt individuals from this effect.

title: (Shaker/Master) Aromatherapy
description_plain:
Your body can, at will, exude chemicals that can expand up to 30 meters before degrading and have various effects upon entering the body.

At first, it will soothe and nullify all aggressive feelings and place the affected in a state of relaxation akin to light sleep, resisting it is possible although it is deceptively capable of affecting even high-tier brutes. In addition, it will start giving an increasing healing factor and immune system, and can even heal psychological damages with time.

Most importantly, after some time depending on the resilience of the affected, it will make them more and more susceptible to whatever you say, akin to a hypnotic state. After the effects have completely cleared the affected will think that these thoughts are their own, and even thinkers can be affected with enough time.

title: (Shaker) Flare
description_plain: You can cause any non-static phenomena, including your other powers, to instantly and rapidly flare in both size, power, and intensity. This includes causing a lighter to flare into a flamethrower that can melt steel and breathing with enough force to break bones. You can flare any amount of phenomena at once but any more than 10 and the effect is weakened enough as to be functionally useless. Flares last up to a maximum of ten seconds, after which the phenomena reverts to it’s original intensity. This does not apply to any byproducts caused by the flare such as fire spreading.

title: (Shaker) Illusion Master
description_plain: You can cause people to hallucinate by manipulating their five senses. You can make them feel as if they are burning alive, being torn to pieces, or being impaled over the course of days while only seconds have actually passed. While extremely versatile these illusions use your own experiences and feelings to make them, thus an illusion of being impaled would not feel as real, painful, or terrifying if you did not experience something similar yourself. Be careful not to go insane in an attempt to master your power.

title: (Shaker) Speed Zone
description_plain:
You have the power to control the speed of anything within a 15-meter radius. The power’s potency is proportional to how close it is to you e.g. an object’s speed 1 ft away from you can be adjusted by any percentage between 10% to 1000%, and an object 9 ft away is a mere 90% to 200%. Unfortunately, you can’t go below 0.001% and above 1,000,000%, and being Manton Limited you cannot apply this to yourself.

(Note: This is not precisely at a foot. For example, a meter can slow a target down to 3.2% of its speed.)

title: (Shaker/Striker) Spontaneous
description_plain:
You have the ability to manipulate the very concept of spontaneity, allowing you to bypass the usual constraints of time and process when creating. As long as you have the necessary materials at your disposal, you can conjure whatever you desire instantly. However, you cannot create conventional objects in this way. Instead, what you create is a spontaneous manifestation, an immediate, raw effect.

For example, with the right components on hand, you could instantly cause a targeted explosion, trigger a powerful healing effect, or summon a projection in a blink of an eye. There’s no delay, no assembly required—your creations simply appear the moment your will and materials align.

However, the complexity of the desired effect determines the quality of materials you’ll need. Simpler creations, like a basic explosion or a minor healing burst, may require only common or low-grade components. But for more intricate manifestations, such as a highly targeted healing or a long-lasting summoned projection, the materials must be rare, high-quality, and specifically suited to the effect. The greater the complexity and potency of what you're trying to produce, the more precise and valuable the resources must be to fuel that creation.

(If you have tinker powers, then you cannot use this power to instantly create tinkertech.)

description_plain: You are able to replicate and sprout pieces of your body from the surface of any object or living thing. You can manipulate said body parts remotely, as if they were extensions of your own original limbs. Note that you will feel any injury or strain these body parts feel, as well as that each replicated appendage is no different from that of your actual corresponding limbs, meaning they reflect your own physical strength. You also need to be able to see the object or what it looks like for them to effectively sprout your limbs on them.

title: (Shaker/Striker) Heroes Don't Kill
description_plain:
No matter what you do, your actions are always non-lethal. You could shoot someone in the head, throw them out of an airplane, break their neck, or even detonate an explosion around them, yet somehow, they will survive—injured, perhaps, but never fatally. Whether through your powers, external forces, or sheer physics, death simply does not follow in your wake.

Even if logic dictates otherwise, your attacks, traps, and environmental hazards will never result in a fatality. Wounds will be severe enough to incapacitate but never critical. Falling debris will always land just off-center, explosions will throw rather than tear apart, and even point-blank headshots will result in unconsciousness rather than death. Any scenario where you would otherwise be responsible for someone’s demise is subtly altered, ensuring that no one perishes by your hand.

You can disable the effect at will to finish them.

title: (Shaker/Brute) Dissipate
description_plain:
You can dissipate any energy, effect or phenomenon within a 20-metre radius of yourself by evenly distributing it throughout that entire volume.

This significantly reduces the local intensity of incoming effects, allowing you to experience only a tiny fraction of the original. For example, the kinetic energy of a punch would be dispersed across all the matter within your range, diffusing it down to miniscule levels and leaving you unharmed.

A blaster power might have its projectiles’ momentum spread out the instant it enters your radius, greatly diminishing its speed and force. Similarly, the thermal energy of a normal flamethrower would be reduced to the point of barely warming you up and a taser would be made virtually harmless.

This power activates automatically in response to any harmful force that enters your radius, but you can also trigger it manually for other phenomena. You have fine control, allowing you to selectively choose which effects to dissipate and which to leave untouched with a thought.

However, if the incoming effect is powerful enough or requires only tiny amounts, you can still be harmed. A huge explosion may retain enough energy after dissipation to cause serious injury while an extremely potent nerve gas might still poison you.

title: (Shaker/Brute) No Place Like Home
description_plain:
This power allows you to place a single marker located wherever you're standing, with the marker glowing and visible to anyone. You may remove and reapply the marker at any time, but the effect will reset itself and must be done all over again. Starting at a radius of 10 meters around the marker, the area will slowly expand at a rate of 5 meters per hour up to a maximum of 1 kilometer, and cannot be seen by others. You are always aware of the size of the area down to the centimeter. The closer the area gets to its maximum, the brighter the marker becomes.

Based on how close you are to the marker (using the closest multiple of 5) compared to the current size of your area's radius, your strength and durability will be multiplied. The larger the area, the better the enhancement can be. For example, having a 20-meter radius and being within 5 meters of your marker will increase your strength and durability fourfold. Having a 100-meter radius and being within 5 meters of the marker will multiply it by 20 instead. Having the full kilometer and being 100 meters away from the marker would multiply it by 10, and so on.

Leaving the area entirely will not affect the marker; you simply won't be affected by this power until you re-enter the area.

title: (Shaker/Stranger) Cinema Flair
description_plain:
Just as in those schlocky action films or sappy romantic comedies, it appears that everyone around you holds a tone of melodrama or embellishment to anything they do or act, behaving as if they were actors in a film, with higher dramatics, editing shots, and special effects to accompany it.

For example, getting closer to a gang-related skirmish about to blow off transforms it into a standoff with the tension, violence, and bombast of Tarantino films, or getting closer to a dinner date turns it into a Richard Curtis’ heartfelt declaration of love. The scene before you always leaves you out of shot, only a spectator, always able to be outside others’ sights while your show goes on.

Being tempted to be the star of the show, however, will have several benefits: many advantages such as increased combat ability in action scenes, social acumen or wit in humor or dramatic scene, to acrobatic talent or parkour skills on a chase will show themselves whenever you need it, while the scene around you will lean to your advantage at every opportunity. For example, cops will be sluggish or clumsy when they reasonably shouldn't be under a chase scene. Once out of active sight or involvement, then you’ll turn into another face in the crowd.

You can switch this on whenever you like, wherever you are, becoming part of the scene, and depending on the number of people or the distance between people, you can turn an apartment floor of 200m² into 5 city blocks, being around 400m².

title: (Shaker/Mover) Red Room
description_plain:
By motioning to a wall, you can generate red doorways onto it. The rooms coming from these doors do not apply to the actual geometry of the building, being individual pocket dimensions.

These rooms are stocked as a typical room within the building the door would be made. If produced inside a house, for instance, it might create a second living room or another seemingly lived-in bedroom. In an office, however, it might produce a breakroom or set of cubicles. These rooms are empty but for the inanimate objects you’d be likely to find in them. Similarly, the rooms match the state of the building, with ruined buildings also producing ruined appearing rooms.

Red Rooms can be created off the walls of other Red Rooms, and if done enough, they can connect to other rooms or even entirely different buildings in reality (though the distance between two buildings would be much larger than if the rooms took up real space).

While these rooms come with doors, they are not exclusive to your use, and can be entered by anyone like any other doorway. Additionally, they cannot be removed and are, by all accounts, now permanent fixtures of the location they are made.

title: (Shaker/Striker) Accute Affliction
description_plain:
You can induce sudden, intense but temporary physiological afflictions in others within your range.

The effect functions through line of sight and does not require physical contact. You are not introducing pathogens, toxins, or foreign energies; you are forcing the target’s own biology to express specific responses on command.

These conditions must be biologically plausible responses the human body is capable of producing on its own, but which you can now forcibly trigger at will.

Examples include: severe vertigo, nausea, gastrointestinal distress, violent coughing fits, blinding migraines, muscle tremors, weakness, shortness of breath, fever spikes, chills, loss of coordination, sudden fatigue, sensory distortion, or any other internally generated symptom the body can feel or produce.

You choose the exact affliction or combination of afflictions at will, may apply multiple simultaneously, and may precisely control their severity from mild discomfort to fully incapacitating. Effects manifest rapidly and may last anywhere from a few seconds to several hours depending on your intent.

By default, the power does not inherently create permanent damage, though extended or extreme use can lead to natural secondary consequences such as dehydration, exhaustion, or strain and even death.

Your power possesses a striker component as well that allows your to prime targets on touch, able to set afflictions to affect the target at a later date based on conditional requirements, such as when entering a fight, or after a set time period, or even more horrifically cause it to persist permanently until you alleviate the effect yourself.

It also allows you to create a few more unique effects, such as causing the body to desync, reflexes delayed, muscles misfiring out of sequence, and other effects that body could do, but doesn’t.

While afflictions you give others will fade after the time you set for it, unless you make it permanent through your striker component, they’ll wane as slow or fast as the target’s own body will allow. But by touching them you can remove all the symptoms immediately.

title: (Shaker/Brute) Stomach In, Stomach Out
description_plain:
Your stomach - the organ, that is - has become massively empowered and reinforced. Its walls become tougher than diamond, while its acid becomes capable of digesting nearly anything. Nothing that the acid digests can negatively affect you as a result, or at least anything you personally would perceive as negative. Additionally, should you lose any digestive acids, your stomach’s glands will work on overdrive to immediately replace what was lost.

You have the ability to overlay your surroundings with the space inside of your stomach, proportionately enlarged to be able to encompass an area of 30 feet around you. This will cause your stomach to begin to digest anything within the space overlaid, excluding yourself.

title: (Shaker) Deaf Note
description_plain:
You have the ability to make any human or animal lose their hearing, as long as you know their face and current location, with no limit to distance.

You can also choose how they become deaf, selecting any cause that could realistically result in hearing loss—such as an injury or a sudden loud sound. If the cause isn’t feasible, the person simply becomes deaf instantly.

You may also set a timer that determines when the hearing loss occurs, based on the cause you selected.

(This ability affects only humans and animals.)

title: (Shaker) Inverted Structure
description_plain:
You can invert any non-living object or contiguous material within a 50-meter radius of yourself, turning it inside out while preserving its exact external shape, total volume, and material composition.

What was the interior surface becomes the new exterior surface, and vice versa, meaning every internal layer, component, or void flips position with the outermost layer. For example, inverting a car pulls the engine block, wiring, and upholstery to the outside while the paint and body panels end up inside, leaving the same silhouette but with all structural integrity destroyed. Inverting a concrete wall brings internal rebar and hollow spaces to the outer face while the smooth finished surface compresses inward, causing immediate cracking and collapse. Inverting a safe exposes its contents and locking mechanism on the outside while the hardened steel shell becomes an interior crushing cage.

This cannot invert living beings, including humans, animals, or plants, due to the Manton limit. It also cannot change an object’s overall shape, separate materials into different locations, or teleport anything; the inversion happens in place, and objects must be entirely within the 50-meter radius to be affected.

title: (Shaker) Temporal Tempo
description_plain: You can make bubbles of slowed, hastened, or frozen time. Frozen time grows at a rate of 1m³ every two minutes. Hastened time at a rate of 1m³ per 15 seconds. Slowed time grows at a rate of 1m³ per 10 seconds. By default, slowed time is 10% slower than the speed of time, hastened time is 1000% faster than the speed of time, and frozen time is 0% the speed of time, completely static. As slowed time grows slower, or hastened time grows faster, it takes longer and longer to grow. A bubble can be no larger than a cubic kilometer, and you cannot have more than 100 active bubbles. You can pop a bubble at any time. All-or-Nothing powers like The Siberian, Clockblocker, and Flechette/Foil can pop all bubbles, though the Siberian will pop when doing so.

title: (Shaker/Tinker) Scrapyard
description_plain:
You possess two bodies: your real body and a simulated body, both of which you can control simultaneously.

Your simulated body exists within a gritty, dystopian simulation world filled with scraps and trash, all low quality material. In this world, you have a tinker power that grants you access to a vast array of tinker specialties, albeit at a lower level. You can make the basics from any tech tree but no further than that.

Anything you build in the simulated world—once it becomes operational—can be projected into the real world. These projections are tangible and fully functional, seamlessly integrating into reality as if they were built there. However, the connection between the simulated and real worlds is more than just a projection; it's a two-way link. Any damage inflicted on the projection in the real world directly affects its counterpart in the simulated world. Conversely, any modifications or repair in the simulated world will immediately reflect on the projection in reality.

The bigger and more complex the projection, the more strain you have to keep it summoned.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Maestro
description_plain:
You possess absolute control and awareness over any vibrations that come into contact with you, extending even to their more esoteric forms. As a consequence of this power, your mind has undergone a mental metamorphosis, transforming your brain into a supercomputer capable of processing an overwhelming influx of sensory data. This adaptation safeguards your mental faculties, enabling you to handle the intense demands of your abilities without compromising your sanity.

Despite the breadth of your control, the immense focus and precision required to use this power are mentally exhausting, limiting much of its practical application. Making the true scope of your ability effectively constrained, as you must meticulously calculate, monitor, and direct each aspect of the vibrations you manipulate, making even minor adjustments a taxing endeavor.

Although you cannot generate vibrations directly, you can alter and amplify existing ones, gradually building them up to cataclysmic proportions. With time and precision, you could produce forces capable of reducing cities to rubble or reshaping entire landscapes. However, such large-scale feats are extremely taxing, requiring total concentration and prolonged immobility. The mental and physical toll often leaves you incapacitated afterward, and any lapse in focus risks triggering unintended, catastrophic effects.

That’s why mastery comes into play: the more accustomed you are to processing every stream of vibrational information, the more proficient you become in terms of control and precision, the less taxing it becomes for your mind and body, slowly but surely obtaining your power’s full scope. Best viewed as a learning curve, it’ll take long and hard steps for you to attain this.

title: (Shaker/Striker) Lasso Man!
description_plain:
Just like your poor attempts at removing that embarrassing part of a photo, like a photobomb or a fake ass friend, you hold the full power of the Lasso Tool!

(Warning: Shard-imposed restrictions apply)

Mostly, you can instantly draw an invisible boundary around any object or its surroundings, isolating it from the immediate environment, either remotely or by touch. This manifests as a faint, luminous dashed line around your hands, leaving a nearly invisible energy thread trailing from your fingertips when active. After tracing an outline with their hands (almost like drawing digitally) and closing it, a shimmering border snaps into existence around the object, not unlike the digital tool’s marching ants.

title: (Shaker/Master) Emotional High
description_plain:
You are able to heighten the emotional response of those around you to extreme levels. Even the smallest triggers can provoke overwhelming feelings, turning minor annoyances into uncontrollable fury or slight amusement into uncontrollable laughter. This also removes the natural limits on how deeply emotions can be felt. For example, a person’s anger could grow boundlessly, while their joy could become so intense it becomes almost otherworldly.

Those overcome with happiness might find themselves floating uncontrollably, as if weightless. Fear could cause someone to tremble until they collapse or dissolve into mist, while jealousy might create a corrosive effect that damages their surroundings.

title: (Shaker/Breaker) Miracles
description_plain:
Each day, you gain 1 charge of this power, accumulating up to a maximum of 7 stored charges. By expending a single charge, you can force a near miracle—a highly unlikely but technically possible event—to occur with absolute certainty. This turns low-probability outcomes into guarantees. For example, a jammed door might swing open at your touch, a hidden object might just happen to be exactly where you look first, or a dying flashlight might sputter back to life just long enough to get you out of danger. These are outcomes that could happen under normal physics and logic, but likely wouldn’t—until now.

If you spend two charges, you can bend reality further—making the impossible merely possible. A gun might misfire despite flawless maintenance, or a collapsed bridge might momentarily support your weight. These feats remain unlikely, unless you seal the miracle by spending a third charge—guaranteeing that the impossible outcome is not only possible, but guaranteed to happen. For example, you could fall off a 12 story building and survive, or have an atom just randomly split perfectly to cause a nuclear explosion.

There are limitations: the effect radius is confined to you and your immediate surroundings—roughly within a few meters—and you are restricted by the Manton Limit.

title: (Shaker) Matter State Master
description_plain:
You are capable of transforming inorganic material into different physical states of matter at will. You can transmute matter within a 100 metre radius of yourself, with the maximum amount of material you can manipulate at once being up to 10 metric tons. The phases of matter you can transmute to and from are limited to the classical states of solid, liquid or gas.

While the material you've transmuted is in a different state of matter compared to its original form, you're capable of telekinetically controlling it within your range. For example, you could convert air into a solid and manoeuvre it like a shield around you or turn the ground into liquid before solidifying it again to entrap your enemies.

When transformed, the material retains its normal chemical properties although you can freely adjust fluid dynamics like viscosity. Any changes to the physical state of an object or material can be permanent but you can also revert matter back into its original form at any point.

title: (Shaker/Master) Parasitic Army
description_plain:
You are able to release small, writhing parasites that burrow into other people’s bodies. This has a small range limit, only able to infect people in your immediate surroundings. Once inside, these parasites grow quickly, forcing their host’s body to change. A fleshy, grotesque mask forms over the person’s face, draining their energy and making them weak and helpless. The longer you stay around a person, the more parasites you can infect them with and the faster they change. As the parasites spread, the host’s body starts to turn inside out—flesh warps, organs pulse visibly, and they become unrecognizable. Eventually, they’re wrapped in a gross, cocoon-like shell made of their own twisted flesh.

From this cocoon, a constant flow of mutated clones of the original host emerge, each twisted and deformed in bizarre ways. These clones retain no powers or skills the host had, only their horrifying appearance and basic functionality. The clones are mostly feral and animalistic, although loyal to you.

They see and feel the world as you did during your lowest point, trapped in a cycle of relentless torment.

You yourself will be stuck inside this illusion, the trauma boosting your power and giving you a degree of control over this illusion.

title: (Shaker/Stranger) Doomsday Went
description_plain:
You are capable of exerting a wide-area Shaker effect that constantly centers itself on you as you move, which continuously overwrites the local environment into a post-apocalyptic state, instantiating physical and ecological situations and conditions as if the end of the world has passed. This doesn’t make the end of the world happen - the world has moved on, and its consequences are all that remain. Note that “the end of the world” as dictated here is more “the end of human life.”

Upon activation, the power selects a specific scenario in which to apply to everything within the area, ranging from the rise of the undead to a solar flare so strong it brushed against the earth, before applying these effects on the zone encompassing the user. In the aftermath of a nuclear war scenario, for example, the air would become saturated with radiation, electronics and other such electricity-dependent systems would fail, buildings would suddenly acquire collapse profiles matching damage from shockwaves, and all water becomes contaminated. Any physical changes brought about that intersect people, such as rubble and debris, result in any person being harmlessly teleported to a safe place beside these destroyed objects.

All of this will occur as if the apocalypse had already happened within this area, exempting people within who will be affected by its consequences. The world’s moved on, therefore everything within the bounds of the zone will behave accordingly - animals mutating or behaving in hostile situations if any non-human organic life were to remain in the scenario chosen as if generations had passed, with social responses being suppressed due to authorities and populations believing the area to have been ‘lost’, the effect breaking when presented with direct proof of evidence. Attempts to terraform, purify, or normalize your environment - even by parahumans - are also suppressed unless of sufficient strength.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Infinite Treasury
description_plain:
You can instantly create any material you know the atomic composition of in any quantity and structure you can imagine that would fit in a radius of 10 meters from your body. You can create multiple materials at once.

This comes paired with minor Thinker capabilities improving your ability to learn the atomic composition of materials, and the ability to better visualize structures in general.

This power does have one major limitation though, namely that you can’t create matter in a space already occupied by a solid structure. Especially if that solid structure is a living being, that said you can use this power to create life should you have the necessary knowledge.

Synergizes well with Tinker powers.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Mycorrizha
description_plain:
You possess absolute dominion over fungal matter within a ten-meter radius, capable of detecting even singular individual spores floating through the air and transforming them into networks of mycelium and fruiting vessels. This awareness extends to all fungal species simultaneously which grants you a constant stream of biological data centered around fungi and fungi-adjacent organisms.

In order to make proper use of this awareness, your brain has been restructured into something akin to a distributed processing system, granting you a greatly increased and refined sense of attention. This allows you to multitask much more effectively in regards to the manipulation of mycelium, allowing you to track hundreds of colonies, manage their growth, and sift through the sensory aspects of your domain in such a manner that even if your power were copied, the lack of the necessary processing would render it all but useless. Given time, you can transform entire city blocks into sprawls of fungal matter, weaving through roads and buildings and floating in thick clouds through the air.

title: (Shaker/Stranger) Bounded Fields
description_plain:
You can create boundary lines made of dimensional energy around a physical area, creating a space between “outside”  and “inside”, isolating the bounded space from the “outside” world. You can, consequently, set one effect on the “inside” or the boundary line itself. This is commonly used for defensive and covert purposes, yet it can also be used for battle, such as producing 7 tightly bonded bounded fields with a barrier effect.

These effects range from obfuscating the bounded area from trespassers, adding a subliminal suggestion or coercion of apprehension, fear, or obliviousness to dissuade someone from intruding upon the area, or simply creating an invisible barrier to physically stop people from entering. You can impose almost any effect within your bounded area if it isn’t a massive change to the area or doesn’t require vast or excessive resources; aside from spatial, dimensional, and All-or-Nothing attacks or powers, nothing can remove or destroy a bounded field.

Once constructed, you can’t move your bounded fields once set.

title: (Shaker/Mover) Dimensional Warping
description_plain:
You can manipulate the fabric of spacetime, allowing you to make non-euclidean regions that defy conventional physics. This would allow you to make things bigger on the inside, an endlessly looping stairway, or even a time dilation room. There is a somatic component to this power, requiring that you stretch and pull at the very fabric of spacetime with your bare hands. You may not reverse time, and you cannot cross dimensions either.

The better your knowledge of a region, the higher the quality of the manipulations you do, making it almost impossible to accurately port to a place you've never been to before. Due to your manipulation's somatic nature, complex or long-range manipulations require much more time to enact, possibly increasing by several magnitudes.

title: (Shaker/Striker) Holonomic Constraint
description_plain:
With a touch, you can lock the spatial position of an object relative to another object you have recently touched. You may choose a surface or curve of allowed relative positions, such as a sphere of constant distance or a straight line that prevents orthogonal movement.

This effect is inherently symmetric and forces are shared between the two bodies as if joined by an unbreakable physical link. You may choose whether the constraint is tied to the orientation of either or both bodies.

Applications include: linking an opponent to a speeding vehicle to carry them along at high speeds, "levitating" an object by constraining its vertical position relative to the floor, or steering a projectile in mid-air by constraining it to a radial line oriented with the weapon. The effect ends on its own after about an hour, or if you dismiss it, but is otherwise inviolable.

Applications include: linking an opponent to a speeding vehicle to carry them along at high speeds, "levitating" an object by constraining its vertical position relative to the floor, or steering a projectile in mid-air by constraining it to a radial line oriented with the weapon. The effect ends on its own after about an hour, or if you dismiss it, but is otherwise inviolable.

title: (Shaker/Master) Tower Defence
description_plain:
You gain the ability to create and control defensive structures and units. Upon activation, you can summon a variety of turrets, barriers, and automated minions within a limited radius around them. These constructs are semi-autonomous, following simple commands such as "attack," "defend," or "patrol," and are powered by a finite energy pool that regenerates slowly over time, which takes a full day to fully replenish.

You can create three primary types of constructs: turrets, barriers, and minions. Turrets come in various forms, such as projectile launchers, energy blasters, and area-of-effect emitters, each with a specific range and damage profile. Barriers can be solid walls, energy shields, or spiked barricades, providing cover and controlling enemy movement. Minions are small, mobile units that can engage in melee combat, scout areas, or perform repair tasks on other constructs.

The structures and units have modest durability and firepower, making them effective for delaying and repelling small-scale threats rather than overpowering stronger opponents. You must strategically place and manage your creations, as each construct drains from your energy pool, and excessive use can leave them vulnerable. The stronger the construct, the more energy it drains from you. The stronger the construct, the more energy it consumes. Additionally, the longer a construct remains undamaged, the less energy it will drain. This resets once it's damaged.

title: (Shaker) Vault of the Modern Era
description_plain:
You have access to a pocket dimension. Inside this pocket dimension is a perfect copy of every single piece of mundane technology that has ever existed in the history of Earth. As long as it’s as advanced as an LED Lightbulb, and less advanced than pseudo-Tinkertech, then a copy of it exists in the pocket dimension.

The dimension contains one copy for every distinct instance of a given piece of tech that exists in the real world. If a thousand functionally identical AK-47s were manufactured, you'd have a thousand copies, each representing a specific serial number, one for every rifle that ever left the factory. However, if a specific item undergoes significant modification during its lifetime, like an AK-47 that was later customized with a new stock and scope, the dimension treats it as a new distinct version. You'd have one copy preserved in its original factory condition, and another copy preserved at that modified configuration's peak.

You can summon anything in the dimension into the real world at will, with it appearing within a 10 meter radius. There is no limit to how many items you can summon at once, and each one has its own distinct summoning time. The bigger the thing you summon, the longer it takes, with a AK-47 taking a few seconds while a Panzerkampfwagen VIII Maus would take a full half an hour. The amount of time needed to summon scales exponentially with no limit. You cannot move while an item is being summoned without cancelling the summon.

When you unsummon the object, they return into the pocket dimension where they are repaired to their prime, taking a maximum of 48 hours to do so, no matter how damaged they are. Summoned objects always appear on a stable surface within your radius, oriented as they would normally rest. You cannot summon them mid-air or inside other objects or people.

title: (Brute) Scarred Healing
description_plain:
Your regeneration speed scales with the severity of your injury. A wound that would kill you within minutes, such as a crushed ribcage or a severed femoral artery, regenerates pounds of flesh in those same minutes. A deep gash that would bleed out over an hour closes in roughly that hour. Anything on the level of a scraped knee or smaller receives no speed boost at all and heals at the normal human rate.

As the wound shrinks past certain thresholds, your regeneration slows proportionally. The last inch of a deep laceration closes no faster than a mundane cut, and the final millimeter crawls. This means you could survive almost anything, but will likely end up having a scar. A properly set bone or stitched wound heals straighter than one left to your power alone, because the final slow phase is indistinguishable from normal healing and can still go wrong if not cared for.

Your regenerated flesh does not appear from nowhere. Each regeneration puts you into a caloric and nutritional debt equal to the mass restored plus interest. After regrowing a limb, you will need to consume tens of thousands of extra calories over the following days or risk fainting, muscle wasting, or the debt compounding into further biological strain.

title: (Brute) Biological Redistribution
description_plain:
You are a regenerator now, with some minor drawbacks: your regenerations are focused on keeping you alive, so they aren't capable of creating new biomatter. Instead, they must relocate unneeded biomatter to heal you, taking it from where you need it most. For instance, if your body needs to grow a new heart, it might take the flesh from your leg to make it happen.

If you are not in life-threatening situations, then your regenerations will focus on patching you up. The good news is that you have also gained a secondary power concerning eating. You now digest 100% of everything you consume – all the nutrients are absorbed and used to form new biomatter, meaning you have no waste. You can even eat things like stones, although they contain few nutrients. As long as you can swallow it, you can eat it. This also removes any problems like food poisoning.

title: (Brute) Focused Strength
description_plain:
You can sense an energy evenly distributed across your body. The energy itself doesn’t do anything, until you choose to focus it in parts of your body. For example, by taking the energy in your arms and placing it in your legs, your arms will become sluggish and heavy, while your legs become stronger and faster. This enhancement and weakening affects any powers acting on that part of your body, such as other brute powers. You can instantly focus any part of your body with this energy, it being limited only by how fast you can act.

If you were to permanently lose a limb, the amount of energy in your body doesn’t decrease, instead it is distributed to the remaining parts of your body, strengthening it.

title: (Brute) Greatest Defence is Offence
description_plain:
Your raw strength and durability become intrinsically linked, ensuring that no matter how powerful you become, your body will always be able to withstand the force you unleash. This means that if you can throw a punch strong enough to shatter steel, you can also endure an equivalent impact without breaking. Likewise, if your resilience grows, your strength rises to match, ensuring you can hit as hard as you can endure.

However, this does not inherently increase either your strength or toughness—it simply maintains a perfect balance between the two.

title: (Brute) Exposure Therapy
description_plain:
If any part of your body is wounded and then heals, the regenerated tissue will become permanently immune to the same type and intensity of damage that caused it.

This immunity is strictly localised; only the area that was harmed and heals gains this invulnerability. For example, if you're shot in the arm, the injured region will become inviolable to kinetic impacts of that force or weaker. The rest of your body, however, will remain just as vulnerable as before.

The same area can stack immunity to multiple forms of damage as it adapts to whatever it regenerates from, whether it’s blunt trauma, acid, electricity, radiation or even exotic parahuman effects. This protection is capable of adapting to almost anything short of All-or-Nothing attacks like Sting.

Similarly, you can improve the threshold of existing immunities by healing from more powerful iterations of the same damage. Skin scarred by a candle burn may only protect against mild heat at first, but if the same area later recovers from a blowtorch, its resistance will strengthen to match.

This doesn’t alter the appearance of your body in any way, nor does it improve the speed or extent to which you can normally heal.

title: (Brute/Striker) Hammer
description_plain:
You possess minor superhuman strength—enough to hit harder than a peak human and perform feats of physicality just beyond normal limits, but not to the degree of shattering concrete or tossing vehicles with ease. Your real power manifests in the moment of impact: whenever any part of your body strikes a surface—be it a punch, kick, headbutt, elbow, knee, or even a full-body slam—you generate a shockwave that pulses through the object you’ve hit.

This shockwave isn’t overwhelmingly strong on its own. A single strike might create a small internal tremor, a rattle, or some surface-level stress. The strength of the pulse weakens the farther it travels from the point of contact, dispersing energy the deeper it spreads. However, each successive hit sends another pulse through the target, and those pulses build on one another. The more you hit the same object, the more the internal vibrations amplify, stacking with growing intensity.

The effect escalates exponentially. What starts as harmless vibrations can evolve into cracking walls, ruptured supports, and sudden collapses, as the internal structure becomes overloaded by the layered force. Even tough materials and reinforced armor can’t withstand the cumulative resonance forever. This works best when you can land multiple hits in quick succession, maintaining the buildup before it has time to fade.

title: (Brute) Antaeus
description_plain: You have the power to heal by touching the earth. When you make direct contact with the ground, you can absorb it to hasten your body's regeneration process. This ability allows you to recover from wounds, injuries, and fatigue at an accelerated rate. Minor wounds and cuts heal within seconds, moderate injuries such as deep gashes or fractures can take a few minutes, and severe injuries, like major organ damage or extensive burns, may require an hour of continuous contact, that is if you can survive for that long.

title: (Brute/Shaker) Echohide
description_plain:
Your body is a living absorber of sound and motion. Every pore naturally draws in ambient vibrations—footsteps, machinery, voices, even distant impacts—and stores that energy in a dense biological matrix beneath your skin. This stored energy passively powers a constant vibrational field that surrounds your body. This field weakens physical force before it reaches you, scattering the energy of blades, bludgeons, and projectiles so they strike with reduced impact. It doesn’t make you invincible, but it makes every hit softer, slower, and less effective. The more energy you’ve absorbed from your surroundings, the stronger this passive defense becomes.

Additionally, you can have your pores emit an ultra-high-frequency hum. The hum is beyond the range of human hearing. The longer someone remains near you, the more their body and mind begin to suffer—disorientation, nausea, migraines, muscle weakness, and sensory fatigue begin to take hold. This hum is powered by the energy you absorb, growing stronger the more noise and motion you take in. In chaotic environments or dense battles, this makes you a walking zone of invisible, crushing pressure that wears down everything around you.

Because you absorb sound directly through your skin, you also hear through it—able to perceive vibrations and soundscapes across your body. However, this skin-hearing and your absorption alike are dulled when covered, with fabric or armor muffling both your senses and the energy you can draw in.

title: (Brute/Breaker) Battle Aura
description_plain:
You have a reservoir of energy that can be directed to temporarily enhance or manipulate your bodily systems. Whether it’s your muscular strength, your natural healing factor, your immune response, or even the speed and clarity of your neural processes, you can selectively supercharge these functions to surpass normal human limits.

When activated, the affected areas of your body emit a faint, hazy glow—an aura that subtly outlines the system or part being enhanced. This effect is instinctively regulated by your Shard, which prevents you from exceeding the structural or biological limits of your body and causing catastrophic failure. For instance, enhancing the muscles in your arm could allow you to punch hard enough to shatter a brick wall—but not beyond that unless you also reinforce supporting systems like your skeletal structure or connective tissue.

You have enough energy to maintain complete, full-body enhancement for up to 10 minutes. However, this is the upper limit of output and drain. Enhancing fewer systems drastically reduces energy consumption, allowing for significantly longer use. The more systems you empower at once, the faster your reserves deplete, with drain increasing exponentially.

title: (Brute/Mover) Hydrofoil
description_plain:
You have a personal shield that produces torrents of water in reaction to breaches. This shield is capable of blocking bullets and even hits from Brutes, with the resulting water torrent being proportional in size and strength, though as your shield has a limited amount of water contained within it will get weaker and smaller the more damage it takes.

You can also travel by means of a personal tidal wave which likewise has a separate water pool it pulls from and can modulate both speed and size of it, provided your water supply allows it.

These supply pools replenish to full over the span of a few minutes if they go empty, though you can replenish them manually by being near natural water sources as your power gets both stronger and less limited with access to external supplies of water.

title: (Brute) Sponge
description_plain:
You absorb pure water through your skin's pores. Any non-H2O content is automatically filtered out and remains on your skin's surface. For every one liter of pure water you absorb, you convert that water directly into one pound of living human flesh.

This flesh can repair any wound, replace lost tissue, regenerate organs, or regrow entire limbs, provided you absorb enough water to cover the required poundage. The transformation is automatic and localised; you do not need to consciously direct it, though you can accelerate healing in a specific area by concentrating water contact there.

Absorption speed is not fixed but instead depends on environmental contact. Full immersion in fresh water allows rapid intake, while mist or humidity provides negligible healing. You cannot convert your own body's water into flesh, nor can you create excess tissue beyond restoring your baseline human form.

If you absorb water with no wounds to heal, the water passes through your system without conversion.

title: (Brute/Thinker) Neuromorphic Reflex
description_plain:
Your body instinctively reconfigures itself in the moment, engaging every available muscle in perfect coordination whenever you perform a physical action. Whether you’re throwing a punch, scaling a wall, or even just walking, your entire musculature activates as a single, unified system. Like a seasoned fighter who punches with their hips, shoulders, and core without thinking, your body does this automatically, all the time, for every action.

Not only does it draw on every muscle, it also instinctively brings your full weight to bear. Every motion becomes a whole-body act, leveraging not just your strength but the total mass of everything you’re carrying—including your own bodyweight and any gear—channelled seamlessly into each action.

In addition, your musculature adapts on the fly to match the physical demands of your actions. Sprinting? Your muscles immediately behave like those of a trained sprinter—fast-twitch dominant, explosive, light. Shifting to a lift? Your muscle fibres reorient to resemble those of a powerlifter—denser, slower, built for brute strength.

These changes don’t add or remove mass; they instantaneously alter the nature of your existing muscles to best serve the current motion.

Layered over this is a constant, internal nudge—an intuitive mental sensation that adapts with your intent. When learning a new physical skill, it corrects errors, reinforcing better technique and speeding up your learning curve drastically. When performing a familiar task, it shifts to refine: helping you minimise wasted movement, optimise timing, and extract maximum force from every action with the least effort.

title: (Brute/Thinker) Rinse and Repeat
description_plain:
You embody the power of repetition, growing stronger, tougher, or more skilled through deliberate and continuous effort. The growth starts small, almost imperceptible, but escalates with each consecutive action. The more you repeat without interruption, the greater the benefits, peaking before diminishing as your body demands rest.

For example, if you throw a punch, the first few repetitions might feel no different, but over time your strikes will grow faster, stronger, and more precise. By the hundredth punch, your power will have increased dramatically. This improvement, however, applies only to the specific action you are repeating. A stronger straight punch won’t make your uppercuts more powerful or improve your ability to block.

This growth only works when you are consciously and deliberately performing an action. Automatic or passive acts, like breathing normally or blinking, don’t trigger your ability. Interruptions also break the cycle, forcing you to start over from the beginning.
