title: (Brute/Trump) Fame
description_plain:
Your strength, durability, and overall physical power increase in direct proportion to the number of people who admire and feel loyal to you. This connection doesn’t need to be personal; widespread admiration from strangers, fans, or followers can empower you just as well as the devotion of close allies.

When people express their admiration openly in your presence—through cheering, chanting, declarations of loyalty, or even acts of service or protection—the effect surges, providing a temporary boost in power. The surge lasts as long as the visible or vocal support continues.

The effect favors quantity over quality. While one person’s complete devotion may be powerful, even overwhelming, two people with half that intensity will strengthen you more. A room full of people with modest admiration will outmatch a single die-hard follower. True power comes from building a wide base of support—being loved, admired, or idolized by the many rather than the few. The effect is strongest when admiration takes the form of cult-like devotion or parasocial obsession.

If you possess other powers, this admiration-fueled strength enhances them as well.

title: (Brute/Changer) Baa Baa
description_plain:
It seems you have been gifted the power of a woolen shield! Albeit in a very unusual way. From clusters of pores on your body, you secrete a slime that, for aesthetic purposes, you can choose the color of, turns into sheep wool! If you were to stand in traffic with your body fully covered, you could survive multiple vehicles colliding into you, and not damage the vehicles outside of them damaging each other.

The Wool also conducts and dissipates dangerous materials. If someone were to pour acid on your wool, it would just neutralize the acid and be like dumping a drink on it. Electricity would warm you up like a toasty blanket over you. However, a sufficiently sharp blade or powerful enough esoteric attacks can penetrate the wool. You also need to concentrate to speed up the growth process, even if you don't need to do the same to shed any excess wool.

You can also, if you have other powers, use your stored-up energy to boost them proportional to how much energy you have stored.

title: (Brute) Level 100 Mafia Boss
description_plain:
You are able to drain the physical strength of those who are loyal to you, directly pulling their power into your own body. This process is not perfectly efficient—there is always some energy loss, but how much is lost depends entirely on the depth of their loyalty to you. When loyalty is weak or shallow, the drain is severely wasteful.

If you were to pull five units of strength from someone like this, four might be lost in the process, leaving you with only one. However, as their loyalty deepens, the losses diminish. From followers who truly respect and commit to you, you can draw their strength with minimal waste, siphoning it cleanly into your own body.

At the pinnacle of devotion, where their loyalty is complete and unquestioning, the process reverses entirely. When you drain five units of their strength, not only is nothing lost—you gain extra. Their loyalty actively amplifies what you receive, allowing you to draw five and walk away with six or more. Their belief in you feeds you more than their bodies ever could.

The process weakens your followers as you drain them, stripping away their strength directly. Their muscles become sluggish, their physical capabilities dulled until they recover naturally over time. How quickly a follower recovers depends on both their physical health and the strength of their loyalty—the healthier and more loyal they are, the faster their strength returns.

The boost in strength you receive is temporary, lasting for half the time it takes for the follower you drained to fully recover. The stronger and more devoted your followers, the longer you can sustain the borrowed power, but no strength taken ever lasts forever.

title: (Brute/Breaker) Achilles' Body
description_plain:
You have access to two distinct Brute states, each determining how physical attacks affect you.

In the first, you are completely immune to any attack that covers more than one square inch of your body upon impact. This renders you invincible to blunt force strikes, shockwaves and heavy punches but still vulnerable to piercing and slashing attacks such as bullets or blades.

In the second state, the rule is reversed. You become immune to all attacks covering less than one square inch of surface area. As such, arrows and other penetrating attacks cannot harm you though larger area impacts can. You can shift between these two states at will.

title: (Brute/Breaker) Enhanced Physique
description_plain:
Your body is no longer a fixed baseline, but a self-refining system that improves through use. Physical effort, strain, and repetition reshape your biology, allowing you to rapidly approach and surpass peak condition while still looking like your default appearance, such as Human-like. Days of exertion produce results comparable to months, and your limits continue to rise.

At baseline, your body is superhuman. You possess strength sufficient to lift several tons, speed and coordination beyond Olympic levels, and durability capable of withstanding heavy impacts, small arms fire, and extreme physical strain. Your endurance allows sustained output with minimal fatigue.

This improvement is entirely physical. Your muscles, bones, nerves, and organs optimize toward efficiency and resilience. Your oxygen usage sustains prolonged exertion, your joints endure extreme stress, and your internals remain stable under harsh conditions.

Your physiology eliminates inefficiencies. Gains stabilize once achieved, maintaining peak condition without degradation. Strain, injury, and environmental stress become adaptations, reinforcing your body against repeated exposure.

Your nervous system operates with precision, synchronizing perception and motion. You instinctively correct errors mid-action, align force and timing with high accuracy, and react with fluid, controlled movement. This grants advanced balance, timing, and spatial awareness that can border on predictive motion.

Your adaptations grow while remaining biologically grounded. Your strength, resilience, and efficiency can increase far beyond your starting point, developing specialized optimizations based on what you endure.

Finally, you possess awareness of your physical state. You recognize inefficiencies and strain as they occur, and your body corrects them over time, ensuring continuous refinement toward a more efficient form.

Your armor and weaponry start off comparable to steel in durability but are much lighter as they grow in strength alongside your body. When activated, this power makes it seem like a blackish-red mass is poring out of your skin and hardening into your weapons and armor. This comes with multiple perks, including the weapons and armor that can retract into your body; they can "heal"; you can use the biological matter to heal yourself; and lastly, they can be affected by any power that strengthens your body. When they retract inside their body, they enter a hyper-compressed state, ensuring that they do not hinder you or are visible in any way, but you are still affected by their weight.

A downside is that, due to them being made of your biological matter when they repair themselves and are created, they use your nutrients and flesh. With time, you may implant your biological armory into others, with them starting out as being affected by your body's abilities, but over time they will lose that trait as they get repaired through their new host.

title: (Brute/Trump) Power in Numbers
description_plain:
Your strength, durability, and abilities, as well as those of your allies, grow as the size of your group increases, though the effects are relatively modest in smaller numbers. With fewer than ten allies, the enhancement is barely noticeable, offering only minor boosts. The power becomes significant when the group grows to the hundreds, peaking in potency at around 500 individuals. At this point, each member’s abilities are amplified to nearly 20 times their original strength. Beyond this, the effects taper off, with diminishing returns, making additional members provide increasingly smaller contributions to the overall boost.

This amplifies both physical capabilities and powers, scaling dynamically with the group’s composition. A fighter becomes faster and stronger, a healer more efficient, and powers gain increased range and intensity.

The boost relies on both proximity and cohesion among group members, as each individual under its influence acts as a relay, extending the range of the effect. This creates a network where the amplification can spread across greater distances, provided the members remain within range of one another. However, the power offers no inherent coordination or unifying influence, leaving the group’s effectiveness entirely dependent on their ability to work together. If members become disorganized, scattered, or fail to align their efforts, the amplification weakens substantially, diminishing its overall potency and causing individuals to revert closer to their original strength.

title: (Brute/Mover) Unyielding Pursuit
description_plain:
When chasing or stalking someone or some goal, you slowly but surely grow impervious to any obstacle that might come between you and your mark. At first, going through a fence or door can injure not as severely as usual when barging in, with only bruises or hematomas as proof.

Then, gradually at the 2-hour mark, these start to be less and less severe, even slowly recovering at a faster pace, growing stronger and stronger as your body grows paradoxically in density and swiftness, it doesn't speed you up, but it does make you light on your feet, jumping from 1 to 4 stories and acrobatically evading anything between you and the mark. Enough time with your cat and mouse chase, or at the 8-hour mark, you've become a Brute of the likes of Gavel or Alexandria, as long as you keep chasing.

Finally catching or missing your mark or goal, you'll gradually lose your strength until you're left relatively powerless.

description_plain: You can shoot weak beams of energy from your hands, but your real power is to charge your fists with your strongest Blaster powers and unleash them at point-blank range without hurting yourself. title: (Brute/Trump) Stockpile
description_plain:
You naturally generate and store a unique form of energy over time. When you are resting or not engaging in physically strenuous activities, your energy generation rate increases. This stored energy can be used to strengthen your physical capabilities or amplify any other powers you possess. The energy reserves have no strict limit, allowing you to accumulate energy endlessly. However, as your stockpile grows larger, the rate at which you generate energy decreases, creating a soft limit on how much energy you can accumulate at any given moment.

At the peak of this soft limit, unleashing all of your stored energy grants you immense power, placing you just below the level of an Endbringer for a few minutes before your reserves are entirely depleted. Reaching this soft limit takes a minimum of one week under optimal conditions.

title: (Brute/Mover) Library Junior
description_plain:
You're the bargain bin version of Alexandria. Now to put that into actual terms of what your power can do. I’ll start with your not-invulnerability.

Your body now experiences damage at a much slower rate than normal; this means that if you were to be hit by a truck, your body wouldn’t show damage till hours later. However, all it'll do is break down the moment, for example, if something as strong as Leviathan were to hit you, it will kill you in one minute as opposed to one second. However, it is worth noting that with lower-level injuries, your body's natural ability to heal can heal injuries as they occur, i.e., if you were shot, your body would heal you at the same rate you receive the damage, making it as though you were never shot.

You also possess super strength, enough to lift nearly a hundred tons. Now, while that sounds like a lot, it isn't. Additionally, you have a rather unique ability to decrease the effects of gravity on your body whenever you jump, which, paired with your superstrength, can allow you to leap tall buildings in a single bound.

Finally, your brain has also been made extremely efficient, allowing you to process and interpret information rapidly, making you a genius.

title: (Brute/Trump) Zenkai Boost
description_plain:
You can now grow stronger after recovering from an injury. This boost not only enhances your physical abilities but also amplifies the strength of all your other powers.

Minor injuries, such as small cuts or bruises, provide only a slight increase in power—typically just a few percentage points. More serious injuries, like broken bones or nonlethal traumatic wounds, can significantly boost your power by 50% to 75%. However, critical injuries, such as gunshot wounds, severe blood loss, or the loss of a limb, offer the most dramatic increase, multiplying your power by 3 to 5 times.

You also possess a moderate healing factor that ensures you recover to perfect health over time, helping you survive these injuries.

This healing factor allows broken bones to heal within a couple of weeks and missing limbs to regrow in a month or two. However, be warned: fatal injuries, such as decapitation or being stabbed through the heart, will still kill you. So, don’t fight recklessly your healing factor is not on the same level as Wolverine or Deadpool, at least not yet.

title: (Brute/Trump) Overdrive Mode
description_plain:
You can now enter a super-empowered state known as Overdrive Mode. In this state, both your physical abilities and any other powers you possess are pushed into overdrive, amplifying them far beyond their normal limits in exchange for significant strain on your body.

Your ability to use this power is directly tied to your physical health and fitness. The healthier and more athletic you are, the more strain your body can withstand while maintaining the state.

For example, an average adult in good health could sustain a 10× increase in power for about one minute and would likely experience only exhaustion afterward. An Olympic-level athlete, however, could maintain the same 10× increase for approximately three to four minutes.

The greater the power multiplier, the heavier the toll it takes on your stamina and body. Lower multipliers can be sustained for longer periods, while higher multipliers can only be maintained briefly.

For instance, instead of a 10× increase for one minute, you could choose a 2× increase for five minutes—or do the opposite and push for a 100× increase for only a second or two.

Unless you possess additional powers or superhuman physiology to offset the strain, it is strongly recommended that this ability be used sparingly and within safe limits. Overuse places immense stress on the body and may lead to severe injury or even death.

For instance, instead of a 10× increase for one minute, you could choose a 2× increase for five minutes—or do the opposite and push for a 100× increase for only a second or two.

Unless you possess additional powers or superhuman physiology to offset the strain, it is strongly recommended that this ability be used sparingly and within safe limits. Overuse places immense stress on the body and may lead to severe injury or even death.

title: (Brute/Trump) Mang
description_plain:
You can manifest floating rings of light around parts of your body or weapons you are holding. These rings are a mere visual representation of your power and have no direct effect on the environment. However, whatever it is they are wrapped around will have its power doubled for each ring. The exact form this amplification takes depends on the intended purpose of what is being amped. Wrapping a ring around your fist will make it punch harder but give no benefit to your legs. A sword will cut sharper and deeper while a gun would fire bullets with greater force and speed. These rings can also be used in conjunction with other powers to similarly enhance them, such as making flames burn even hotter if you shot fire from your hands.

Multiple rings can be manifested at a time and each individual one can be moved around you instantly at will, but using these rings incurs mental fatigue, which grows more severe with each ring used at once. Furthermore, maintaining these rings for prolonged periods of time rather than using them in quick bursts can prove excessively draining.

title: (Brute) Stronk
description_plain:
You are ostensibly one of the strongest Brutes to live, able to exert All-or-Nothing levels of force on par with the Siberian, with one caveat: you have no way to generate any form of artificial leverage with this power.

If you were to try and push against a steel wall, the concrete beneath your feet may fail and cause you to slide back instead. No force is capable of stopping you from moving your body, but it remains completely up to you to figure out how to get leverage. It's recommended to learn grappling, as using yourself as leverage is a great way to get the most from your strength.

This grants you a form of durability that negates damage in your direction of motion, mostly to stop you from breaking your bones or tearing apart your body as you press against things much more durable than yourself.

title: (Brute) Phylactery
description_plain:

The time it takes for the object to turn into a Phylactery depends on the size and complexity of the object, for example a simple doll will only take a few minutes whereas a piece of tinkertech can take over a few weeks and an entire city could take well over a year.

You can only have one Phylactery at a time. When a Phylactery is being made, you will be weakened, constantly sick, irritable and sometimes pained. You cannot be far from the object when making a Phylactery, even after it is made you cannot be too far from it, as if you are you lose its effects.

When you have a Phylactery, your body undergoes a change. First, you gain an All or Nothing defence that makes it that any damage below a certain threshold is completely nullified. Even if the damage exceeds this threshold, it is instead weakened to 10% of their original damage. Your body’s durability itself also increases, making tank shells necessary to leave a scratch you. Last but not least, you regenerate at an absurd rate, you can regain entire limbs in a matter of minutes.

If your Phylactery is destroyed, you will be temporarily weakened and lose its effects. It also hurts like crazy.

title: (Brute) Telekinetic Barrier
description_plain:
You have Glory Girl or Antares’ durability and strength. Any impact stronger than a bullet shot from a pistol will pop your shield, but it can take any impact without taking damage. When the shield is down, you no longer have enhanced durability, but you still have your super-strength. Your shield will regenerate after one or two seconds, longer if it was a sustained impact. Your enhanced strength is enough to allow you to lift 30 tons. Due to the nature of your enhanced strength, you'll still get tired from keeping your hand raised too long since it doesn't help counter gravity.

Additionally, this protects you from non-physical attacks, including poisons, sickness, Trumps, Masters, Strangers, reality warpers, precogs, and any power that directly affects others.

You lose all these immunities when your barrier is down.

title: (Brute/Master) Hydra
description_plain:

Your construct can use any mundane poison/venom through its fangs and blood. You and your construct are immune to any mundane poison/venom.

If you suffer a fatal head injure while your construct is out, you will keep living and be quickly healed, and you will also be able to manifest a additional construct while the maximum length of your constructs is increased by 50 centimeters.

The previous effect also applies to your constructs, though with them any fatal injury works.

Your constructs are as durable as a snake of their size would be and their senses are connected to you, meaning that while you can for example see through them—thus allowing you to see heat through them—you also feel their pain.

title: (Brute/Trump) Numbers? I Don't Know How To Count
description_plain:
The purpose of numbers in a fight is to overwhelm, to wear you down through sheer persistence. Even if the individuals are weak, their strength lies in their numbers. But for you, that concept is meaningless. Numbers no longer matter. Whether you’re facing ten or a hundred, your power renders them indistinguishable.

For example, if an opponent is too weak to match you in a one-on-one fight, no amount of them together can overpower you—their strength doesn’t stack. On the other hand, if an opponent is your equal and capable of facing you one-on-one, adding more of them won’t improve their chances. The difficulty remains the same, and your odds of victory are unaffected, regardless of how many you face.

title: (Brute/Blaster) Mantis Shrimp
description_plain:
You are decently superhuman—you can tear through brick walls like wet paper mache, have reflexes comparable to a cat, receive only mild bruising from the most powerful conventional firearms, and can punch and kick at Mach speeds.

However, the real meat of this power is the ability to mentally direct the kinetic energy your body produces with every action while preventing it from dispersing in every direction, focusing that energy along paths you desire. This lets you do things like punch the air and have it be a viable and controllable ranged attack.

This manipulation of kinetic energy scales with how much kinetic energy you can produce as it will still dissipate over time and distance no matter how tightly you compress and direct it.

You are able to almost instantly restore the armor upon destruction or damage, provided you are still conscious.

You aren't any less flexible, and are no harder to throw around. If you encounter another All-or-Nothing effect, this power will take around a second to recover, during which time you will be vulnerable.

If something harms you in this vulnerable state, the wound will remain as-is and will cease to bleed, worsen, or cause pain. This means that unless something kills you within the few moments of vulnerability, you will be no worse for wear, beyond having an unhealing wound.

title: (Master) Peat Critters
description_plain:
By squeezing together a pound of soft plant matter, such as leaves, grass, or moss, you can create a thumb-sized Critter.

Critters have a round body with four stubby legs, a round head with eyes, and two graspers attached to the head like antennas.

They are loyal to you and capable of following verbal orders, although they aren't smart enough to reliably make decisions or distinguish people from each other.

Critters can stick to walls and ceilings using their legs and carry objects up to a pound in weight using their graspers. Critters can work together to carry heavier objects or bridge gaps by linking together if directed to.

Critters collapse into loose plant matter an hour after being created and are about twice as durable as the materials that make them up.

title: (Master/Thinker) Ahead of the Curve
description_plain:
You possess the ability to telekinetically control small objects you throw/flick. The faster the object moves, the finer your control over it becomes. While you cannot generate additional thrust to keep the object flying indefinitely, you maintain a localized field of influence around it. This field allows you to manipulate its trajectory or object around it during flight, but at the cost of speed, as the field applies a drag-like effect.

This trade-off means that quick, precise manipulations—such as pulling a grenade pin or redirecting a light object—can be performed with minimal loss of momentum. However, attempting to exert sustained control over heavier or faster-moving objects, like dragging a bullet mid-flight, significantly reduces the thrown objects speed. The control within this field is incredibly precise, allowing you to exert opposing forces along the object's trajectory.

title: (Master) Papillon
description_plain:
You have a subtle, passive emotional manipulation power that causes those around you to experience a gentle, persistent sense of admiration and a desire to please them, like the fluttery feeling of puppy love.

This effect radiates naturally from the user, subtly shifting the perceptions and priorities of anyone in their vicinity to align with the user’s needs and desires. The influence is soft and difficult to detect, causing people to rationalize their feelings as genuine and rarely suspecting outside manipulation.

While it cannot force anyone to act against their core values, it makes others more forgiving, eager to help, and inclined to see the user in a positive light.

The effect is always active, offering the user natural social advantages and loyalty from those they encounter, though it can sometimes lead to awkward or potentially dangerous infatuations or complicate genuine relationships.

title: (Master) Seed of Doubt
description_plain:
You can compel a person to have doubts or be insecure about certain ideas or mentalities.

If the ideas/beliefs are within their belief system, their effectiveness grows, e.g., a person who believes in a social Darwinist mentality, finds the faults of this belief more easily over time, growing more insecure or self-conscious of holding said ideas until progressively resenting it altogether to the point of either self-hatred or self-rejection.

Another use could be implanting doubt about an idea outside a person’s belief system to distance or sour a person toward said idea, i.e., inserting a doubt about the very idea of sports, resulting in avoiding or hating sports.

title: (Master) Green Thumb
description_plain:
With a touch, you can animate and control plant life. The time required depends on the size of the plant being transformed: smaller creations can be animated in minutes, while larger or more complex constructs may take hours.

Once animated, your creations are entirely loyal to you. They act independently within their abilities, following your will with unwavering obedience. These plant-based constructs possess internal systems you create from the ground up—hydraulic muscles, circulatory fluids, pressure-resistant vessels, and nerve-like conduits. Their internal complexity and level of intelligence scale with their size; a small vine-creature may carry out simple tasks, while a massive, tree-like sentinel may understand and react to complex orders with tactical awareness.

The physical power of each minion is also influenced by the condition of the plant before transformation. A well-nourished, healthy specimen results in stronger, more resilient constructs. Wilted or damaged plants produce weaker bodies, unable to support the full range of physical feats your designs might allow.

Once animated, your constructs live for as long as their bodies can be sustained. They do not require your constant control to function, but their continued existence depends on maintenance—sunlight, nutrients, water, or artificial means if adapted accordingly. As long as they are alive, they retain their function and loyalty.

title: (Master) Sleep Walker
description_plain:
When people sleep near you—whether in the next room or under the same stars—you can feel their presence in the dreamscape. With a thought, you may step into their dreams, slipping from your own body into theirs as easily as crossing a doorway.

Once inside, you aren’t just a guest. You are a director, a painter, a god in miniature. You can bend the dream to your will—altering places, faces, events, even the flow of time. Minutes outside might become hours inside, or the reverse. Emotions become your brush, memories your canvas. You can turn a nightmare to peace, or shape a gentle dream into a silent message.

While in their dreams, your real body sleeps. You remain linked to it, able to return with a thought or when it is in danger. When the dreamer wakes, they may remember everything—or nothing. Dreams are slippery things, and even your most vivid creations may fade into half-remembered emotion or strange deja vu. But seeds can still be planted. Ideas, comfort, fear, even subtle changes in perspective can remain without conscious recall. Additionally when they do wake, you are kicked out and back into your body, waking up in the process.

description_plain:
Every time you covertly investigate a situation related to a person, or you simply find them suspicious of something, they’ll unreasonably feel compelled to do or act in ways that incriminate themselves in small to obvious ways. You have no overt control over the Master effect concerning who or when, only that the Mastered will always be the culprit or an accomplice, manifesting in poorly pretending their innocence, buckling under pressure, or desperately making plans to clear their name that are often on the incompetent side of the barn.

Among the crowd, they’ll be hard to discover, but rest assured: their incompetence will be revealing.

title: (Master) Inverse Cannibalism
description_plain:
Your body has undergone a disturbing transformation. Every part of you—your blood, flesh, and organs—has the potential to become irresistibly delicious, more flavorful than anything anyone has ever tasted. With each bite, the taste would only grow more exquisite, an endless escalation of delight. You even exude an aroma reminiscent of the perfect meal, enticing those around you.

However, this allure only manifests if you willingly consent to give your flesh. If you do not, your body becomes the opposite—vile and repulsive, with a taste and scent so foul it drives away even the most desperate. Those who attempt to consume you without permission are met with this revolting experience, even suffering sickness from this.

For those who taste your blood with your consent, an addiction takes hold immediately. They become slaves to their desire, unable to resist the compulsion to obey your every command in hopes of savouring you again. Over time, their identity erodes, leaving them little more than puppets, unable to willingly break free from your control.

If someone under your thrall is forcibly separated from you, they suffer intense withdrawal symptoms, both physical and mental. Only those who survive this torment for long enough can break free from your influence.

This doesn’t give any additional regeneration so be wary.

title: (Master) Hypnodancer
description_plain:
Whenever you dance you can emit ripples in the air that causes anyone hit by them to enter a trance and obey anything you say. If your dance was the most atrocious thing ever the ripples would barely travel away from you and those caught by them would not obey any order that they absolutely would not want to—plus it wouldn't last long—, as such the better your moves the farther those ripples travel, the more orders can bypass unwillingness and the more the trance will last.

This works through electronics, with said electronics acting as vectors for the ripples—so if the ripples extended 5 meters from you a TV would send ripples up to 5 meters. If you were the best dancer in the world not only would your range be that of an entire city but by that point your suggestions would become permanently absolute.

title: (Master/Trump) Blank Doll
description_plain:
You gain the ability to summon a blank mannequin-like projection which has a physical and mental capability on par with a completely average human but no true sentience. This doll will have complete loyalty and devotion towards you accomplishing your orders to its best. Whenever your doll defeats somebody, you will get a mental choice between 3 random traits their opponent has. These can include things like body parts, physical stats, mental capabilities, skills, and even powers. Your selected choice will be swapped between your doll and its defeated opponent. This is a complete swap, so it's possible to be a downgrade for the doll, like swapping its average strength with somebody who is below average, and any physical swap will also come with connected biological systems, but also with their drawbacks, like swapping their mouth would come with a complete digestive system and a need for sustenance and breathing. The doll parts will provide a permanent minor power for their new owners to guarantee their function within the average human range, so even if they lose something like their eyes, they will still retain their capability to see.

Having your doll kill an opponent will grant you a single swap of your choice with its victim instead, and defeating the same opponent multiple times will grant an increased chance to pull traits they value more.

The doll starts with no powers for itself, but it has a single empty slot which it can swap. In case you have the ability to grant powers to your doll, it will manifest as extra slots taken up by the power(s), making it possible to give it multiple powers. Your doll is always a valid target for any power designed to empower/enhance other beings, even in its non-living state.

When your doll becomes fully biological, no longer having any of its original physical blank parts, you gain access to a mental trigger to finalize your doll, making it a permanent living being still under your master effect with its own developing sentience, but no longer capable of swapping traits. Finalized dolls no longer count as your original projection, allowing you to summon a new fresh Blank Doll as well.

title: (Master/Stranger) Workers
description_plain:
You can create fully-formed adult humans at the cost of stamina. Creating more than one in a day risks feeling like you ran a marathon. The resulting Workers are complete individuals with moderate fitness and age-appropriate skills, but you control only the broadest categories of their purpose. You cannot specify their exact appearance, personality, or background. They emerge with mundane documentation and belongings, immediately integrated into the world by a potent Stranger effect that rewrites peripheral memories. To all observers, a Worker has always existed as an unremarkable member of society.

While intrinsically loyal to your well-being, Workers possess full autonomy of mind and will. They argue, dissent, and refuse orders they deem foolish or harmful to you, serving as a council rather than a slave army. However, they possess zero instinct for self-preservation. A Worker will calmly and logically walk into certain death if it is the most efficient way to advance your safety or goals, viewing their own existence as entirely expendable.

The rats created are smarter and tougher, able to defeat a teen with their strength and wit alone. However, the more rats you directly control, the smaller your shared sight becomes, making it more difficult to see through each rat individually, ultimately only being able to see what multiple of your rats see. Your rats can grow by eating, increasing in strength and intelligence up to being as big and strong as a bulldog and as smart as a monkey. If your rats devour a human, they will be able to grow further, becoming as big as a grown pig while gaining a bipedal appearance, gaining the dexterity equivalent to a monkey. Once they reach this state, you lose control over them but they remain loyal to you.

title: (Master) Heart Demon
description_plain: With a touch, you can awaken a Heart Demon in someone. This Heart Demon will take the form of some issue that the target is facing. At the start, it'll be very weak—only appearing in dreams to torment its target. But the longer the issue festers, the stronger the Heart Demon becomes. Given enough time or if the target spirals from the given issue, the Heart Demon can activately manipulate the target's senses and even temporarily control them when they feel negative emotions. The stronger the Heart Demon, the more strain it causes on the target's heart, literally. If it gets strong enough, the target will die from a heart attack. The only way to defeat the Heart Demon is through accepting and moving past whatever issue the Heart Demon is feeding on. For example, if it is feeding on trauma from a specific incident, the only way to defeat it is to move past your trauma.

title: (Master) Scarecrow
description_plain: From your shadow, you can create crow projections. These projections can go as far as 20 kilometers away from you and are no faster or stronger than an average crow. If they die, their bodies will break apart into shadows. You can see through these projections, and while you have a general level of control over them, they are mostly independent, only staying within your range, moving to locations you dictate and swarming targets of your choice. You can only summon 10 crows a day but can keep them summoned indefinitely, allowing you to slowly build up the amount of crows under your control.

title: (Master/Changer) Incubator
description_plain:
You are able to incubate living beings within your own body. These incubations can occur anywhere on your body—your abdomen, shoulders, back, legs, or even more unorthodox places like your skull. The process begins subtly, with a small, almost imperceptible bulge forming beneath the skin. Over the course of seven days, the growth becomes more pronounced, swelling outward until it resembles a heavily pregnant belly.

During this gestation period, you will feel an ever-growing hunger. The larger the bulge, the more ravenous you become, as your body diverts an increasing portion of its resources to nourish what’s growing within. Once the week is complete, the bulge ruptures painlessly and bloodlessly, and the creature is birthed fully alive. Your body heals from the rupture near-instantly, leaving no trace of trauma.

Each creature birthed is tailored by your intent and will, guided and rendered viable by your shard, allowing you to create biologically plausible beings in nearly any shape or function—predators, scouts, weapons, guardians, or even intelligent companions. At birth, these entities are in an infantile or juvenile stage and will continue to grow and develop over time, with the full maturation process taking anywhere from one week to a full month depending on their designed strength, complexity, and purpose.

You may carry multiple incubations simultaneously, however, the more you carry, the more visible, vulnerable, and demanding the process becomes. Damage dealt directly to the gestating bulges can disrupt the process—if an unborn creature is fatally harmed or killed during gestation, you will feel intense pain, as well as need to restart the incubation from the beginning.

title: (Master) Gang Leader
description_plain:
You emanate a passive, ambient influence that gradually reshapes the social landscape around you, drawing individuals together into a cohesive and loyal group—your gang. This is not overt mind control, but a slow, insidious molding of social alignment and group dynamics. People who share even loosely similar views, goals, or outlooks are the first to be affected, requiring less internal friction to be pulled into your orbit. As your power takes hold, these individuals start aligning their perspective with yours. With enough time—typically a full day of consistent proximity or shared space—they begin to shift, behaviorally and socially, to mirror your unspoken leadership.

As more time passes, the effect deepens. Their independent charisma, social status, and presence are subtly drained—not in a way that leaves them empty, but in a way that funnels that weight and force into you. They speak less, listen more, and begin to defer to you in ways they may not even recognize. In turn, you become exponentially more commanding and persuasive. Your social gravity intensifies with each person pulled into your sphere, allowing you to sway others with a glance, end arguments with a word, and unify disparate groups into a singular identity: yours.

Each new addition reinforces the illusion of legitimacy and cohesion, making the group appear from the outside as something elite, respected, enviable. People not yet under your influence instinctively perceive the unity, the confidence, the shared language of status—and they want in. Outsiders look upon your group with fascination and longing, compelled by the idea that your orbit is where the power, belonging, and momentum are.

The formation of loyalty is slower for those with opposing worldviews or deep resistance but the effect is patient and relentless. Once someone is drawn in, they defend you with the fervor of someone protecting their identity.

title: (Master/Stranger) Fleeting Obsession
description_plain:
You can induce specific thought to a target within your line of sight, which becomes more prominent the longer you keep your influence. At first, it will be fleeting and brief, but with each passing moment it will occupy their mind more and more, until they become unable to think about anything else.

Their mind will enter an endless cycle with this thought alone. Even if attacked, they will still be completely occupied by this single obsession, not reacting to the assault.

It takes around a minute until they become entirely obsessed and you need to maintain a relatively strong concentration on this task, you can be interrupted by sufficiently strong stimuli. The effect fades away gradually within 30 seconds after your influence has ended.

title: (Master) Turn Based RPG
description_plain: You have the ability to force everyone around you, including yourself, into a turn-based state. When activated, each individual is assigned a turn in a random order, during which they can perform one deliberate action. An action is defined as any intentional act that requires effort, such as attacking, activating a power, moving, using an item, or activating a device. Subconscious actions and passive powers like breathing, blinking or regeneration do not count as actions and occur freely. For example, if a someone chooses to attack, that attack is their action for the turn, and they cannot move or use another ability until their next turn. Similarly, casting a spell, moving to a new location, using an item, or activating a device each constitutes a single action per turn. You can keep this state up for no longer than 10 minutes.

title: (Master/Brute) Emotivore
description_plain:
You can sense and consume emotions, drawing them from others as if they were a tangible energy source. It is easier and more effective for you to sense and eat emotions directed at you. When you feed on emotions, they nourish and empower you, granting a temporary surge of strength and vitality. Draining people of their emotions leave them lethargic and apathetic. This state is temporary but draining all of their emotions multiple times extends the duration of this state until it becomes permanent.

Note that indulging in too many emotions at once carries risks. Overconsumption leads to a volatile reaction within you, resulting in a your vomiting, releasing pure, liquid emotion. This liquid, a concentrated essence of whatever feeling you consumed, is potent and potentially dangerous. If another person were to ingest this emotional substance, they would experience an overwhelming burst of that specific emotion, magnified to an extreme.

For example, if you had gorged on hatred, drinking this liquid would fill the person with an uncontrollable surge of hatred, likely consuming their thoughts and behavior.

title: (Master/Striker) Pavlov
description_plain:
By touching someone you can place a brand on them which can induce either pain or pleasure in accordance with rules you set when placing the brand. This allows you to condition those you mark, inducing pain when they act against you and pleasure when they obey. The rules you set can be as elaborate and precise as you desire.

This also has combat applications as you can tag someone in a fight and immediately make it so even thinking about trying to harm you causes excruciating pain as if every nerve was set on fire.

You can have as many brands as you desire active at a time, but a brand will wear off after a week unless reapplied. You may dictate what levels of pain or pleasure are induced, ranging from a subtle warmth to feeling as if every nerve was bathed in salt and then set on fire.

title: (Master/Trump) Heartmaker
description_plain:
By looking at someone you are able to gradually alter and refine certain areas of the brain relating to social ability and memory. This ability first focuses on altering the brain towards at least the functionality of the average human, and plateaus at a level that lets targets function as mid-level social thinkers with photographic memory, though this would take hours.

The biggest drawback and strength of this power is that empathy, guilt, and overall emotional capacity fall under this purview of social ability. This power can give hardened war criminals a working conscience in short time. If you were to actually maximize someone's brain with your power their ability to empathize would likely lead them to dedicate their life to making other people happy, with their memory letting them never forget any wrong they've committed.

That being said, there is a point at which the suffering and guilt one person can experience plateaus as their capacity to work through their emotions in a healthy manner outweighs their ever-increasing empathy.

title: (Master) Narcissus
description_plain:
If any reflective surface shows at least ten percent of your body within a person's field of view, the effect triggers. This could be your full silhouette in a mirror, your head and shoulders in a window, or just your legs in a puddle. The moment their eyes register that image, their attention locks onto it completely. They cannot look away, they cannot focus on anything else, and all other thoughts are forcibly shut down.

While trapped in this state, the victim's mind is reduced to a single looping process. They experience a total cognitive arrest where every thought is an involuntary expression of worship toward the image they see. Their internal monologue becomes a ceaseless stream of adoration, marveling at the perceived perfection, beauty, and grandeur of the reflection. No fear, planning, or situational awareness can break through. Physically, they stand or sit frozen, eyes fixed, utterly defenseless. The experience feels transcendent while it lasts, a moment of pure blissful devotion with no room for anything else.

The effect breaks instantly the moment your reflection leaves their sight, whether because you moved, the surface was obscured, or someone pulled them away. However, the memory of the mental experience does not fade like a normal recollection. It sits in their mind as a flawless, glowing memory of the most euphoric and sublime moment they have ever felt. This remembered bliss can foster a desperate longing to experience it again, making them vulnerable to voluntary re-exposure.

title: (Master/Stranger) Owe You One
description_plain:
You can cause individuals to owe you one-time ‘favors’, which you may later call in to directly influence and manipulate them.

You acquire these favors by placing someone in your debt, regardless of its nature, through your actions (or inaction). To form a favor, a sense of moral obligation must be recognised by the person on some level, even if only subconsciously.

Individuals may owe you multiple favors at once and these can range from helping cover up a mistake to rescuing them from death’s door. The weight a favor carries is directly proportional to the cost, risk and impact of the act that formed it. This influence manifests as an imperceptible master/stranger effect, biasing them to your aid.

Your actions must be meaningfully notable to generate a favor; minor assistance and kindness such as holding open a door or offering brief help is insufficient. Comparatively, grievous personal sacrifice on your part or directly saving their life may form a favor powerful enough to compel near-absolute cooperation.

When calling in a favor, the request must be comprehensible and finite. If a request reaches beyond a person's capabilities and/or the favor's influence, the favor's effectiveness is reduced or may fail entirely. A favor cannot be used to directly acquire more favors from the same person but indirect methods are feasible.

You retain full awareness of all favors owed to you, including who owes them, what caused each one and the degree of influence they can exert. You may spend favors whenever you are communicating with the person in question at anytime.

title: (Master) Mutant Mob
description_plain:
You can induce rapid and extreme mutations in biological creatures, changing their form in seconds. These mutations always enhance the target’s physical attributes, increasing its size, strength, and natural abilities—teeth grow longer, muscles thicken, hides toughen, and reflexes sharpen. However, such rapid evolution comes at a cost.

The more you push a creature’s mutation, the more its intelligence deteriorates. Higher reasoning gives way to instinct, and as the mutations progress, the creature becomes increasingly mindless. However, the dumber it becomes, the more fiercely loyal it is to you, following your commands without hesitation. If mutated too far, its brain devolves to the point of complete dysfunction, rendering it incapable of survival and resulting in death.

Additionally, repeated or extreme mutations increase the likelihood of sterility. A creature that undergoes mild or controlled mutations may still reproduce, but those subjected to excessive changes are more likely to become completely sterile.

For a more stable approach, you can slow the mutation process, allowing for controlled adaptations with fewer drawbacks. title: (Master) Scribble
description_plain:
You can bring your drawings to life as ink creatures, each imbued with traits and powers based on your artistry and the medium you use. The better and more detailed your drawing, the stronger, more stable, and lifelike the creature becomes. A hastily sketched doodle might result in a fragile, unstable creation, while a meticulously crafted masterpiece could yield a creature with impressive strength, intelligence, and resilience. Depending on their quality, they can have a maximum of 7 SP worth of powers.

However, your creations inherit properties from the surface they were drawn on. If you sketch on a delicate medium like paper, the creature will be vulnerable to water, fire, or tearing attacks. Conversely, a drawing etched on something durable, like stone, results in a creature far tougher to destroy. This trait is distinct from the creature’s overall durability, which is tied to the quality of the drawing itself.

You can unsummon the ink creatures at will, returning them to their original drawing, which will be altered based on the state of the ink creature when they were unsummoned.

title: (Master/Thinker) Skein
description_plain:
You are a living lexicon, able to rapidly acquire understanding of any linguistic system from the vocabulary of languages to how they work to all the various regional dialects and accents. Your power analyzes all forms of communication you encounter - spoken, written, signed - ensuring swift comprehension. However, this is only the secondary function of your Thinker classification.

The core of your power allows you to read a person's internal 'linguistic map', able to trace associations in any direction you wish linguistically, from the technical associations of red with roses or the personal associations of 'red > shirt > dad > wore'. This can even work in real-time on their current chain of thought, such that if someone is speaking, for example, you could predict their next words before they even fully form them mentally.

Crucially, this linguistic map isn't just readable - it's modifiable. You can swap or overwrite connections. For instance, you could switch someone's understanding of 'red' and 'blue' though that would be more surface level as they simply swap the two names of the colors around. More complex changes - like altering their view of a loved one or enemy - require tampering with numerous associations and may take time to perfect. This doesn’t alter memories or emotions directly but reshapes how those experiences are interpreted, such as pulling together all of someone's knowledge about you remaining the same but creating such a strong connection to 'BAD IDEA' that they recoil at the very thought of you.

title: (Master/Shaker) Logosthesia
description_plain:
You can emit a gas around your body. When inhaled, this gas breaks down specific neurological connections in the brain, leading to a complete collapse of the individual's established worldview. While their memories remain intact, their beliefs and interpretations of the world are entirely reset.

For example, if a doctor were exposed to the gas, they would still retain memories of their medical practice and skills, but might now believe in absurd notions, such as a banana being capable of curing a stab wound, similar to what a naive child might believe.

Immediately after exposure to the gas, individuals become highly susceptible to influence by the first narrative presented to them. For instance, a deeply religious person might become an atheist or adopt Mickey Mouse as their new deity. Similarly, a prejudiced individual could transform into an exceptionally open-minded person, and vice versa.

Upon receiving a replacement narrative, they unquestioningly accept everything presented to them. Alternatively, if left to their own devices, they may embrace any fanciful notions their mind might come up with.

You can make a man hate his best friend with murderous rage, leave his beloved wife the same way he’d walk away from a stranger on the street, or loyally and fervently dedicate himself to a cause he didn’t even know existed yesterday. 

This power can affect any number of people as long as you can directly perceive them, and you can roughly sense a person’s currently existing relationships when you pay attention.

title: (Master/Thinker) The Boss
description_plain: This power consists of two parts: one is Thinker-related, allowing you to become a competent CEO/Boss of a company/business with expertise in all skills and learning of the craft. The other part enhances the abilities of your employees, similar to the Bastard Son (sans the detrimental effects), in their respective fields. Secretaries, programmers, researchers, and more become parahumanly adept in their trades. The effect is subtle and fades when they are not in their work areas. Field employers use their work base as their designated work area.

title: (Master/Thinker) Truth Serum
description_plain:
To your vicinity, people’s uncomfortable truths about themselves are in plain sight within their mind’s eye, incapable of avoiding them, almost as if someone forces them to confront their biases and self-deception. title: (Master) It’s The Thought That Counts
description_plain:
You gain the ability to massively empower the effects of any interactions you have with others or others have with each other.

A minor gift could be made to bring even the most entitled and unappreciative person to tears as if it was the most thoughtful thing they could have ever received, becoming a cherished memory.

The slightest smug expression could send even the most taciturn into a frothing rage, driving them to violence at the slightest provocation.

You can control the intensity of these interactions and are able to control who can see and perceive the effects of the interaction, allowing you to send someone into a wild berserker rage with a massive crowd watching and believing they suddenly lost their mind, or have a crowd oohing and awwing when you give someone their dropped pen back.

This effect extends through other media, allowing even recordings to generate the same effect.

title: (Master/Breaker) Bilocation
description_plain:
You now project a second body to control, with a supplementary Breaker ability to selectively share changes and improvements.

With a thought, you can summon your other body next to your "original" and simultaneously control both at once, aided by a minor tertiary Thinker enhancement to give you just enough multitasking and mental processing to use both with full focus. When first summoned, your second body will be identical to your first, even down to possessions held and worn- aside from anything granted/projected by powers- and shares all other powers you have.

The selective sharing aspect of this power allows you to only carry over positive changes between both bodies without any harm/impairment or negative side-effects; have one body work out and only they get the fatigue and soreness, while both get the benefits of exercise, have one sleep or eat and both get the rest or nutrients, and so on. This even extends to the effects of both your and others' powers, though stacking on too many shared enhancements can severely impact your or others' Shard's energy reserves in the long-term, unless you have Negentropy.

If your original self dies, the other automatically becomes the "real" one while the attacked vanishes like a Master projection, reappearing 24 hours later with similar rules as above. If a hostile Trump weakens this power, less and less benefits will be shared between both forms, and full nullification will result in one of your bodies being forcibly desummoned until you escape the effect.

title: (Master/Tinker) Piggot’s Terror
description_plain:
This power grants you a single biological minion that you can remotely control by thought. You gain biokinetic control over that minion’s biology, capable of rapidly reshaping it into anything you can imagine within seconds, so long as it’s biologically possible and its body has the mass for it.

Your minion will come into existence possessing the biological form of a normal Earth animal that you desire, though size will be scaled off its mass. Speaking of which, your minion will possess a starting biological mass equal to your body, though it can gather more through consuming and processing various other compounds such as dirt, sunlight, or flesh.

If your minion is destroyed or dies, it will respawn near you within a second, though its biological mass and form will be reset to its initial state.

You are always aware of your minion’s physical condition, distance from you, and can share in its senses. You are also granted a minor boost to multitasking so you can manage your minion and your own body at the same time.

Besides your minion, this power also grants you a minor biological Tinker tech base. This is so you start with various ideas and knowledge on ways to manipulate your minion's biology. Examples include turning your minion into functional mythological creatures such as a centaur or wyvern with abilities comparable to a PRT rating of 6. Synergy with other biological Tinker powers will obviously expand these capabilities.

title: (Master) Kitbash
description_plain:
Every day, you receive a Charge. You may hold up to 20 Charges at any given time. With these Charges, you can breathe life into scale models and animate them. Minis, action figures, 1:700 battleships, and similar kinds of figures are able to be affected by this power. These models will be able to talk, move, act, and function like who/what they're based off of when applicable. Models of beings that are more powerful than a Triumvirate member will have their abilities scaled down to match that level at the figure's theoretical peak.

As more Charges are given to a model, the model becomes a little bit more powerful, often receiving weak powers based on what/who they were based off of after the first couple Charges. This is not the only benefit, as the model will also grow in size by a fair bit, figures smoothing out, gradually losing their toy-esque appearance and appearing more like the real deal instead of a poseable action figure.

When a model has been given a certain amount of Charges, they will no longer be able to receive any more, as they have reached the peak of their ability. The size, quality, and appearance of a figure can determine the limit for a figure's peak ability. For example, an unpainted and damaged Warhammer mini may not even be able to be animated at all, let alone stand up to a regular person. On the other hand, a wonderfully painted high-quality 1:8 scale model of Sailor Moon could end up taking more than 20 Charges, ending up as large as her original counterpart.

As a rule of thumb, models that could eventually match the level of a below-average Parahuman or weaker take ≤ 5 Charges, a model comparable to the average Parahuman would take ~10, above average would be ~15, and models that have the potential to reach Triumvirate-tier would take ≥ 20 Charges.

title: (Master/Thinker) Brain Worms
description_plain:
You can create honey bee-sized larval worms from your own flesh and blood, consuming a bee-sized volume of mass from your body. You possess a direct neural connection to these larval worms, allowing you to control them. You have infinite multitasking for controlling your larvae.

These larvae can burrow into the brains of sentient life through the nose before integrating themselves and unfolding into a neural web that intertwines across the host’s entire brain.

As your larvae unfold, they begin tapping into the host’s senses, beginning with touch and ending with sight, allowing you to use them as a highly effective information-gathering network. This does not overwhelm or impair you, regardless of how much sensory information you receive.

Gradually, as your larva intertwines with more and more of the host’s brain, it gains a greater reach into the host's thought process, eventually being able to read and decipher the host’s thoughts and memories in real time.

Your larva can act as the source of mental or immaterial powers. If you are a Tinker, you could send an unwitting host into a tinker fugue or, if you possess precognitive powers, give your hosts visions of the future.

title: (Master/Breaker) Blood Spill
description_plain:
You don’t bleed anymore. When you’re hurt, spiders spill out of your wounds instead of blood. Depending on the size of the wound, there could be a dozen to hundreds of spiders that pour out. These spiders move as one with your intent: defending you, attacking enemies, clotting wounds with silk, or even disappearing into cracks and dark corners.

The pain from your injuries will fade as more spiders are released. As you sustain more damage, the quantity and aggression of the spiders increase. The spiders remain for only a short time; they begin to break down into ash after thirty minutes and disappear within an hour.

title: (Master/Trump) Lionheart
description_plain:
You can create and control fire within a short distance of yourself, with a person-sized fireball being on the upper end of what you can do. You can also enhance others, mending their scrapes, and giving their power an offensive boost. Using your enhancement power on others grants you influence over them, allowing you to manipulate their emotions.

This influence increases the more often you use it on them, allowing you to control them long term by 'branding' them with your fire. The 'branding' process needs you to be in physical contact with them for several minutes as you brand both their physical body and their emotional landscape into one that puts you fully in control over them.

title: (Master) Victory's Path
description_plain: Your power subtly makes people do things that will lead to your victory: shooters in your range will twitch and miss, people you are speaking to will trust you implicitly (or disbelieve you if you employed reverse psychology), and people you are fighting will slip up, leaving themselves open. This power scales with your ability to recognise and seize advantages—the more victory conditions you know how to capitalise on, the more ways your power can help you. This doesn't guarantee you a win; it only makes it possible if you can seize the opportunity.

title: (Master/Stranger) Sleeping Guard
description_plain: When you fall asleep, a large group (20) of shadowy figures, dressed all in black and riding black horses, decked out with black harnesses, and wielding broom-shaped whips, are summoned. The group splits into smaller groups to patrol and protect you. They are able to detect hostility directed at you and go unnoticed when inactive. Each guard has a strong brute rating and their horses have a strong mover rating. Together, their Brute/Mover rating can reach 6, but when acting alone it’s only 1-2. The group grows weaker the further they are from you while sleeping, with a maximum range of 2 kilometers from your resting place. The group will disappear after you awaken.

title: (Master/Shaker) Starving Shade
description_plain:
Your shadow transforms into a semi-tangible projection, gaining a subtle three-dimensional quality akin to a layer of fabric. You can freely alter its texture at will, ranging from soft velvet to rough grit, or even a smooth, imperceptible surface.

The true potential emerges when you imbue it with the properties of water or any other liquid. Your shadow develops the simulated "surface tension" of this liquid, allowing it to engulf and pull anything or anyone that presses into it downward, placing them into a personal pocket dimension. This realm appears dark, and being inside it mimics the sensation of immersion in water, but it lacks any actual substance or mass. By default, it subtly draws in ambient elements like air, radio waves, and sound from its surroundings, but you can choose to disable this function.

Additionally, you gain precise control over your shadow's movements and positioning - your shadow need not be humanoid, in fact, and you could swallow a pretty big bike with good positioning. However, its newfound nature renders it immune to any manipulation by light, maintaining a fixed surface area equivalent to your silhouette cast by a direct backlight on a flat wall. In all other respects, it behaves like a natural shadow, but it can’t refract into multiple shadows if you’re currently being illuminated by many light sources or extend beyond its inherent limits. You can choose to make your shadow move onto your own body, over clothes and skin, rendering you immune to most forms of harm that could sink into the shadow (e.g. bullets and stabs get sucked, but being hit with a car will still damage you as normal), but it is important to note that it will only ever cover you partially due to its limited surface area.

title: (Master) Fly Strike
description_plain:
By touching a corpse, you can cause its flesh to blacken and decay in seconds, sloughing off the bone as it liquefies, turning every ounce of rotted tissue into a swarm of insects. The resulting creatures are hybridized abominations; their bodies are elongated like centipedes but segmented and armored with a glossy beetle-like exoskeleton. Their heads resemble a cross between a fly’s compound eyes and a spider’s mandibles. Each has four wings patterned like those of a butterfly, scaled and iridescent, yet capable of rapid, sustained flight. Their size is comparable to that of large spiders, and they release pheromones that cause fear. Despite the mismatch, all their parts work perfectly, even though they shouldn’t be able to in nature.

How fresh the corpse is changes how strong and strange the insects are. If the body is old, the insects are weak, dull-colored, and slow. If the body is fresh, they come out bigger, brighter, faster, and stronger, with more exaggerated features such as sharper mandibles, thicker armor, and more intricate wing patterns. Their physical capabilities and vitality scale directly with the quality and recency of the flesh they originate from.

While you are incapable of directly controlling them, you can speak to them telepathically and they will obey your orders. Every one of them recognizes you as their progenitor and treats you akin to their god. Each insect has a simple, animal-like mind, about as smart as a clever dog. The more powerful an individual insect is, the more intelligent it becomes. When several gather, they can pool their intelligence, temporarily merging their awareness to heighten their collective intelligence and coordination. They have no range limit.

You can use them as vectors so you don’t have to touch a corpse yourself. This indirect process is slower than touching the corpse, but it gets faster if you send more insects at once.

title: (Master) Child of Flemming
description_plain:
You now possess the power to create flawless duplicates of yourself—the act of which is instantaneous, appearing anywhere within a 2-meter radius of your choosing. The only limitation is that the chosen space must be able to contain them. You may produce up to ten duplicates per day, refreshing precisely 24 hours after your last use of the ability.

Should you wish, you can also absorb any copy within that same 2-meter radius, immediately occupying their position. This act rejuvenates you, restoring 5% of your physical and mental condition, and with enough clones, can even pull you back from the brink of death.

Each duplicate retains all of your memories, skills, abilities, and physical state at the moment of their creation, lasting only 24 hours before dissolving in a scatter of light—or sooner, should either they or you be killed (in which case, they'll all disappear). Able to act independently, make decisions—and even create duplicates of their own, albeit with the same restrictions as you. Rest assured, despite their self-awareness, they have your best interests in mind and are unwaveringly loyal.

Moreover, a mental link connects all of "you," granting a limited form of telepathy. Through it, you can convey emotions and intentions, though not fully formed thoughts, across this network.

Note: Because of the shared constraint, if a clone dies, all clones created by that clone dissolve as well. Absorbing a clone, however, does not count as them "dying."

title: (Master) Stand
description_plain:
You can summon a projection that has powers of its own; you can choose the appearance as long as it's roughly humanoid. You can control your stand as if it was a second body and see through its senses. It has no hard range limit but you will start to feel latency as it gets further than 20km away from your body, or if the stand is in another dimension.

Your stand has a total of 20 SP to spend on powers but can't have access to minion-type Master powers and Trump powers are more restricted in their functions (ex: copied powers are not permanent, can't give powers to yourself, etc.) or unavailable (ex: Network Hub); they are also restricted to Tier 1 or equivalent powers.

title: (Master) Calling Help
description_plain:
You can summon a projection with up to 10 SP worth of abilities specifically tailored to the situation that triggered the call: a guardian in battle, a healer in crisis, a guide in confusion, etc. Its form, nature, and powers are entirely determined by the circumstances and your subconscious need at the moment of summoning. You have no direct control over it, and its behavior is governed by an internal logic that may not align with your expectations, though it will never act in direct opposition to your well-being and the reason you summoned it.

The projection remains active for a maximum of one minute before dissipating into nothingness, though it may vanish sooner if its purpose is fulfilled. Each summoning takes a toll—your physical and mental stamina are both significantly drained, and attempting to summon multiple projections at once or in rapid succession causes the strain to scale exponentially, potentially leading to collapse, unconsciousness, or worse.

Should the original you die, a random clone will become the original.

title: (Master/Trump) Scepter of Power
description_plain:
You can summon a Projection that manifests as a grey wood Staff with a yellow crystal orb on its tip. You can use all your senses through this Staff like how it can use yours. The Staff can fly at a speed of 60mph. The Staff is sapient with its mind, being connected to yours, allowing it to read your intentions and commands to follow your will, though it can act independently. The Staff is highly durable, being able to take a punch from Alexandria before breaking, though you can resummon it later.

By touching something, the Staff can absorb it. The bigger an object than you is, the longer it'll take for it to absorb. If attached to something else, both their sizes will be taken into account; too large of an object won't be absorbed. Non-sapient living beings can't be absorbed, while sapient beings can only be absorbed once given consent. It has 6 Weak slots and 1 Strong slot to store absorbed objects, which you can freely swap between a Weak and Strong slot.

Absorbed objects enter stasis, remaining frozen in time for as long as they're in storage.

The Staff gains weak powers based on the objects inside it. The Strong slot amplifies the power gained greatly by the object. The power expression is random, but you can freely randomize it again. Some powers may need you to be touching the Staff to use. What the object is does not influence the strength of the power, only its expression.

The following are examples of power expressions. By absorbing a spear, the Staff can change its crystal orb into a spear-like shape capable of cutting anything that isn't metal, like a hot knife through butter, on a Weak slot, while the Strong slot would give it the additional capacity to control its length. Absorbing a rock would grant the Staff the capacity to reshape the stone on a Weak slot, whereas a Strong slot would allow for additional capacity to create stones. The stone created by the Staff shall stay locked in whatever place it was made in, even air, though it will rapidly decay if not attached to anything.

Absorbing a Cauldron Vial/Corona Pollentia will create a temporary connection to whatever Shard they're connected to. Endowing the Staff with a random power like any other object. If you're lucky, the power expression could be what their host has.

The Staff is hyperaware of its surroundings and has a perfect memory, allowing you to access and effectively use any knowledge it acquires. The Staff has an awareness of what's inside it, allowing it to, for example, know the contents of a book stored within it or the components of the ink used. It can communicate with you by whispering to your mind.

Touching the Staff grants you the ability to fly, greatly enhancing your thinking speed, and with your consent, it can pilot your body. The Staff will try to protect you from harm, though it won't do so if you consider said harm beneficial. It could protect you by piloting your body to evade an attack or use one of its powers.

The Staff changes based on what is occupying the Strong slot and its power expression. The level of influence the Weak slots have depends on the compatibility of what's inside. A chunk of iron on the Strong slot would make the Staff turn into metal, while a lighter on a Weak slot would make it glow red-hot.

title: (Master/Tinker) The Spark of Life
description_plain:
You have a pool of energy inside you that you can discharge into inanimate objects in order to convert them into robots capable of transforming between their forms. The larger an object is, the more energy it will consume, and the pool will take a week to refill if drained completely. Additionally, these machines obey conservation of mass as far as their size and complexity is concerned.

The largest object you could theoretically convert in one go would be a sixteen-wheeler truck. However there is no limit to the number of robots you can create as long as you have the energy. These robots appear to have personalities and internal lives, but these are all simulated by your Shard (unless you’re Shardless or possess Esoteric Knowledge) .

Additionally, you can integrate any Tinker specialties you may have into your robots, but they will need to be maintained like any other piece of Tinkertech.

title: (Tinker) of Friction
description_plain:
With this power, you receive a Tinker specialty revolving around friction. Essentially, you can create materials and technologies that are virtually frictionless, experience extreme friction, or have selective friction.

This has a number of properties—for example, you could build boots with selective friction soles that, combined with internal gyroscopes, could provide a form of enhanced speed when virtually frictionless, or the ability to walk on walls and ceilings with friction.

Virtually frictionless materials in technology also means that so long as you design things properly, mechanical components will experience reduced wear and increased performance over longer periods.

title: (Tinker) Kinesis
description_plain:
You specialize in the construction of technology that is capable of remotely manipulating other forms of matter, much like a form of telekinesis.

Basic forms of this technology are only capable of manipulating matter in very basic manners, such as holding an apple in the air ten feet away with all the finesse of an average human, and remotely exerting 1 ton of force anywhere within that radius.

Also when you're starting out, power sources you can make for your kinesis technology when restricted to the spatial and weight requirements of personal equipment like gloves or a handgun, are only capable of exerting force for a minute or two before needing to be recharged or replaced.

Synergy with other Tinker powers will allow you to construct more powerful and specialized forms of kinesis technology. For example, a Tinker power specialized in genetics allowing you to create biokinesis technology, or an Energy focused Tinker power letting you construct dynakinesis technology.

title: (Tinker) Domestic Life
description_plain:
Your specialisation lies in household goods, furnishings and everyday consumer appliances; the essentials of daily life that are often overlooked.

You can create highly advanced domestic items, ranging from kettles, fridges and ovens to household furniture such as beds, chairs, cabinets and much more. This naturally also covers common consumer electronics: televisions, lighting, smart-home interfaces, entertainment devices and other staples of modern life.

You could produce a coffee maker that prepares the perfect brew, a wardrobe that automatically irons, folds and sorts your clothing, a climate-control system that ensures an ideal ambience in every room or home maintenance units that clean and repair before you notice it.

Note that your machines are fairly basic compared to what (Tinker) Electronics or (Tinker) Robots could make, prioritising convenience over complexity, but these do pair well together. With this speciality, you can transform anywhere into the perfect home, producing pure domestic bliss.
