title: (Blaster) All Things Are Projectiles
description_plain:
You can transform any object into a projectile, weaponizing even the most mundane items in your surroundings. The effectiveness of each projectile—its strength, range, and power—is determined by the material from which it is created.

When you activate this ability, the object reshapes into the form of an arrow, ready to be launched. At a baseline, every projectile possesses the speed and force of a bullet from a gun. The true power of this ability lies in the unique properties that each material brings to the table.

For instance, a stone projectile might have limited range and low penetration power, but its significant mass ensures it delivers a strong impact force on contact. On the other hand, projectiles made from something like poisonous leaves can inflict a poison effect on any target they strike. Metallic objects might offer high penetration and range, while fragile items like glass could shatter on impact, creating dangerous shrapnel.

title: (Blaster) Banshee
description_plain:
Your mouth works like a perfect echo chamber. When you keep it shut, any sound you make—like a hum, growl, or scream—gets trapped inside and starts echoing over and over. With each echo, the sound grows louder and more powerful, but it also changes. It becomes slower, thicker, and heavier—not just louder. The longer you hold it in, the more intense and altered it becomes.

When you finally open your mouth, the stored sound bursts out as a heavy, crashing wave. Instead of moving fast like a regular noise, it hits like a wrecking ball—slow but full of force. It can knock people down, break through walls, or shake the ground. But the heavier and stronger the sound is, the quicker it fades, which means it won’t go very far. Shorter echoes travel farther but hit lighter, while longer ones strike harder but stay close.

description_plain:

Each canister contains a nearly-random single item of immediate use, ranging from the mundane to the extraordinary. The selection is unpredictable but always relevant to the user’s circumstances, as though a “system” behind the drops anticipates what is most useful to the user at that moment and provides it.

Possible contents for these canisters include any common FPS item such as medical kits, bullet-proof armor, weapons of varying technological level, consumable boosts (temporary shields, cloaking devices, or heightened strength), and compact equipment such as drones or motorcycles. Any items possible must fit within a human-sized container, and once expended or destroyed, will vanish into particles of light.

title: (Blaster/Thinker) Fistful of Dollars
description_plain:
When you throw a coin into the air, it can reflect a ranged attack towards an enemy of your choice, or the nearest one if you can't make your mind up.

This can work on most ranged attacks. If someone shoots a coin you flipped into the air, the bullet is gonna ricochet back towards the shooter. If someone fires a laser at it, then the laser will ricochet. If a constant beam is attacking the coin, it will still be able to ricochet it for as long as it is in the way, but it will need another coin to be able to send it back to the attacker, otherwise, it will just ricochet the beam into the sky.

This power also comes with a Thinker ability to calculate the best position and area to throw a coin for any attack.

You can also hit the coin, sending it into the area you were punching with 500% of the kinetic energy you hit it with. This allows the coin to bounce once before it loses its power. It will bounce off any surface for as long as it has powers.

If you have multiple coins in the air, the attack that hits one of the coins will ricochet toward the other coin, making the attack 25% stronger for every coin it hits.

The coin can be in the air forever, as long as it is airborne, not touching the ground, and not affected by a supernatural force.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Voice of the Devil
description_plain:
You possess the ability to sing with a voice so profoundly wrong, so deeply discordant with natural sound, that it becomes a weapon in itself. When you begin to sing, the effect is immediate and unmistakable: those who hear it experience a violent physical reaction as their bodies reject the sound on a primal, involuntary level. Blood seeps—or bursts—from their ears, nostrils, eyes, and mouths, vessels rupturing under the strain of frequencies that were never meant to exist. What hurts them is the structure of the sound, the impossibly broken harmonics and jagged tonal violence that infects everything it touches.

Your voice bypasses all normal limitations of hearing. Deafness provides no immunity; even those born without the ability to hear are affected as the unnatural sound forces itself directly into their nervous systems. Damage caused by your voice doesn’t grant resistance either. If someone’s eardrums are already destroyed, it doesn’t matter—your song reaches past ruined tissue, striking nerves, blood vessels, and pain centers with unwavering precision. Silence, earplugs, noise-canceling systems, or even power-based sound filters are useless.

As you continue singing, the damage escalates. Minor exposure might cause disorientation, dizziness, or headaches paired with light bleeding. But sustained listening leads to internal hemorrhaging, collapsing balance, and seizures. Some collapse entirely, curled up and screaming not because of what they’re hearing, but because of what it’s doing to them. And through it all, the voice remains—a cracked, haunting, almost absurd parody of song, dragging its listeners toward a crescendo of agony.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Roadless Camelot

The projectiles can move at any speed from 0 to 450 miles per hour, though you cannot change this after they are created.

You can control the size, shape, direction, and power of the projectiles. The strongest of your projectiles is able to one-shot Crawler and has the explosion range of a city block. Alternatively, you can concentrate this force into numerous thin needle-sized projectiles to pierce through Endbringers, until around the 50% layer mark.

Uniquely, these projectiles can be manifested anywhere in a 100 meter radius around you, including behind and above, rather than just within line of sight. This allows you to do things such as rain spears of destruction from the sky or manifest countless projectiles behind your back. You are immune to your projectiles and explosions.

title: (Blaster/Mover) Folktale
description_plain:
You're the bargain bin version of Legend.

You have the ability passively absorb anything in contact with you that isn't one of the three states of matter. Each absorbed thing has its own metaphorical container that stores them for later use. Anything bigger than a small explosion will overwhelm your absorption resulting in you still taking damage from what you couldn't absorb. From electromagnetic waves to inertial reversal fields what you can absorb is quite diverse.

Besides your inability to be hurt up to a certain point, you can use up what you absorbed to shoot beams made up of it. E.g light makes regular lasers, cold creates a invisible beam that freezes things, kinetic energy is like a punch in the form of a laser and etc. Additionally you have a secondary flight ability that allows you to move at bullet train level speeds.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Spectral Platforms
description_plain:
You can shoot trailing lines of energy of any color of your choice from anywhere on your body which create floating platforms made of the same energy.

These platforms can either be left behind by the initial ray which can travel up to 50 feet away or begin from it at any point during flight extending up 100 feet long and 10 feet wide in any shape, orientation and direction which you can alter at any time including extending them as long as they lose length in another direction.

These platforms are completely flat and blunt on the sides and stop when impacting something they can't break through.

You can control the direction and movement of anything on these pathways to an extent, such as speeding up, slowing, or trapping to and stopping them from moving effectively making your platforms extremely sticky, or use the same effect to stick to them upside down or climb them like a spider you can also use this to slide on your own platforms at high speeds while extending them as you move.

When the initial ray impacts an object or living creature you can choose between two effects being applied to them.

-The first effect is that they get wrapped in a tube of your energy while the energy stays fully under your control, including moving it anywhere you want and controlling the movement of anything inside, allowing you to shoot people like a cannonball. Additionally the energy constantly applies a kinetic pressure onto the thing trapped inside making it very difficult to move as the force applied increases the more force they exert.

-The second effect is simply having the ray unravel into a wall and slamming the target with multiplied kinetic force applying more force than it should, this is mostly concussive in effect with a large amount of knock-back but repeated impacts can be harmful or cause incapacitation or even be fatal as bruises and internal wounds build up.

This makes the attack unavoidable, as there is no physical projectile to dodge or block.

title: (Blaster/Trump) Burnout
description_plain:
You are a pyrokinetic, being capable of conjuring and manipulating your own brand of special purple flames. These flames, in addition to burning normal materials, also burn parahuman powers.

Upon coming into contact with a supernatural effect, it will set it aflame and burn it away no matter the durability. These flames are even capable of consuming invisible/immaterial effects like Shaker auras, all or nothing effects and things that are currently under the effects of a power (empowered by a Striker ability, telekinetically controlled, under a Master effect, etc.) no matter the objects' original flammability for as long as they remain under an effect.

These flames don't burn tinkertech any better than they would any other normal machinery, since they’re not power effects.

title: (Blaster/Thinker) Droplet
description_plain:
You can summon a single ‘droplet’ in your hand; a small, metallic-like mass roughly the size and shape of a standard toy marble.

You have complete telekinetic control over this droplet, being able to move it at supersonic speeds reaching up to Mach 5. This object ignores momentum or friction, being able to accelerate instantaneously, stop dead or immediately turn in any direction.

The droplet has a density and durability comparable to the innermost layers of an Endbringer, making it an almost unstoppable projectile. It could punch through tanks like tinfoil or pierce dozens of foes in moments with pinpoint accuracy. You could also use it for less destructive purposes, such as assisted flight via tethering yourself to it.

To facilitate your control, you have a dedicated secondary thought process that effortlessly manages the droplet's movements, regardless of its velocity. This Thinker component also offers direct sensory perception through the droplet, providing awareness of its surroundings.

title: (Blaster/Trump) Rogue-lite Shooter
description_plain:
You can fire small spherical ‘bullets’ of energy from your hands, which travel at around 60 mph and are subject to gravity. These pellets can hit with enough force to crack concrete, although you can scale back the power if you so desire. However, this is just their base form.

Once every 24 hours you are presented with a choice of one of five options, random modifiers for your bullets that can be mentally equipped or de-equipped instantly at will. You can also gain modifiers by defeating parahumans, being presented with a choice of one of three modifiers.

Modifiers can range from simple things like increasing the power or speed of the bullets to more exotic effects like changing the type of projectile or bestowing the bullet with unique properties like life steal or the ability to grow in power by bouncing off of surfaces. Modifiers can sometimes include “negative” effects as well as a form of balancing, such as a modifier which massively increases damage also making your bullets slower.

When you get modifiers from defeating parahumans the options available are always related in some way to the power the parahuman had, such as pyrokinetic providing options related to heat or fire. Additionally, you can get more than one of the same modifiers and their effects stack and interact in both positive or negative ways, so experimentation to find proper synergies is highly advised.

title: (Blaster) Laser Bullets
description_plain:

Their thickness is the same as your fingers. You can alter the trajectory of your lasers, but you need to determine their path before firing them.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Railgun
description_plain:
You can designate markers anywhere within your line of sight, anchoring them to either fixed points in space or to objects or people as points your power can interact with.

At will, you may launch yourself, anything you touch, and/or anything that bears one of your markers to any one of your other markers at horrific speeds.

The trajectory is always a straight line from the point of launch to the marker, however you are not limited to simply one jump, instead your power allows you to create routes through all of your established markers, allowing you to change total trajectories and even looping through them.

This lets you set out routes that can be followed until changed as well, allowing you to potentially create a barrier where you set an object to constantly loop between two or more markers until you change it otherwise.

The speed at which you may launch such projectiles caps at Mach 8 from the launch to the first marker, however every subsequent marker it hits will it allow its speed to double, allowing you to drastically increase the speed and power it travels at by routing through multiple markers.

You can freely choose to set the speed at which something is launched, whether at the cap or to be lower, and can control whether hitting another marker will increase its speed or not.

During transit and till they stop, whatever is launched is coated in a breaker effect that renders them immune to the harmful side effects of traveling at such speeds and whatever they may collide with, instead the force expelling outwards. This will result in obliterating most of what it comes in contact with, or pushing whatever it can’t out of the way.

You may also coat the targeted marker in the same breaker effect; rendering them safe from collisions from a launched object.

You can choose to waive this breaker effect away, leaving what is launched at the mercy of the speed, kinetic force, and energy it will hit and be hit with.

Railgun acts as a near all-or-nothing as far as its trajectory is concerned, unless it encounters another all or nothing in which case it will simply immediately deactivate and blunt all forces on the user, leaving them unharmed from their travel but suddenly stopped.

Your power also comes with a secondary aspect to support all this that provides constant, intuitive awareness of every active marker and their positions relative to one another and to you.

This also includes an awareness of what each marker actually is, such as knowing what marker is what location, person, or object. This is also wonderful for keeping track of things and their distances and positions relative to each other,

This awareness manifests as a mental map that updates in real time, allowing you to plan routes, anticipate movement, and execute complex chains of launches with near-perfect precision. Markers are permanent and persist without input although you may also dismiss them at will if the need ever arises. You may have as many markers as you wish.

title: (Thinker) New Personal Record
description_plain:
Shooting guns, swinging a sword, driving a car, anything you have done, has some measure of skill to it. What this power allows you to do, is to use a skill at the best you ever used it. If you could cut through steel at some point, you can replicate that feat again. If you could knock someone out with a punch to the gut, be assured you can do it again with no issues on your part.

You don’t need to have personally performed the feat; as long as you’ve experienced it directly—whether through possession or other means—you can imitate it, provided it’s an improvement over your previous abilities.

title: (Thinker/Mover) SUPER HOT
description_plain:
Time only moves when you move. In other words, if you stand completely still, time won't move at all. Looking around with your eyes and such things do not count as moving. If you move slowly, time will move slowly as well.

You also gain an incredible advantage though, beyond the extra time, and that's the fact time moving again has slight delay. This means you can dodge bullets! You just need to have stopped moving before it's already piercing your head.

title: (Thinker) Prometheus Alpha
description_plain:
Once a day, when you sleep, you can choose to receive a dream that simulates/predicts a random day within the next two weeks. This dream will always be not 100% accurate, as there will be minor or major discrepancies in your dream compared to the actual day it simulates. You can mitigate this by collecting Data, thereby receiving more accurate predictions on how people would act.

You gather Data subconsciously (with a lot of help from your Shard, if you have one) by going outside, talking to people, and learning how they act with certain stimuli or scenarios. Finding information about people via other means (Biographies, Interviews, Personal Files/Information, Psychological Evaluations, etc.) will also be considered as gathering Data.

Your Shard can also exchange Data with other shards about their host's behavior, making actions done by Parahumans more accurate. Your memories are also taken into account, so the more that you remember, the more Data that can be used to make the dream more accurate. 

As the chosen day is random, important events do not take priority, and as such, they may be skipped entirely.

title: (Thinker/Master) Chef Supreme
description_plain:
With the ability to create incredibly tasty food from even the most basic ingredients, your culinary mastery transcends ordinary boundaries. Not only can you transform simple fare into mouthwatering delights, but you also gain a heightened sixth sense to perceive the unique sense of taste possessed by those around you. This uncanny ability allows you to tailor your creations to suit individual palates, ensuring that every dish brings unparalleled satisfaction to anyone who partakes.

But your culinary prowess extends even further. By infusing mundane food with a tantalizing taste enhancements from your touch, you have the power to make any dish irresistibly delicious, surpassing the addictive allure of even the most potent substances. The flavors you create are so enchanting and captivating that they leave a lasting impression, forever etching your culinary creations into the memories of those fortunate enough to experience them. With each bite, you transport others into a world of culinary ecstasy, where food becomes an extraordinary sensory journey.

title: (Thinker) Overactive Imagination
description_plain:
You are able to manipulate your personal perception of reality through precise innate control of your senses. You can conjure up incredibly realistic fantasy worlds and blur the lines between what is real and what’s not via these mental hallucinations in a manner akin to lucid dreaming.

You can completely block out any sense of pain if you are injured, create imaginary friends or have the air smell constantly fresh. This power applies to all of your senses, including any parahuman ones. This will even trump other powers manipulating your senses although you have to be aware of them and their effects on you to do this.

title: (Thinker) Voices of Failure
description_plain:
Every time you get incapacitated, or your situation leaves you debilitated, you get a new voice in your head—someone who's an expert at dealing with whatever took you down.

If you drown, the voice of an expert diver will start talking to you, giving tips like, “Stay calm and conserve your air.” If you’re taken down in the wild, you’ll hear a survivalist’s voice guiding you on how to endure, what not to do, and what to do. Get your ass beat in a fistfight? You’ll get the voice of a brawler who knows how to handle punches, saying stuff like, “Roll with the hit, keep your guard up.” Get caught in a gunfight? A marksman will pop up, advising on better positioning and how to spot cover.

But it’s not just physical incapacitation. If you find yourself imprisoned, you’ll get the voice of an escape artist, suggesting ways to break out. If you’re struggling with being poor, you will get the voice of the impoverished, telling you how to survive and make do. Get blinded? You’ll get the voice of an echolocator, guiding you with strategies for navigating without sight.

You can switch to these voices whenever you want—let them take over to guide you in tricky situations, or switch back to your own mind. If you keep getting taken out by similar things (like getting beat up a lot or always drowning), those voices will merge into a single expert that’s the best at handling all aspects of that situation.

Basically, these voices help you survive and avoid getting incapacitated again. They get better the more you deal with whatever keeps putting you down. Plus, they can use your mental abilities.

title: (Thinker) Electroreception
description_plain:
Congratulations! You've gained a sixth sense! You now possess electroreception, much like many species of sharks.

This new ability allows you to detect weak electrical fields, enabling you to track living beings and objects over a distance of roughly 100 meters. To support this, your skin is embedded with highly specialized electric receptors. Unlike in sharks, however, these receptors remain invisible—unless you choose to reveal them.

Typically, electroreception is limited outside of saltwater because air is a poor conductor of electricity. But your receptors are extraordinarily sensitive, allowing you to use this sense just as effectively in the air as underwater.

Your brain has also been enhanced to seamlessly process this new stream of sensory input without any strain. And for convenience, you can switch your receptors on or off at will.

title: (Thinker) Business Shark
description_plain:

These powers allow you to predict market trends and future shifts with incredible accuracy, making you an unmatched negotiator, even when dealing with the most conservative businessmen and politicians.

You possess a keen sense for identifying individuals with high potential and know exactly how to develop their talents and unlock their abilities. You can manage cash flow in a way that satisfies employees and shareholders while providing them with the minimum they find acceptable. Your skills enable you to direct the growth and investments of your company to not only keep it afloat but also ensure continuous prosperity.

You have a natural intuition for drawing people into debt, turning them into willing workers under your influence. You are capable of building a global business empire from virtually nothing, though achieving this might take several decades. In the world of business, you are a shark among fish.

title: (Thinker) Immersive Storytelling
description_plain:
When you read or hear a story, you can experience it, though it's all in your mind. You are able to picture and feel the events as if they were happening to you. For example, if someone describes a hike through a dense forest, you can feel the crunch of leaves underfoot, hear the rustling of wildlife, and see the sunlight filtering through the trees as if you were there.

This experience can give you insights into the storyteller's experiences and emotions, even possible allowing you to learn skills from these stories. However, this power of immersion cannot be activated if the story lacks sufficient information or is too vague. If crucial details are concealed, such as names being replaced, the experience may be altered, but you will instantly sense that something is off. Additionally, it comes with a subtle sense that helps you judge whether a story is true. This sense isn’t based of what the storyteller thinks is true, but what is actually true. Authentic stories evoke rich, vivid, and dynamic images and feelings, while fake stories often feel dull, flat, lifeless, and artificial. This difference can help you tell if a story is genuine or not.

title: (Thinker) Consciousness Commander
description_plain:
You find it easy to fall asleep at will even with chaotic surroundings and can wake up from sleep with a minute of focus.

Whenever you sleep, your consciousness will be transported to a simulated military operations room.

If you have a master power you can maintain its effects while sleeping if you can't already. While awake, you can tag willing individuals (anybody under the effects of one of your master powers will automatically count as tagged for this power). You will have the ability to communicate with any tagged being inside the range of your ops room when you're inside, allowing you to coordinate them.

The room will give you real-time information on the environment in a five-block radius communicated by the various elements of the room that you can understand in a strange, intuitive dream logic kind of way. From the room you can find out the layout of the area, any environmental effects (such as traps or shaker effects, even if they're hidden or otherwise undetectable), the locations of every living being in the area, what they are and what they currently have equipped (what they're wearing and what they're holding).

You cannot directly recognize people with the information from the room alone (you can tell the difference between tagged and not tagged people) and will have to pick up who they are from context clues (what they're wearing, where they are, etc.). However, each person tracked is identifiably distinct, so you will never lose track of which person is which, no matter how complex their movements. (i.e. if Trickster swapped two people, you’d be able to instantly tell that they’ve switched, even if you didn’t know who they were)

description_plain:
Your body is now a great tool for your mind, creating a effect where physical training directly enhances cognitive abilities. Every aspect of your mental fitness—problem-solving, memory, creativity, and focus—grows in proportion to your physical development. As your body becomes faster, stronger, and more enduring, so too does your mind sharpen and evolve.

Training for speed heightens your mental processing and recall, allowing you to analyze and retrieve complex information at unprecedented speeds. Developing raw strength fortifies your willpower and your ability to tackle mental challenges with brute force, breaking down problems with a forceful, direct approach. As you improve physical agility through stretching and movement exercises, you also cultivate mental flexibility. Building physical endurance grants you extraordinary mental stamina, ensuring clarity and focus under pressure for extended periods.

title: (Thinker) Dreams of Another Life
description_plain:
You will have a lucid dream every time you sleep. You don’t get to control the dream itself, but you’re fully aware that it’s a dream, and you can make choices within it. The dreams are completely random—one night, you might find yourself as a janitor, scrubbing floors in a massive, empty building, and the next, you’re a soldier in the chaos of war, facing death and destruction. You could even end up in a dream where you are an animal, be it a prey animal being chased or a predator in an hunt.

When this ability first kicks in, your dream only lasts five minutes. But with every dream after that, the time doubles—5 minutes turns into 10, then 20, then 40, and so on. The dreams grow longer and longer, becoming more vivid and immersive with each passing night. Even death will not end the dream, all that will do is restart the dream. If you have the Holding Back perk you can end a dream ahead of time. This doesn’t extend how long you sleep, only how long the dream feels for you.

Any skills you learn or experience in these dreams stay with you when you wake up. Whether it’s mastering a specific technique, understanding a complex system, or even just developing a sharper mind, your time in the dream world makes you smarter, more experienced and capable in reality.

title: (Thinker) Interlude
description_plain:
Every time you go to sleep at the end of the day, you can, at will, experience interlude dreams. They will depict the events of the day from the point of view of several other characters, complete with the narration of their inner thoughts and feelings. The events shown in these interludes will be, in one way or another, related to your actions during the day.

You may, at any time, switch to another character POV or interrupt interludes entirely and either wake up or fall asleep as normal. Any interlude lasts at most an hour of real time, no matter how much time passes inside the dream. Should you go without sleep for several days, you may experience Interlude Ark, where every character POV may last for as long as you have been awake, still taking at most an hour to fully view it.

title: (Thinker) This Is The Greatest Plan…!
description_plain:
Your instincts and intuition passively operate at a superhuman level, giving you a subconscious understanding of the best courses of action available in any given moment of time. Whether in a scrum, a regular conversation, or for more recreational purposes like storytelling, you react like you already knew what you were going to do, like beginner’s luck taken to the next, next level. Your gut feelings prove accurate, and your hesitation just vanishes in the face of anything you know you can handle.

However, you’re pushed away from long-term planning by the power itself, making detailed strategies feel slow. You can execute them just fine, but you’ll find your instincts and intuition more and more dull by the moment. The more information you can act on, the less effective your power becomes. Conversely, it ensures that you’re at your very best when you’re at your wit’s end: blind, deaf, and acting with absolutely no plan whatsoever.

title: (Thinker) Feel It In My Bones
description_plain:
Whenever you take physical damage from an attack, you instantly gain comprehensive theoretical knowledge of that attack. You learn its biomechanics, force vectors, energy transfer, timing, and mechanical execution. For example, if someone breaks your nose with a straight punch, you immediately understand how they generated that force. You know their foot placement, hip rotation, arm angle, and impact distribution. You can then apply that knowledge to your own punches. Turning that theory into practical muscle memory happens hundreds of times faster than natural learning. What would take weeks of practice condenses into minutes or hours, with more severe injuries providing deeper and more detailed information.

This understanding remains purely theoretical and does not grant you any inherent ability to replicate exotic or parahuman effects unless you already possess the necessary means. For example, if a pyrokinetic burns you, you’ll learn everything about the fire's behavior, its heat gradient, and how the parahuman controlled it. You still cannot breathe or throw fire without a compatible power or technology. The same applies to being rammed by a car. You learn the vehicle's speed, mass, impact angle, and crumple dynamics, but your body cannot generate that force. You gain only the knowledge, not the physical capability to reproduce the attack.

title: (Thinker) Life 360
description_plain:
You can now tag people to then create distinct mental groups, linking each other in a shared information network. You may have as many groups at a time as you wish.

Anyone added to a group becomes continuously aware of the condition and location of every other member within the same group, with each person’s position updating in real time through an intuitive mental map that tracks movement, area, and activity.

The map also shows the actual area itself, rather than simple feeling of relative distance. This will allow members to actually tell where people went, such as a restaurant or home or office, rather than a feeling of simple distance.

This awareness is not limited to just the present moment either, members are able to pull up a history of activity and location through a continuously recorded history that begins from the moment they were added to the group and persists for as long as they remain connected.

Beyond simply tracking the power also enables communication between members of the same group, allowing them to discuss through a form of telepathy. This communication is seamless and immediate, making coordination effortless even across large distances.

Individual members can hide their information from other members, and are not obligated to communicate with others if they do not wish, essentially able to block, mute, or simply not “pick up” their communications, however they cannot hide from you and you can force that channel open, and can likewise remove someone’s ability to hide from others and reinstate it at will.

title: (Thinker) Perfect Timing
description_plain:
You gain enhanced timing. You can effectively time and manage group activities with exceptional efficiency. With this ability, you can calculate the precise amount of time required for a given task and organize team members accordingly.

Your enhanced timing ability requires you to have an understanding of every factor involved in the task at hand. Whether it's the environment, fitness, Parahuman powers, or any other relevant detail, you have a heightened sense of intuition that helps you precisely determine the optimal course of action for each situation.

You have the normal Shard blindspots.

title: (Thinker) A Thousand Souls
description_plain:
Inside you, there resides a thousand voices, each representing a distinct personality with its own outlook on life. These voices know everything you know, share every memory, and possess the same knowledge, yet they interpret it in their own unique ways. Some are cautious, some daring; some are analytical, others creative. They argue, they suggest, they critique, but ultimately, they all work together toward a common goal—yours.

You are the conductor of this symphony, the one who holds the reins. No matter how many perspectives they offer, how many strategies they propose, your will is the guiding force. When you decide on a course of action, every voice aligns behind you, channeling their unique strengths and insights to make your decision a success. They bring different skills to the table, drawing from their unique understanding, but they never overshadow your desires. Instead, they enhance them, offering solutions you might never have considered alone. Any attempt to master you will likely fail, as if one mind is mastered, another takes its place. Thinker powers have a difficulty reading you, as reading a thousand people at once is far from easy.

You are a collective consciousness—a thousand minds working as one. Every challenge becomes an opportunity for collaboration, every obstacle a problem to be solved from countless angles. And while the voices may sometimes clash, creating a cacophony of thoughts and opinions, in the end, they are all united in a singular purpose: helping you become the best version of yourself, achieving what you set out to do, and ensuring that your path is always illuminated by the wisdom of many.

If at any point the voices are too much, you can silence them at will.

title: (Thinker) Multibrain
description_plain: You can give your full focus to several things at the same time and increase your mental capabilities by cloning your brain. You can do this once per day, and it will always appears within a jar. Fortunately, if it happens, they will never be malicious, as they will consider you a parental figure.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Dream Cinephile
description_plain:
You find it easy to fall asleep at will.

Whenever you sleep, your consciousness will be transported to a simulated movie cinema. If you fall asleep while maintaining contact with anybody else, you can pull them into this simulated space with you, knocking them out as well. Nothing that happens in the cinema will persist once they wake up from the dream, due to it being a mental space, the exception being a portion of the Thinker headaches or other costs incurred via the use of powers in the cinema. There is a door in the cinema that will wake up anybody that walks through it so long as their unconsciousness isn't being maintained by external forces (such as the effects of other powers or drawbacks).

In this cinema, anybody can choose to replay, pause, rewind, etc. any of their memories on the screen at perfect quality (viewing the screen intently will allow people to experience the non-audiovisual senses of those memories). These memories will be in pristine shape with no degradation from forgetting or alterations, being backed by postcognition to ensure they're always accurate (So you’d be able to view Imp while she had her power active in the memories, for example).

Anybody inside the cinema can apply their Thinker powers to the memory, allowing anybody focusing on the screen to be able to postcognitively get information from them as if the power were being used at the time of the memory, from the point of view of the memory (including the use of touch-based thinker powers on things the rememberer was touching at the time). Only the Thinker aspects will work for this, however, i.e. Victor draining a person's skills from a memory would not drain the person's skills in real life.

You know their names, date of creation accompanied with every use and their reason, motives of their existence, equipment and capabilities—things like clothing, tools and weapons, powers and skills, physical stats, etc; you even get what or who those identities are connected to and their relationship—things like whether they are enemies or friends, or perhaps family, maybe all three, etc. Although, you would need to sense those connections to know their identities.

title: (Thinker) Deja Vecu
description_plain:
You possess memories of the future, recalled as naturally and vividly as you remember your past. These future memories blend seamlessly into your existing recollections, making it nearly impossible to tell what has already happened and what is still to come. You may suddenly “remember” a conversation or an event—only to realize later that it hasn’t occurred yet, or perhaps never will.

You remember the near future with relative sharpness, while events further ahead become vague or completely lost. Just like how childhood memories blur over time, your visions of the distant future grow unstable the further they are from the present. Adding to the confusion, acting on a future event can shift the timeline, subtly or drastically, without your awareness. Each future memory you act on can cause other memories of the futures to shift or disappear and you won’t know what changed as they will have changed seamlessly in your mind.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Munchkin
description_plain:
You are exceptionally creative in how you use powers, yours and others'.

You instinctively spot unusual applications, clever combinations, and overlooked tricks. Small details stand out to you. Secondary effects suggest new possibilities.

Moreover, you have an intuitive sense of how to utilize abilities in the moment, able to think on the fly. This also extends to how to potentially spot weaknesses or bypass opponents' abilities.

For example, utilizing a swarm of bugs to suffocate an immortal and immutable brute by ramming bugs down their throat.

After seeing a power in action, grasping the basic concepts of it, or extrapolating it from simple inference, you quickly grasp ways it could be pushed further, used differently, or turned against its owner.

This also extends to making you excel at teaching others how to use their abilities.

You don’t increase the raw strength of any ability. You simply think of things other people don’t.

title: (Thinker/Breaker) Inner Self
description_plain:
Your shard grants conscious access to the abstract representation it uses to monitor and maintain your body and mind. Rather than entering it, you simultaneously perceive both realities at all times, your awareness naturally divided between the physical world and your shard's maintenance space without distraction or loss of focus. This inner world takes a symbolic form shaped by your psyche and powers—a factory, laboratory, temple, fortress, sewer system, or any similarly fitting environment.

Within it, every aspect of your being is represented by mechanisms, structures, and strange shadow-like workers. These entities are manifestations of your shard's autonomous maintenance processes, continuously repairing damage, regulating biology, organizing memories, and maintaining your Corona Pollentia. They are neither intelligent nor alive, merely specialized processes given symbolic form.

By directly repairing, reorganizing, or modifying these representations, the corresponding changes gradually manifest in reality. Likewise, injuries, diseases, mental trauma, power-related abnormalities, and other conditions appear within this landscape at their source, allowing them to be diagnosed and corrected before they worsen. The extent of your changes remains limited only by what your shard could ordinarily accomplish.

title: (Thinker) Pattern Recognition
description_plain: You are extremely good at learning and memorizing patterns. This allows you to quickly analyze an opponent’s attack sequences and movements, enabling you to predict their next actions based on observed behaviors. By identifying small changes in their strategy, you can make precise adjustments to counter their attacks or exploit weaknesses. Your accuracy is only limited by the information available, but once enough data is gathered, you can anticipate even subtle shifts. For example, after observing an opponent’s attack style for a short time, you can recognize their preferred moves—whether it’s a tendency to strike low after a feint or to rely on quick jabs between heavy hits, and from there you can “herd” them to your desired position.

title: (Thinker) Super Dream
description_plain: Whenever you sleep, your consciousness is transported to a simulated reality designed by your power to provide various methods to experiment and train your power to its fullest extent in a safe environment. Powers with limited resources do not consume them in this world. There is no sapient life in this world, just soulless automata for you to practice on. This world and your body in it are entirely mental/simulated, only useful to build skill and muscle memory. Time spent in Super Dream counts as proper sleep for the purposes of body maintenance. It is not just powers this helps train; if you, for example, wish to develop your skills as a mechanic, it will provide opportunities for you to develop the skill as long as you put the work in—do this enough times for multiple different disciplines and people might think you have a Tinker power or multiple Thinker powers even if this is your only power.

title: (Thinker) Full Picture
description_plain:
All your senses work in an “absolute” fashion: if you perceive something, no matter how occluded or how minute a part of it, you will be able to perceive it in its entirety with that sense as if you were right next to it. This is a full 3D extension of the sense along its topology, including internal topology if the object is not airtight. This doesn't give you knowledge of things resting on or inside the object, just the object itself. This has no range limit, allowing you to view even heavenly bodies light-years away in full, real time detail.

For example, if you saw only a person's foot, you’d be able to view that person in their entirety; if you heard a muffled conversation, you’d be able to hear the words loud and clear; if you touched a bottle, you could feel the entire surface of the bottle, including its inner walls; etc.

As well as this, you can also do the opposite, filtering specific objects out of your senses if you desire, leaving only a vague “blob” in its place that you know is filtered. So you could filter out a specific person's voice to ignore them; or, with quick reflexes, filter out a flashbang grenade to avoid being affected by it; etc.

This power does innately help you process your senses to prevent you from getting sensory overload, but that protection breaks down if this power is pointed against particularly large (building sized) or complex (Escher-like/fractal) objects, giving Thinker headaches without training and focus.

View a crude drawing of a building, and you can get the knowledge that the building it represents still exists and the rough cardinal direction it’s in; view a map of an area and you can get a top-down view of the area the map represents and where it exists relative to you; view a to-scale doll of a person (or one made using parts from the person) and you can not only get an accurate third person view of the target and can pinpoint their current location exactly, but you can also get extra insight into them like how they think or their emotional weaknesses, depending on what qualities the doll gets most accurate.

For instance, blasting an 80s jam from your speakers and getting into a scrap, timing your attacks to the beat would produce three times the result you’re looking for, be that damage, time disoriented from a stunning strike etcetera.

This also affects non-combat activities, with tinkering, training, calculating and more all growing more efficient and effective when performed to the beat.

title: (Thinker) Unwilling Prodigy
description_plain:
You become incredibly good at things you really don't want to do at that moment. The more you hate doing a specific task right now, the better and more skilled you become at it. The second you start feeling okay about doing it, or you don't mind anymore, your amazing skill starts to disappear until you're back to baseline skill at it.

Its caps at the skill level of the greatest human practitioner in history, enhanced by approximately twenty percent.

Any skill that you download from the target is largely the same, though there may be edge-cases where you’re unequipped due to not having developed the skill naturally.

If you have a method of retaining large amounts of information this can become quite lethal if you uploaded too much to one person.

title: (Thinker/Brute) Dark Knight
description_plain:
Ah you think darkness is your ally? You merely adopted the dark. I was born in it, molded by it. I didn't see the light until I was already a man, by then it was nothing to me but blinding!

The darker your surroundings, the more your baseline physical and mental capacities amplify. In dim light you grow noticeably stronger, more coordinated, and sharper of instinct.

As the area darkens further, your existing strength, speed, durability, and cognitive speed continue scaling upward. However, you do not create any capabilities you didn’t originally have. You cannot suddenly speak a language you never learned or play an instrument you never practiced, but any physical or mental task you could already perform becomes executed with escalating superhuman proficiency.

title: (Thinker) Combat Savant
description_plain:
This power turns you into a combat savant. When in battle, your mind makes multiple connections a second, taking into account your opponents' positions, your own weapons, their weapons, their likely future actions according to their body movements, and which course of action is likely to end in their defeat. While this accelerates your own perception while in combat, enough to keep up with your deductions and allows you to predict your enemies' actions to a point, these are all things you'd be capable of doing mundanely; this power simply makes this prediction faster and more intuitive.

However, whereas mundane folk would hit a plateau in skill at some point, you don't.

Every fight will allow you to make more connections; while this increase in skill is most noticeable at the start, where it might only take you a few fights to go from a complete novice with a weapon to an expert, you'll learn more complex, inventive, and efficient ways to use them as you fight and keep fighting. Some of that expertise would also carry over to other weapons, like using bladed weapons, allowing you to learn a sword faster. Yet this isn't limited to weapons; you'll get better at using your own body, powers, environment, and even other people, whether it's your allies or enemies. As you keep fighting with or against the same ones, you'll rapidly become more proficient in working together with them or putting them down quickly. And just like with weapons, you'll be able to carry some, if not most, tricks you learn against one opponent to another.

This would turn you into a decent combatant when you're new to this power, into someone as skilled as John Wick with a few dozen fights and would make people wonder whether you've got a power that makes you know the steps necessary to end any fight, once you've survived north of a hundred. While this assists you in combat, you’ll have to learn diplomacy on your own if you wish to end fights non-violently, though.

Less violent types of combat, like games, also benefit from this power somewhat, but this mostly serves to help you take notice of the behaviors and tells of your opponents; how useful this will prove depends entirely on what kind of game it is.

title: (Thinker/Brute) Transferable Skills
description_plain:
The ability to adapt your skills from one field to another is among the most valuable talents a person can have, a talent you have in spades it seems.

What this power offers is threefold. First and perhaps the most immediately apparent, is that all your skills will grow to match the greatest among your repertoire. Moreover, any improvements to your skill in any skill will also improve your skills in every other field. This applies to every skill you try your hand at.

If you had been a world-renowned chef you could pick up a gun and land a bullseye on a standard target as easy as it would be to dice some onions, even if you had never picked up a gun before.

An expert video gamer who’s never bothered to run would find himself capable of scaling up a building like he’d been practicing parkour his entire life.

The second effect is more passive, your mind immediately learns to adapt existing skills to improve one another across any field.

As the third effect, you’ve gained the power to shift your body’s physical form to reflect different skill sets. The physical body can only adapt to the level of the skill set you are utilizing. You can freely shift back to your normal form at will, you’ll retain your level of skill however your performance may suffer as your body is not at the optimal level to perform alongside your skill.

title: (Thinker/Master) TLC
description_plain:
You have a healing hand… a therapeutic touch, you could say.

You understand people’s traumas, hang-ups, and generally their mental state (intuitively and academically) while being capable of remediating or advising them with therapeutic strategies, knowing how to help people open up, and guiding them to deal with their problems.

If that isn’t enough, a touch (or a slap, that works, too!) implements this process altogether: healthy coping mechanisms, a new perspective on themselves, a possibility of self-awareness and self-reflection, only years of appointments can do to a person all in one helping hand.

It doesn’t change the contents or essence of a person, but rather changes a person’s outlook or perspective on their life, putting them on a path of healing and giving them the tools for a better road.

Each individual becomes a node in the network, pooling their skills and senses to form a powerful force. Those in the network also gain a minor multitasking ability so that they can make use of the additional senses with no problems.

There is a limitation, the effectiveness of the connection gradually weakens as the individual moves further away from other members of the network. As a result, it becomes harder for individuals to access the shared skills and senses, and vice versa.

title: (Thinker) Twisted World
description_plain:
You can see a second layer of reality. This reality is a mirror of the true reality but distorted by emotions and past actions. You can see actions that have happened in an area, to a limited degree, see the mental state of a person in physical form, and hear the true feelings and thoughts of people around you unfiltered.

When looking at an office worker, you may see a distorted version of them, where they are skinny and half dead, overworked. When looking at a murder scene you may see puddles of blood that aren’t there. When someone is talking, you do not hear what they say, but what they feel and think is unfiltered. Your eyes are open and you see the world for what it truly is. You and anyone else who has this power is immune to the distortion in the second reality, thus appearing as yourselves.

You can toggle this on and off.

title: (Thinker) Mental Faculty
description_plain:
You can 'pause' time and enter your own mindscape dimension, where you have god-like control, able to alter, modify, and create as you wish. Your thoughts, feelings, senses, and more are stored as books in your mind to an inhuman degree after minimal exposure. Inside your simulated mind, you can still view the outside world, but it will appear 'paused.'

Additionally, you can simulate different scenarios, practice skills, and interact with the stored books of thoughts and memories, allowing for cross-referencing information and solving complex problems. You can process information and think at incredible speeds, analyzing and coming to conclusions at an unprecedented rate. Your perfect memory enables you to read entire pages of text with just a glance and learn at an incredible pace. With some training, you'll even be able to cold read people on the same level as Alexandria.

You cannot modify your intelligence or thought process inside or using the mindscape. The dimension resets after each use, ensuring a fresh start every time.

title: (Thinker) Enhanced Mastery
description_plain:
You are able to master any skill or field of endeavor at an unparalleled pace and continue growing beyond conventional limits. Within days of study or practice, you can achieve the proficiency of professionals, and within a week, ascend to the ranks of experts. Though your growth slows as you approach mastery, your superhuman learning ability ensures continuous and noticeable improvement with sustained effort. For perspective, your training efficiency is such that hours of focused practice equate to months of typical learning.

This only affects your skills, not inherent attributes like strength or energy reserves. However, your potential for skill acquisition and refinement is virtually limitless, as you possess perfect technical retention and flawless execution. Once learned, your skills never degrade, and you always perform at your peak.

Moreover, your capabilities allow you to push skills to superhuman levels. You can achieve feats such as mastering echolocation to navigate blindfolded or manipulating your organs to avoid critical injuries during combat. While this supernatural skill offers incredible potential, it still operates within the realm of possibilities, so learning to fly would be impossible.

Lastly, you gain an acute awareness of errors during any task, recognizing mistakes as they occur and ensuring they are never repeated.

title: (Thinker) Canon Event
description_plain:
You are able to observe the future with perfect certainty. By focusing your thoughts on a specific moment and event, you can project your awareness forward in time to witness it as a disembodied, invisible presence. You view the event from above, unable to interact or influence what you see.

What you witness in these visions is guaranteed to occur. The people and actions within the event will unfold exactly as seen. However, your perspective is limited: you do not receive context before the event begins, nor do you witness what happens afterward.

Despite the certainty of the event itself, factors surrounding it remain fluid. The cause of the event, its consequences, and the reasons behind each action are all changeable. You can’t alter the event you’ve seen directly, but the surrounding narrative is malleable. By acting on what you’ve learned or preparing for the exact moment, you can shift the world around the moment you observed, changing what leads to it or what comes after.

Once you observe a specific moment in time, you are temporarily locked out of viewing other moments in that area or timeframe. Until the vision has fully played out in real time, you are blind to anything nearby in both space and chronology. Attempting to see other points close to the one you’ve already seen will result in a blank void. Beyond that limitation, you may explore the timeline freely, skipping to other places and distant futures as your focus and curiosity allow.

title: (Thinker/Striker) Martial Arts
description_plain:
Like a Tinker carries blueprints for impossible devices in their head, you carry kinetic blueprints. These are complete instructions for combat movement, katas, and response chains that your Shard generates and installs directly into your muscle memory. Visually speaking, you look like you jumped straight out of a kung-fu movie.

The martial arts you perform may have passing resemblance to real world styles but they are original creations generated by your Shard. Your Shard draws from human fighting history as raw inspiration, then warps it through alien logic to produce movements that are slightly more effective than they should be, much like Tinkertech cheats physics. A straight punch might generate far more force than your muscle mass should allow while a joint lock might hold despite your opponent being twice as strong.

Like Tinkertech, these effects are blackboxed. Others cannot learn these techniques because the move relies on countless Shard assisted cheats that cannot be replicated by normal human instruction. Much like a tech tree, as you build a stronger physique and greater skill depth, you unlock progressively more advanced techniques that require prerequisite skills to use, each new technique stronger than the last.

You also have your own tinker fugue, usually triggered by extreme stress. Your conscious mind steps back and your Shard puts you in a state of extreme focus and inspiration. This lets your instincts take over, moving with far greater power and skill than you normally output. You ignore pain and fatigue completely while your Shard invents entirely new katas on the fly, using sequences you have never seen before. In this state you automatically target anything you even subconsciously consider dangerous. The fugue typically lasts thirty seconds, although it can be lengthened if a fight hasn’t ended, after which you wake up, without memory of the fugue.

title: (Thinker/Master) Zeitgeist
description_plain:
You have a tremendous intuition for social dynamics that grows sharper, deeper, and more reliable as the scale of the systems involved grow larger. This is highly-effective for large organizations, spectacular for media ecosystems, and nearly precognitive when applied to entire cultures or economies. You could flawlessly predict all the results of an upcoming election from a pile of recent magazines, outpredict Number Man at the stock market, or engineer shifts in public consciousness powerful enough to spark nation-wide riots. Organizations that earn your ire might find their internal culture splintering into factions at the same time that public interest in their activities inexplicably wanes, all while fighting off seemingly unshakable PR disasters.

You aren't truly precognitive and your manipulations are far from absolute. For one, you require reliable information to work with, though passive cultural osmosis can do a lot of the groundwork when it comes to the big picture. If you want to truly understand a particular organization expect to spend some time digging through old memos or listening in on interpersonal chatter, and even then you can still be thrown off course by major disruptions, like natural disasters, sudden public revelations, or miraculous scientific breakthroughs.

Like Accord, you're also limited by the willingness of others to follow your instructions. Although the power of a few well-placed phone calls should never be underestimated, you're most effective when you already have organizations at your command or networks of contacts to act through, since the sort of influence you can exert as an individual isn't your power's forte.

This power includes an acute but limited intuition for the behavior of individuals, primarily focused on how they fit into and respond to the cultures around them.

title: (Thinker) Filter
description_plain:
You can create filters to see the world through. In practice what this does is it allows you to assign visual filters, which are expressed as colors that can manifest in any multitude of ways. The filters can be for anything you can imagine and can be altered at any time.

Filter for “danger” and assign it with the color red, and you’ll soon start to notice a clearly visible, only to you, sign on anything that could be a danger to you.

Smoky trails into rooms that foreshadow danger, a stock's ticker is soft red before you buy it, a random person on the street is flashing in bright red warning you of a killer in plain clothes, etc.

Likewise, you can also assign things such as “success” to the color green, numbers highlighted in green as you fill out a lottery ticket, a smoky trail leading somewhere, and the correct wire to defuse a bomb highlighting a bright and unmistakable neon green.

The more vivid the colors, the closer to your assigned filter it matches. Despite however many filters you assign or however you choose to manifest it, it’ll never actually deter your normal vision, still being fully aware of what your normal visual input would show. You can assign as many filters as you want, as broad or specific as you want, and can reassign colors and how that manifests at will.

You also possess a secondary multi-tasking thinker ability that allows your perception to seamlessly process both your normal vision and your future sight at the same time, ensuring this duality doesn’t interfere with the natural flow of your body’s movements or actions.

title: (Thinker) Ninshú
description_plain:
You can link to anything and anyone within a 100-meter radius. Everyone you link with also gains a link to one another, even if you were to add more later on.

Everyone linked to one another develops a deep and incredible understanding of each other, allowing them to understand and share feelings, insights, intentions, and experiences without a word.

This connection will persist even after they leave your range, and will allow you to communicate with one another even from afar without any difficulties. You’ll each be immediately notified when and if someone in your connection is in danger.

The effects are greatly magnified when in physical contact, allowing you to view and understand another’s entire life with a single brief touch.

This can also be manipulated to be one way by any member, allowing a method of simply transferring information if a member wishes, such as teaching another member a language they know, allowing them to not share other information with another if they choose not to.

As you are the center for this, you can choose to exclude some or to excise them from your group at will. Others cannot prevent you from viewing any information at will, and you can pass this ability to bypass information denial to other members.

title: (Thinker) I’ve Come to Bargain
description_plain:
Upon entering combat, you create a temporal “lock,” anchoring your consciousness to that moment. If you die, time rewinds to the instant the lock was formed, allowing you to attempt the fight again with full awareness of past failures. This reset occurs endlessly, granting infinite retries. However, the trauma of each death accumulates, with pain, fear, and mental exhaustion compounding over time. There is no reprieve between loops; the moment you die, you are immediately thrust back into battle, with no opportunity for rest or recovery for your mind.

The lock remains active until you either emerge victorious or successfully disengage from combat. If you are caught in a surprise attack, you can still be killed outright. However, if you survive the initial attack, the lock will form at that exact moment—meaning every reset will return you to the instant you first endured the ambush.

title: (Thinker) Your Only Move
description_plain:
At any time, you can ‘pause’ time from your perspective, rendering both yourself and others unable to move. From this position, you can choose to undertake one simple physical action taking no more than one and a half seconds, such as throwing a punch, jumping, running a predetermined distance, or using another power. Following this decision, you are locked into performing the action to its completion, at which point time will freeze again and you can take another action as before. If you are interrupted while taking the action, time will only ‘pause’ again when you would have ‘paused’ before had the action completed as intended

You can return to normal time at any point.

title: (Thinker/Mover) Pathfinder
description_plain:
You have the incredible power of Path To Victory! But only for getting object A to point B. You can choose a subject/group of subjects (it must be an actual physical thing, you can't run a “Path to bring good fortune to me” or anything similarly abstract) and a position to take it to, at which then your power will give you a step-by-step precognitive guide towards getting the target to its location in the most efficient way possible, with the power guiding your body to perfectly perform the actions required.

When setting your paths, the target location must be a real thing and not too vague (no “path to bringing my opponents to death” or “path to a place/person that will help me succeed”), although it can be moving, and you don't need to know where exactly it is i.e “Path to get on to that train” or “Path to the nearest grocery store” are both valid paths.

Your path automatically defaults to ensuring the safety of the object being transported as much as is physically possible while still moving it. However, you can toggle this protection off for a more efficient path.

You are also capable of dictating specific routings for your path such as “Path to getting there stealthily” or “Path to the most dramatic entrance”.

Keep in mind that even with these restrictions, you can still pull off some less obvious paths like “Path to getting this bullet into their head” or “Path to getting this villain to prison” (the path doesn't ensure that the villain will necessarily stay in said prison, just that they’ll get there).

title: (Thinker/Master) Self Image
description_plain:
That which holds an image of an Angel, Becomes itself an Angel

Any image of yourself—whether it's a drawing, photograph, statue, reflection, or any other representation—is connected to you. You have the ability to perceive through these images and even transform them into physical manifestations of yourself. The closer the image resembles you in detail and accuracy, the less effort it requires to convert it into a fully functional clone. For example, a life-sized statue of yourself can easily be animated into what is essentially a perfect replica, with minimal strain and limitation. On the other hand, a simple printed photograph of you would be more challenging to transform into a clone, requiring greater effort and potentially resulting in a less stable copy.

These clones all have your powers, acting as extensions of your will. If your original body were to be destroyed, your consciousness would automatically transfer to one of your existing images, allowing you to survive as long as any depiction of you remains. Through these clones, you can continue to interact with the world, effectively making you immortal as long as there are images of you in existence.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Glass Cannon
description_plain:
Having the power of “coming back” from death, and getting stronger from your untimely end seems like a worthwhile power, aside from the necessity of “dying” time and time again for it to work. Unfortunately, this isn’t a simple “get stronger quick” scheme rolled into a power.

Let me explain: As opposed to truly dying and then returning to the point of time before your death, you experience precognitive simulations of the future timelines à la Coil. These keep going until your “death”, which you then go back to a place in time where your safety point is. Hell, you could use this aspect as information gathering from several timelines you only shut down with your… willingness, in sensible terms, with each try experiencing growing thinker headaches until you can’t anymore.

A second facet of this is every time you “die” in a conflict or obstacle to overcome, you gain offensive abilities addressing said circumstances to deal with them next. Hell, you can gain power expressions from parahuman powers that got the better of you with a solely offensive spin. A downside of diminishing returns each time you “die” from the same parahuman power, starting strong yet weaker from the original, only to trickle down to a crawl in strength gain.

This goes back to the power’s title and concept: it turns you into a Glass Cannon (an RPG archetype centered on offense without defense to compensate; hits hard, dies easily) for the power’s function, which means you’ll never get any defensive abilities or power expressions from your “deaths”.

Another limitation of this is the limited frequency of your “deaths” until you growingly suffer Thinker headaches.

Note: Offensive abilities range from physical enhancements sans durability, and skills geared to inflict more damage, such as weapon handling or unarmed hand-to-hand combat.

title: (Striker) Swapped Palms
description_plain:
You are able to selectively swap the regions of space between your hands. Your power does not affect anything outside of a 10 cm sphere touching the center of your palms.

It does not work within living beings, but can affect regions of space that are in contact with them—for example, you could swap a chunk of concrete that your hand is resting on with the space around another’s hand, encasing their hand in concrete. However, you cannot swap the region of space inside their hand, or directly affect any part of their body.

title: (Striker/Blaster) Striker
description_plain:
You can deliver kicks with explosive, disproportionate force—far beyond what your physical strength alone should allow. Even casual kicks you land feel like they hit with the force of a sledgehammer. Your most powerful kicks, in ideal conditions, are capable of launching enemies or objects with the momentum and force of a speeding car.

In addition, you also have a subtle control over the trajectory of anything you kick. Whether it’s a person, a projectile, or a loose object, you can influence its direction slightly mid-flight, allowing for surprisingly accurate shots. This effect isn’t precise enough for full guidance, but it’s more than enough to curve a kick just right to catch someone off-guard or redirect a launched object toward a secondary target.

title: (Striker/Shaker) Hardlight
description_plain: You can form hardlight constructs with just a thought within a meter of yourself, limited to a total of 10m³ of hardlight. Hardlight has the strength of steel, provided you leave it as normal. The greatest advantage of hardlight is that it can imitate other matter, allowing you to create anything. Even comes with a complimentary perfect memory to store all your knowledge. Your constructs have no range limit, but it will still count to your hardlight limit until you dispel it.

title: (Striker/Stranger) The Cheese Touch
description_plain:
You can mark up to five people by touching them. This gives them a Stranger aura of 15 feet that they cannot turn off until they touch someone else with the place you touched them, upon which the mark will be placed on the new person instead, and so on and so forth. That is to say, there can only be (at most) 5 people with a mark at any given time. You can take away these marks whenever you wish.

The Stranger aura makes people subconsciously inch away from the target and harbor moderately negative feelings towards the target, which get worse the longer they stay inside the aura. Staying out of the aura will have these effects dissipate over an hour. People who have a mark will be immune to the effects of other people who have the mark.

This can be applied to yourself if a person with a mark touches you. If this happens, you can turn it off, disable the effect, or get rid of it the regular way. You will always know who has a mark at any given time, and how long they've had it.

title: (Striker/Mover) DPS
description_plain:
You can move fast—but only when you’re attacking. Your punches, kicks, and any kind of strike happen at lightning speed, letting you land dozens of hits in just a few seconds. Your limbs become a blur when you’re on the offensive, making it hard for enemies to react or block once you’re within reach. This speed only applies to attacks, making you a serious threat in close combat where every moment counts.

Outside of attacking, you’re stuck at normal human speed. You can’t run faster, dodge quicker, or move around any faster than an average person. This means if someone keeps their distance or tries to outmaneuver you, you can’t rely on your power to catch them or get away.

Additionally, just because your attacks are fast doesn’t mean they hit hard. Each blow carries only as much force as your normal strength allows—no more than what you’d do at regular speed. A hundred fast punches still hurt like a hundred normal ones, not like being hit by a truck.

title: (Striker) 100th Strike
description_plain:
All of your attacks only deal 1/100 of the damage they normally would. All of the power that is not dealt is stocked up, and it caps out at 100. When you reach the 100th strike, all of the stockpiled damage is merged, and multiplied by 100 for the final blow. The process then repeats itself after the 100th. You can delay this for as long as you like, but you can only have one 100th strike.

You aren't strictly required to use this power at the 100th blow, you can use this power as low as 2 blows. Remember though, you can't hold it back. If you have 6 blows already stocked up, you can't only use 2. Do note though that the multiplier is weaker the fewer blows it has to work with. If you have 6 blows, it will only be a multiplier of 6 times.

title: (Striker/Brute) Rusted Juggernaut
description_plain:
Your touch can cause anything colloquially known as “metal,” including materials generated by other parahuman powers, to violently tear itself apart and wrap around your body as a full suit of armor. Both the process and the resulting armour does not harm you or limit your movement.

title: (Striker) Midas Touch

title: (Striker/Blaster) The Spin
description_plain: You have the ability to touch an object and induce a rotational force with your point of contact being the pivot. It starts at a manageable level, but with each rotation, the object accelerates more and more. This momentum is built up over time, allowing you to launch high-speed objects in a desired direction at any moment. The friction at the point of contact is reduced, allowing the object to spin with minimal resistance. The force and speed of the launch are directly proportional to the speed and force with which you spin the object. You may not spin objects with a volume greater than 10 cubic meters.

title: (Striker/Tinker) Facet
description_plain:
You can create crystal growths with a touch, which you can then dismantle to create catastrophic artillery-level siege weapons and any ammunition they might need. You can do this fast enough to construct an artillery weapon within minutes and have enough power-given know-how to build and utilize your constructions, though these are still fundamentally mundane weapons instead of true Tinkertech. The crystals you create become malleable under your touch, allowing you to form them into the various parts required for your artillery and when touching a place with both hands can create crystals fast enough to be useful in combat.

While your crystals are as durable as the material they're made of once created, they crumble over the course of an hour and tend to collapse or weaken much faster when not being actively used, whether in combat, as a weapon or as material for your artillery. Your weapons won’t work unless you’re the one using them, or at least the one pressing the ‘trigger’ as your crystals keep their normal rigor when not in contact with you.

Additionally your crystals change colors and type from day to day, affected by various factors from your mood, your shards disposition towards you, up to the purpose you’re using them for, making your crystals range from being made of Fluorite, Quartz, Jade or any other crystal and very rarely out of Talc or Diamond. Your interactions with your crystals are unaffected by which material they’re made of⁩⁩, making construction just as fast independent of the material they’re currently made of.

title: (Striker) Human Capacitor
description_plain:
Your whole body is a living battery. You will naturally generate electricity over time, which will take a week to fully charge. You can, however, absorb electricity through direct contact with a charged material. You can then release this stored energy at will through any part of your body, delivering electric shock to anything that touches you.

You can store enough to completely burn someone to crips instantly or just the right amount to stun for a few seconds. You can't control the path that your current will take and although you can send your energy through clothes with the right settings, it would burn holes into them to make way for the current.

Furthermore, you are immune to electric attacks as long as you have enough storage to absorb them completely, but once your storage is full, you will take damage, though you are heavily resistant.
