title: (Striker) Machine Spirit
description_plain:
You have the power to bless a machine with a spirit, guiding it in your chosen direction. The disposition of these creations is not tethered to their form; whether a tank aiding its pilots, a toaster thirsting for blood, or a printer dutifully obeying commands, the original purpose of the object has minimal sway over its essence, for good or ill.

Examples of usage can focus on the maximization of their function, such as enhancing a gun's accuracy to precisely hit the wielder's desired target, prolonging a sword's sharpness, or just making a Machine gain a trait not commonly seen on them, like a hyper-aggressive toaster that will burn all bread put on them because they want Humanity to suffer, it can too enable more autonomous functionalities in modern devices like planes, cars, or smartphones. These will have options to be more "Autonomous", such as AI-like help, self-driving if the device can move for itself in the hardware front, or more.

(Additionally, all machine spirits gain imperceptible durability through metaphysical means and minor self-repair abilities tailored for preservation and maintenance purposes.).

Their emotional level has a broad spectrum, from highly emotional to extremely logical, with intelligence ranging from that of a child to that of an adult human, and the more powerful and precise you make, the more time you need to awaken their spirit. All of them can and will grow with stimuli, gaining new traits based on their experience and intensity.

As their creator, All Blessed Machines hold you in high regard. However, their affections can shift, and they may develop favorites beyond you.

title: (Striker) Twin Impact
description_plain:
Twin Impact allows the user to, at the site of any initial impact, create a second impact remotely and at their discretion. The second impact will be at least 5 times stronger than the initial one. It can also be used on objects or on people.

The second impact can be triggered at any moment, regardless of how much time has passed or how far away the user is. There is no limit to how many times this ability can be used; however, each activation must be applied to a different impact location for it to take effect.

title: (Striker) Meat Touch
description_plain:
You have the ability to cause objects that you touch to be transformed into biological versions of themselves, which you can then slowly mutate and alter the properties of. The more you alter and change an object, the longer you must spend working on it to do so. With enough time spent on an object, you can be able to grant it various biological functions, ranging from skeletal reinforcement to creating digestive acids to even creating basic and rudimentary nervous systems.

You can take a sword and convert it to a sword-shaped mass of flesh and then turn the sharp edge of the blade into a row of jagged teeth that regrow when knocked out or broken. You can take a bomb and make it into a living organism filled with volatile and explosive gas and then have it grow legs, creating a network of nerve impulses that allow the living bomb to scurry around mindlessly. With enough time and focus, you can even heal injuries on yourself and others by converting an object into flesh and then grafting it into the wound, though this is extremely difficult and time-consuming. You could even turn tinkertech into a fleshy version of itself that you could modify; converted tinkertech no longer needs maintenance. You also gain a Panacea like understanding of the biological creatures you touch.

Your only major limits are time, because alterations to objects take time to perform, and size. The bigger an object is, the harder it is to change it, and the longer it takes to do so. At a certain point an object will be too large for your power to work on, and this is also the case for objects which are secured into place in their environment. A parking meter that is cemented into the sidewalk would be something that you can not use your power on, but if that same parking meter were to be ripped from the sidewalk by something else, you could then grab it and begin to use your power on it. Most vehicles are too large for you to use your power on.

title: (Striker/Thinker) Cold Weaponry
description_plain:
You have a mental database of all Cold Weapons made throughout history, it updates whenever a new one is made. Through touch you can use this database to convert a cold weapon into a different cold weapon. The database also contains all skills related to using those weapons, allowing you to perfectly wield them.

You can split bigger weapons into smaller ones, and can remerge them as long as they are touching each other. You can't split weapons made through splitting. You can still use your weapon conversion on them.

You are aware of all cold weapons within 100 meters of you. You also know their exact distance, direction, composition, design and state.

Your database — and thus your weapon conversion  — are limited to mundane cold weapons.

You may touch a device and literally black box it, causing it to become encased by a dark veil. This causes the device to be immune to thinker/tinker abilities to understand what's within, as well as abstractifying it's function with regard to physics. The durability of the veil is proportional to the durability of the device, and all effects reset to normal if the veil is pierced.

description_plain:

Now, they resemble neon-glowing metal wires that pulse with a vibrant, ethereal light beneath your skin. title: (Striker) Discombobulating Puppeteer
description_plain:
You can scan and tweak the body of others. This requires direct skin-to-skin contact with your target, with your awareness and control scaling directly to both the surface area of contact and the duration it is maintained. A single fingertip for a second gives you a faint glimpse of their immediate biological state, while a full palm for a minute lets you map entire systems, and sustained full-body contact turns their internal biology into an open book you can read and rewrite at will.

This control only allows you to alter existing biological functions, forcing them to operate in ways they were never meant to, such as flooding the brain with dopamine to engineer devotion, alter their hormonal balance, toggle their heart rate from slow to fast instantly, or inhibiting neural pathways to alter the senses. On the other hand you wouldn’t be able to create new structures, heal wounds, reshape flesh, or alter genetics, only alter what is already present. Each tweak feeds you new data on cause and effect, deepening your understanding of their specific body and as you understand their body better, you can continue to tweak it in unique and novel ways.

The instant skin contact breaks, your supernatural understanding and tweaking ability reset entirely to baseline. However, your memory retains the knowledge of what you discovered, allowing you to relearn their body and reinstate control far more efficiently with every subsequent encounter.

title: (Striker/Trump) Equip Bonuses
description_plain:
You have gained the ability to “equip” gear that you are carrying. When an item is equipped, it grants an additional bonus distinct from its natural function. For example, wearing plate armor already provides physical protection, but equipping it might enhance your overall endurance, grant additional resistance to blunt force trauma, or even extend its defensive benefits to areas not covered by the armor itself. Similarly, a sword will still cut as normal when wielded, but equipping it could increase your strength, improve your cutting precision, or even enhance your ability to parry attacks.

The quality and nature of the gear influence the bonuses granted. A high-quality shield might not only improve your ability to block attacks but also provide resistance to knockback or stagger effects. A poorly made or damaged weapon, on the other hand, might only grant a minor boost or come with drawbacks, such as a rusted sword offering slight strength enhancement but increasing the risk of it breaking mid-fight.

Other gear may offer protection against specific conditions—equipping a treated cloak might grant resistance to heat, while a reinforced helmet could help you resist concussive forces or mental attacks.

However, you cannot over-equip yourself. Even if you can physically wear multiple pieces of gear at once, you can only equip items that do not interfere with each other. For instance, you may be able to wear both a suit of heavy plate armor and a cloak, but you would have to choose which one to equip—the armor for increased resilience or the cloak for enhanced mobility or elemental resistance. However, as long as they don’t take the same “slot”, then you are free to equip as many things as you can wear.

You can maintain control over any object you are affected by, even if you are no longer touching them, and can release control whenever.

description_plain:
By touching an object that fits within 2ft³ of space, you can convert it into a single indestructible Locust under your direction.

title: (Striker/Changer) The Face Stealer
description_plain:
With a mere touch, you can strip an entity of its face, leaving behind a smooth, featureless void where it once was. The victim is neither truly dead nor alive, existing in a suspended state where they require no sustenance, oxygen, or sleep. Any wounds they had at the moment of theft are rendered inert—never worsening, but never healing either. They effectively become unchanging, unable to die. While they remain functionally immortal in this state, they are utterly deprived of their senses of sight, smell, and taste, and are left incapable of speech.

Once stolen, a face becomes yours to wear, and with it, you inherit the natural and supernatural traits associated with it. A dog’s face grants an unparalleled sense of smell, a cat’s bestows superior night vision, and the face of a parahuman with clairvoyance or emotion-sensing allows you to use those abilities as if they were your own. You can seamlessly switch between faces at will, but only one may be worn at a time. The transition is instantaneous, letting you adapt to different situations with frightening speed. If you somehow have more than one face, you can wear multiple faces.

Your collection of faces is permanent unless you choose to return them, at which point the victim regains their senses and consciousness as if no time had passed.

title: (Striker/Trump) Tuning Fork
description_plain:
Upon making contact with something, a looping timer will begin: its length depending on how difficult the target would be to harm. A normal person would only take a few seconds, while a Titan may take a dozen or so minutes.

Upon completion of a loop of the timer, your strikes will become better augmented to harm your target. Against Velocity, they may allow you to strike a place he was a few seconds ago to harm him, while against Panacea, it may give your strikes a Blaster rating or produce a shield around them. This only augments the effects of your strikes, meaning it won't do things such as boost your speed. Each additional loop increases how effective your strikes are, and against targets more susceptible to harm, they may even become lethal after only a few loops.

These effects cannot be passive in nature, and choosing a new target will reset any past augmentations and start a new timer catered for them. You don't need to switch targets when attacking a new one, but adaptations meant for some may not help you against others. They also plateau after a while, since there's only a certain amount of damage your strikes can deal before they just become instantly lethal.

You can 'target' just about anything, from a stone to an Endbringer, though certain targets may have unique interactions with your power. An example would be Eidolon switching powers or Endbringers' unique internal structure, though even then, you'd still eventually be able to kill them as well.

If you target Scion, you could manage to destroy his body, and even eventually manage to find a way to circumvent the Stilling, but the actual Hub is beyond you due to shard restrictions. It would also take a ridiculously long time.

title: (Striker/Trump) Object Playlist
description_plain:
You have a mental Playlist that is filled by touching a non-living object that isn't bigger than you. Said Playlist is numbered 1 to 5—with 1 being the newest item—and as such can only hold 5 items. Adding a item to the Playlist pushes the previous item one number below, doing so while the Playlist is full means the oldest item is discarded to make space for the new newest. You have a couple ways of managing your Playlist: you can discard an item, you can manually drag around a single item at a time, you can directly swap two items positions, and you can randomly shuffle everything.

By selecting a number from the Playlist you gain absolute awareness of the object within it—for example what a specific knife can cut, its material composition, who made it, what was it used for since its creation, etc. Though the true purpose of the selection is your capacity to them recreate the selected item either into your hand, with said hand repositioned in whatever way you want—like say recreating a Gun with your finger already on the trigger, or recreating multiple knifes between your fingers. You can freely overwrite whatever is already in your hand with a selected item.

Since the items within a Playlist are a 1:1 copy of the original object at the time of registry, they also contain any properties acquired by being affected or made by a power, though while for example the cable from Hookline would keep its All-or-Nothing durability due to it being a property of the chain itself you would not have telekinetic control over it.

Each item in the Playlist can have a maximum of 20 instances at a time. The oldest instance of an item disappears to make way for its newest instance if its limit is surpassed. if an item is no longer in the Playlist all of its instances disappear, they also disappear 1 hour after their creation.

Together with a scary capacity to accurately hit any of your projectiles, your entire body is enhanced to the human limit to take advantage of your Playlist.

title: (Striker/Thinker) Fight Me With Your Fists
description_plain:
Your Striker ability allows you to interact with abstract or non-physical effects as if they were solid, tangible phenomena. To you, every hostile intent, psychic attack, emotional manipulation, or conceptual influence can be met on physical terms. You can literally grab and strike the intangible, treating mental or metaphysical assaults as if they were solid things. When someone tries to dominate your mind, you catch the command midair and snap it in half. When despair or fear creep in, you can crush them underfoot like any other threat. If someone forces you into an illusion, you punch it till it crumbles. You can even crush or choke parahuman senses that reach too close or back at all.

Your Thinker aspect translates these conceptual effects into perceivable structures — patterns, motions, or distortions you can read and react to. You can see manipulation before it takes hold, feel the weight of a power before it lands, and hear deceit as if it were a note out of tune. You’re not immune to such effects — you simply fight them head-on, nullifying their influence through direct, physical confrontation. Even psychological trauma or precognitive inevitabilities can be confronted and dismantled by force of will made real.

This, however, doesn't give you the knowledge/sense of how to fight or the strength/might needed to perform those feats; still, removing Taylor's control of something/someone is as easy as snapping a thread, while beating Zion's depression would be an effort in futility.

title: (Striker) Dynamo
description_plain:
You can generate and decrease mundane energy through touch, such as generating large spikes of heat able to melt concrete or stopping bullets against your skin. You don't have a traditional self-protecting Manton limit, rather a percent of your output is instead inverted as a way to protect yourself from harm, which can be ignored if you wish to push yourself further at the cost of your safety.

You aren't limited against using multiple energy types at once, nor against directly affecting living things. This power gets noticeably stronger with prolonged use of a single output, with the cost being that it takes an increasingly longer amount of time to turn off. Your maximum strength would be roughly equal to Lung's heat output in his fight against Leviathan, though your lack of any dynakinesis and the massive ‘cool off’ time would likely cause enough collateral to get you slapped with a kill order.

title: (Striker/Thinker) "Healer"
description_plain:
By manipulating time and matter, you can return things to their original states and heal deep injuries. Even if the patient is barely alive, you can save them and restore their bodies to their optimum state.

However, to do this, you must understand the perfect condition of the body you are restoring, so, to achieve this, your power makes you go through all the experiences of the target, meaning you will experience their lifetime of pain in just a few seconds. As a side effect of experiencing your patient’s memories, if you can somehow think through the pain, you can gain access to their skills. With enough mastery you can also modify the process, allowing you to alter the bodies of your targets at will instead of simply restoring them.

When used, the force and effect of that strike are multiplied by an exponent of 2.5, turning even a normal blow into something violently devastating.

This boost also applies to later Black Flashes, meaning repeated successful strikes can make each follow-up hit sharper, stronger, and more devastating.

title: (Striker) Mutagen
description_plain:

This artificial evolution will cause the emergence of traits desired by the user of this power if they are possible with enough time, starting with and prioritizing conscious desires and then working on subconscious desires if it has time.

You can choose what types of life allow the catalyst to affect and not affect when creating it, like bacteria and viruses, for example.

title: (Striker/Trump) Thorny Rose
description_plain:
You have control over an improved version of Armsmaster's nano-thorn technology. Any attack you make or power you use, from a simple punch to a reality warping doom laser, is infused with the ability to completely sever molecular bonds.

This power has two modes, passive and active. In passive mode, you have the equivalent of what Armsmaster used against Leviathan applied to all of your attacks (including weapons and powers), without the visible effect. However, this comes at a cost -- being extremely difficult to control. You may find yourself accidentally cutting through precious objects or even people merely by touching them. You can improve in control over time and regular usage of your power in conflict but you may still unintentionally affect parts of an object or power that you did not intend to. However, the The 'Holding Back' perk will allow you to determine if your power is on or off as well as control what is affected.

In active mode, you gain access to an improved version which allows you to sever nearly anything, up to and including an Endbringer core. This still isn't an "absolute" effect, so it will not be able to damage things such as Alexandria's body stasis or The Siberian. Because this mode is extremely energy intensive for your Shard, it will give you the full-body equivalent of a thinker headache if you use it too often. If you are Shardless, you do not feel this pain but are instead paying the increased energy cost yourself, so use this mode sparingly. Attacks infused during active mode gain an pale aura of a color of your choosing.

You can also temporarily infuse objects with the ability to create Nano-Thorns, which allows you to make items such as Nano-Thorn daggers. These last for a couple hours.

title: (Changer) Athletic
description_plain:
Your body is changed so that your body fat percentage always stays the same as that of a well-trained athlete. No matter how much fat you gain, your body automatically builds enough muscle to keep the fat percentage low. The change happens instantly and without pain, as if your body is just naturally adapting. Since this doesn’t remove fat and instead adds muscles to preserve its ratio, that means that the higher the amount of fat you have, the more muscles you have to compensate.

Any muscle added by this power is temporary and automatically removed if your fat levels drop enough to no longer require it to maintain the athletic fat percentage. However, any muscle gained through legitimate training or natural development is retained and not removed by the power.

Along with the look, at baseline, you also gain the strength, speed, endurance, and general physical performance of someone who trains like a top athlete, even if you never exercise.

title: (Changer) Genetic Reformatting
description_plain:
You shapeshift by rewriting your active genetic expression in real time, meaning you can instantly gain any trait you could have naturally been born with based on the genetic material already present in your DNA. This includes changes like altering your eye, hair, or skin color, modifying your height, bone density, or muscle composition, switching sex characteristics, or adjusting your metabolism and pain tolerance. All of these shifts remain within the natural range of human variation present in your immediate lineage and occur without any delay or discomfort. For example, if your parents both have brown eyes, you cannot instantly give yourself blue eyes, but if your family has a recessive blue eye allele, you can.

You can also access traits from your ancestors via genetic regression along your ancestral line, including characteristics you personally could not have been born with, such as archaic hominid features like a Neanderthal's robust bone structure or a Denisovan's enamel thickness. However, the further back the ancestor, the longer the transformation takes and the less comfortable you feel in that form, ranging from a few minutes and mild oddness to several hours and a dull ache, and up to days paired with severe dysphoria and nausea. Your body may even begin to reject these ancient forms after prolonged exposure, forcing you back into your normal state.

title: (Changer/Trump) Metamorphosis
description_plain:
You can create a cocoon around your body. This cocoon can give your body a few benefits or drawbacks, depending on your perspective. If you stay in the cocoon for less than an hour, all it will do is slowly heal you of any injuries and cure you of any disease. But stay there longer than an hour, and your appearance will start to be altered. It will optimise the body's natural systems, and if you have any other abilities, it will slowly transform your body to better reflect and utilise them.

An example is that if you have pyrokinetic power, your body will start to turn red and perpetually be hot, maybe even having flames instead of hair. This will result in your pyrokinetic power growing stronger, either in potency or control.

title: (Changer/Brute) Dire Wolf
description_plain:
You can transform into a colossal wolf roughly the size of a car, gaining devastating physical prowess that lets you tear through steel barriers or knock aside entire vehicles with a single swipe. The jaws of this dire wolf can bite through reinforced metal without strain, and you can leap tremendous distances, easily clearing obstacles or reaching rooftops in a single bound. While in this form, your speed far surpasses that of an ordinary car, allowing you to race across highways and city streets at blinding velocity. Your dense fur and hide provide formidable protection against small-arms fire, and even if you do sustain injury, your body mends itself at an accelerated pace, allowing you to recover from wounds that would be crippling for a normal human.

You retain your full human intellect and control while transformed, avoiding the pitfalls of an animalistic mindset. Shifting to and from this dire wolf shape requires only a few moments, leaving you free to adapt quickly in combat or other high-pressure situations. You can remain in this alternate form indefinitely without any inherent drawbacks, ensuring you always have access to an immense well of strength, speed, and resilience whenever you need it.

title: (Changer/Thinker) Fangs
description_plain:
You can manifest a pair of sharp, predatory fangs in your mouth at will. These fangs are capable of piercing flesh with ease, allowing you to extract blood directly from living beings. The blood you consume functions as a substitute for conventional nourishment—approximately one pint is sufficient to sustain you for a full day, and since the average human body contains about 10.5 pints, a single person can theoretically provide enough sustenance for over ten days.

In addition to providing sustenance, the blood you consume temporarily grants you access to the learned skills of your target, matching their level of experience. Whether it’s martial arts, marksmanship, surgery, or even painting, their mastery becomes yours for as long as the blood remains within your system. These borrowed skills fade gradually as you digest the blood, typically lasting several hours depending on your metabolism and activity. However, repeated feedings from the same individual cause the skill to imprint more deeply—if consumed often enough, these abilities may become a permanent part of your own repertoire.

This ability does not allow you to copy superpowers, mutations, or unique physiological traits—only skills that were learned through training, study, or experience. While you cannot mimic a powered individual’s abilities, the flavor of their blood often tells its own story. Different blood types have distinct tastes, with rarer types being noticeably more satisfying. Blood altered by powers, mutations, or otherwise unique biology offers the richest and most euphoric flavor, often proving addictively irresistible even without the promise of a useful skill.

title: (Changer) Manticore
description_plain:
Your body is divided into three distinct sections for the purpose of transformation: your torso, your limbs (arms and legs as one group), and your back. You are able to shift each section independently into the equivalent of an animal’s corresponding anatomy. For example, your torso might become that of a lion, your limbs those of a gorilla, and your back may take on features like wings from a bat or a scorpion’s tail.

These transformations grant the physical traits of the chosen animal—strength, durability, natural weapons, or mobility—but all of them are scaled to what the human frame can support. Oversized parts, such as those from elephants or whales, are proportionally reduced to what a human body can reasonably support. Conversely, features from smaller animals, such as a hawk’s wings or a mantis’s claws, are scaled up in size and power to remain practical and physically functional on your form.

Your head is the one part of your body that cannot change. No matter what form the rest of you takes, your face, skull, and sensory organs remain human. This also means any sensory advantages from animal heads—such as enhanced smell or night vision—are not gained.

Each section must be drawn from a different animal. You cannot use the same creature more than once across the three sections.

title: (Changer/Master) Sheeda
description_plain:
You can take the form of a three inch tall winged humanoid with exceptionally sharp teeth. While in this form you’re capable of flight to the same speed you can run in all directions.

Additionally, if you can latch onto the back of a creature’s neck, you can use your teeth to cut into their bodies and take direct control of their nervous system, puppeting it from the inside. title: (Changer) Fishing Trip
description_plain:
You can transform your body based on deep-sea creatures. Your transformations favor boneless or cartilaginous marine life, with exoskeletons counting as bones for this limitation. Your focus is on stuff like cephalopods, jellyfish, rays, and certain eels. Creatures with internal skeletons are harder, if not impossible, to use. When you transform you are not limited to the actual size of the original creature; all forms are scaled appropriately to match your own biomass. A tiny venomous snail can be manifested as a fist-sized barb, while the form of a giant squid is condensed down.

You can choose how exactly your transformation works at any given moment, such as splitting an arm into a cluster of strong, prehensile tentacles for grappling, or fuse the mass of your lower body into a single, powerful muscular appendage to deliver a crushing blow or propel yourself. You can extrude venomous spines along your forearms, flatten your torso into a rippling mantle for gliding, or cause your eyes to bulge and become wide, dark pools capable of perceiving minute electrical impulses in the air, allowing you to "see" the nervous system activity of nearby beings, even through obstacles.

These adaptations are altered to function outside their natural environment. Gills can filter oxygen from air, hydrostatic support replaces the need for deep-sea pressure, and specialized senses like electroreception or lateral line detection translate to land, granting you awareness of vibrations and bioelectric signatures in your immediate vicinity. The main limitations is that while your power gives you the instinctive capability to control these transformations, you do not have the intimate knowledge of their biology, meaning you need to study it on your own. Additionally, while you can reconfigure, you can't create mass from nothing.

A side effect is that you are a very good swimmer.

title: (Changer/Brute) Cells At Work
description_plain:
Each cell in your body is a sentient being with a sole purpose: to keep you alive and well. While they may appear unremarkable to the naked eye, close examination through a powerful microscope reveals them as tiny, human-like creatures. Each cell is meticulously designed to perform its specific role in maintaining your health and functionality, and their collaboration has created the complex organism that you are. They cannot be mastered, with the only exception being from a strong Biotinker or Biokinetic, and even then it will only be temporary. You can interact with the cells in your body, directing them as needed.

Your cells can make independent decisions and prioritize tasks based on your body's needs. For instance, in the event of an injury or infection, they will allocate more resources to the affected area to ensure quick and effective recovery. They can even take control of your unconscious body to fight in your place if required. Your cells adapt and evolve over time in response to changes in your lifestyle and environment, making you highly adaptable and resilient. No matter what type of lifestyle you lead, you will always be healthy and fit. Additionally, they can help you resist biokinetic and biotinker influences to a degree.

title: (Changer/Brute) Living Threads
description_plain: You are able to extend sinews, veins, and strands of your flesh like living threads, weaving them into weapons or tools. These threads can lash out like whips, slice through objects, or wrap around enemies to bind and crush them. The strands move as if they have a mind of their own, writhing and reaching for anything nearby. title: (Changer/Brute) Exaggerated Figure
description_plain:
Your power passively distorts your features to a cartoonish degree, amplifying both your physical appearance and abilities to superhuman extremes. You become an exaggerated, larger-than-life version of yourself, with proportions that defy natural limits. Your height is towering, your muscles are over-the-top, bulging beyond what even the most dedicated bodybuilder could achieve, yet somehow still fully functional. Every trait—whether it’s strength, beauty, or presence—is cranked up to an absurd level. You’re not just attractive; you have an almost surreal allure, with flawless skin, impossibly shiny hair, and features so symmetrical they seem drawn rather than real.

Beyond physical appearance, your human capabilities are enhanced far beyond ordinary limits. Any natural human ability you possess is greatly boosted. You are faster, stronger, and more agile than any human could naturally be. While others might be able to sprint, you could blur by at astonishing speeds, outpacing vehicles. Your strength allows you to lift objects many times your size with ease, and your reflexes are sharpened to a superhuman degree, allowing you to react instantaneously to any movement around you. However, this power doesn’t enhance learned skills—anything that relies on training or knowledge is unaffected.

If you have Holding Back then you can freely turn this power on and off.

title: (Changer/Master) Culture
description_plain:
Your body is capable of producing and harvesting parasitic lifeforms and substances within your body, depending on which part of your body they’re nested in: a parasite forming and gestating within your muscular systems develops into a root-like lifeform that infects and subsumes the host’s body keeping it to only a mass of nerves, veins, and arteries until it decays into a mass of fleshy branches; a parasite forming among your central nervous system develops a worm-like parasite with mirror neurons and nerve agents that, if a person’s infected, will slowly and surely develop and overrides the host’s brain and replace with the parasite’s, etc.

As a seedbed for these lifeforms, you can control the rate and method of infection, the symptoms your parasites produce, and their severity and lethality. However, your body’s natural limitations and the parasites’ biological nature and scope limit your control.

title: (Changer) Mutant Beast
description_plain:
You can undergo a surge of mutations, drastically reshaping your own biology for a limited time. This transformation allows you to warp your physical form in extreme and often grotesque ways—growing claws sharp enough to shred steel, converting your saliva into corrosive acid, elongating limbs, reinforcing your skin into armor-like plating, or even sprouting entirely new appendages such as wings or tails.

Each mutation grants new capabilities, increasing your raw power and adaptability in combat or survival scenarios. The extent of your transformation directly affects its potency—the fewer changes you make, the weaker and more limited the effects; the more you mutate, the stronger and more versatile your form becomes.

However, the more extensive and unnatural your changes become, the more monstrous your form appears and the harder it is to maintain control or return to your original state. Reversion begins only once you will it, but the process is slow—taking a minimum of one minute under optimal conditions, and potentially longer depending on the scale of your transformation.

Additionally, the mutations are semi-random in nature—you can choose where on your body they manifest and express a general intent for what they should become, but the specific outcome is unpredictable and may vary each time.

title: (Changer/Trump) Versatail
description_plain:
With a thought, you can extend and retract a fully functional and prehensile tail near your tailbone. This tail takes an appearance of your choosing within the realms of possibility each time you choose to manifest it, including natural weapons such as sharp spikes or even blades and stingers or additions like hands and eyes, all of which are fully functional.

The tail can reach a length equal to twice your own height and is very flexible, being able to slither slowly, coil, and grasp things with ease, while still being able to make swift twitching movements to strike.

Its physical attributes are always equal to twice your own, so if you can lift 60 kilograms with some effort, it can lift 120 kilograms with the same amount of effort; moreover, the tail is naturally as dexterous as your hands and using it comes naturally and does not get in the way, almost as if its been part of your body for your entire life.

If damaged, the tail can benefit from any regeneration you possess and will reconstitute itself when manifested again. If your tail is severed or severely injured, it will automatically retract and re-manifest in a few seconds.

However, the true strength of your tail is the fact that it can be infused with the rest of your powers—letting your tail take on the properties of the power, use aspects of it to support forms that would otherwise be impossible, or act as a complement or support for the power; for example, if you had a pyrokinetic power, your tail take on multiple forms based on your needs, such as being made of fire, super-heating the natural weapons you manifested or expelling a large amount of flames. If you had super speed, it could move at very high speeds without becoming injured, create vibro-blades on your tail, or automatically move and grab things to help keep your balance.

You can imbue up to two powers into the tail without any strain, with any more powers beyond that taking an increasing amount of stamina to maintain. You can choose how the powers are integrated.

title: (Changer/Master) Aragog
description_plain: You can transform into a giant spider made of arms with no body. The arms are covered in black fur, and break off into branches of four forearms per arm, each ending in a hand with eyes and mouths on the palm. In your changer state, you also gain a mild brute power, being able to crush cars with some effort.

title: (Changer) Human Centipede
description_plain:
You can unhinge and stretch your jaw far beyond human limits, and from within, a new torso emerges—an upper body identical to yours, slick with mucus, its lower half still anchored in your mouth. This new form retains your face and arms, but it can also open its mouth to birth another torso, and another, creating a grotesque, centipede-like chain of human forms.

As the chain extends, each successive body grows increasingly bloated and distorted, sprouting additional limbs, heads, or even alien appendages like wings or tendrils. If a torso develops multiple mouths, each one can independently generate more bodies, causing the chain to branch and spread in different directions. Every new form inherits the mutations of its predecessor, meaning that extra arms, eyes, or other abnormalities will carry forward and potentially multiply.

The result is a horrifying, ever-growing mass of fused human torsos, endlessly twisting and writhing, an extension of yourself that can spread across the battlefield like a nightmarish organism. The only limit to your growth will be your increased need for nutrients to feed all the extra bodies.

You have complete control over all the bodies, as if they were the one you were born with, allowing you to see and sense through them. You can at any moment bite off the first body you made, freeing you from the chain. The remains will then slowly starve to death, acting braindead until they finally succumb.

title: (Changer/Blaster) Swiss Army Man
description_plain: You can physically change your body into any form of weapon, other than Tinkertech. The only limitation is you cannot exceed twice the total volume of your body with the amount created. You could change your arm into an artillery piece, or you could make it into 50 smaller gun barrels, but you cannot go over twice the total volume of your arm. You can control every weapon created on your body as long as they are attached, so the 50 barrels could all point in 50 different directions and could move around as you desired. Any ammunition fired is created by the power and uses no body mass.

title: (Changer/Master) Reefshell
description_plain:
Your body now plays host to a supernatural reef system, the colony’s mass having buried itself into your skull and upper spine, replacing much of your neural matter and a good portion of the nervous system. This coral grows beneath your skin in iridescent, jagged plates akin to fish scales, often secreting cloudy mucus within the layers of your dermis. Its only external growths hide within the depths of your hair, spines to a crown wreathed in skin and bone.

Feeding off of your neurological impulses and ambient bioelectricity, it reproduces through the creation of mutant growths that harmlessly force pores of your skin wide open in their wake. These growths are similar in appearance to most underwater organisms such as fishes, lamprey, and squids, but possess your features within them. Tentacles with contracted skin like joints existed inside, terminating in human nails; fish mouths with human teeth and scales of their own half-peeled from growing hair beneath, revealing raw, pulsating muscle.

When you wish it so, you may detach these growths from your skin, letting them come alive as though the air served as water to them. They swim, writhe and twitch with their broken, half-limp bodies attacking those you deem targets with attempted-human behavior. Smiling, crying, expressing emotion that they cannot comprehend. Some explode into splinters of calcium and paralytics, others latch on to release coral growth like roots, embedding living coral into flesh, attempting to grow - expect most of your spawn to display such self-destructive behaviors.

title: (Changer) “Dragonfly”
description_plain:
“It seems your Shard heavily misunderstood what a dragonfly was…”

Your Changer state takes the form of a three-meter-long insect vaguely shaped like a dragon, its body composed of segmented, metallic-black chitin that gleams with green and bronze iridescence. Four translucent wings extend from your back, each twice your body length, capable of vibrating with such speed that they blur into a faint, shimmering halo when in motion. Your limbs are long and multi-jointed, ending in hooked claws suited for grasping and clinging, while a tapered, flexible tail balances your form in flight. Vast compound eyes dominate your face, and a narrow proboscis extends beneath them.

Your compound eyes provide near-total panoramic vision, allowing you to perceive motion in every direction simultaneously. Each of the thousands of lenses forming your eyes contributes to a multifaceted image of the world, giving you a flawless sense of depth and movement. You see not only in visible light but also in ultraviolet and polarized spectrums, allowing you to distinguish subtle heat traces, reflections, and optical illusions that would fool human senses. This constant flow of information feeds into your reflexes, enabling you to react before an opponent can consciously complete a motion.

Your exoskeleton also serves as a sensitive pressure array. Air vibrations, footsteps, even the shifting of air currents register across your chitin plates, creating an awareness of nearby movement independent of sight or sound. Your antennae and facial sensors provide olfactory and chemical detection far beyond human capacity; you can identify creatures by scent, detect emotional hormones, and trace toxins or specific individuals through faint airborne residues.

Behind your wings lie a pair of small, stalked halteres; gyroscopic balance organs that keep you perfectly oriented in flight. You are capable of abrupt turns, hovering, and split-second reversals of direction without losing stability. Your wings produce immense thrust and can accelerate you from rest to full speed in an instant, while adhesive pads and microscopic hooks on your claws allow you to cling effortlessly to walls, ceilings, or smooth surfaces.

Your exoskeleton can shed damaged outer layers through rapid molting, allowing you to regenerate new chitin plates within minutes. The process releases a faint organic dust as residue. The internal structure beneath is supported by dense, pressurized hemolymph, granting your limbs hydraulic strength disproportionate to your size. Every strike, leap, or wingbeat carries immense force, driven by the conversion of internal fluid pressure into kinetic output.

Your voice in this form is produced not by a throat but through micro-adjustments in your wingbeats. The vibrations can mimic speech, though always layered with the insectile undertone of buzzing resonance. A similar misinterpretation from your Shard produced your most striking feature: an enzymic exhalation that superficially resembles dragonfire. In practice, this is a spray of corrosive digestive fluid expelled from your proboscis, capable of rapidly liquefying organic material. It burns and smokes on contact, creating the illusion of fire while remaining entirely chemical in nature.

title: (Changer/Trump) It's a me, a Mario!
description_plain:
You have a number of forms you can transform into at will, based on the Mario power-ups. Each power-up has a cooldown that begins after your power-up runs out. The more powerful a power-up, the longer it is until you can get another one. A typical mushroom has a cooldown of about 15 minutes, a fire flower has a cooldown of an hour, an invincibility star has a cooldown of a week, a mega mushroom has a cooldown of a month, and a one-up has a cooldown of a year.
This also grants you the ability to jump really high, ground-pound, break bricks with your fists, and great skill with hammers.

title: (Changer/Striker) Amalgam
description_plain: With a touch, you can fuse with any living being. This fusion has all its component's skills, powers, and abilities. All minds within the fusion are combined equally, including yours, and physical traits represent a mix of everyone involved. You may fuse as many times as you want, and the fusion may decide to eject members or unfuse entirely at will.

title: (Changer/Brute) Stitch Blanket
description_plain:
You can transform into a blanket made from the fabrics you have absorbed. Your material can shift and change, allowing you to mix and match different fabrics, but the total amount you can create is limited to no more than ten times what you originally absorbed. You cannot absorb torn off parts of your body. In addition to changing your composition, you can also reshape your form, giving yourself structure and definition. This allows you to take on a more muppet-like appearance with features and limbs, rather than remaining a simple flat blanket.

Your blanket form possesses heightened strength and durability, far beyond what ordinary fabric would have. You can withstand significant force without tearing, and if you are damaged, you can regenerate by quickly stitching yourself back together.

title: (Changer/Trump) Slime
description_plain:
You can turn into a slime, a creature made of semi-solid acid that can turn into liquid with a thought. The acid is very corrosive. You can also transform your shape, though your color, texture, and consistency will remain unchanged. You can change your color by resting in food coloring for a few hours, but your texture and consistency cannot be changed through mundane means.

You can absorb mundane objects to gain minor powers from them. Absorbing more of that object, or similar objects, will strengthen that power, or gain a new power from that object, e.g., absorbing calculators would increase your ability at math, absorbing bleach may allow you to remove the color from objects, absorbing water may allow you to dilute chemicals, absorbing plants may allow you to absorb energy from the sun, and candy may allow you to give yourself short bursts of energy. You can only have 30 of these powers active at once.

title: (Changer/Brute) Transhuman
description_plain:
You can regenerate far faster than any human—capable of regrowing a lost arm in just under an hour. However, you no longer regenerate flesh and blood. Instead, the missing part is replaced by cybernetic machinery. These mechanical replacements mimic the function of the original limb or organ, but each comes with extra features. The catch? You have no control over what these features are, be careful when testing your functions.

This process of cybernetic transformation isn't limited to injuries. Your body’s natural cycle of cellular death and renewal means that, over time, even undamaged flesh will be gradually replaced by cybernetics.

Any powers or abilities you already possess treat your mechanical parts as your body, even granting it regeneration. If a cybernetic limb or organ is damaged or destroyed, it will regenerate stronger and/or more versatile.

title: (Changer/Trump) Tentacled One
description_plain:
You can summon up to eight tentacles from your back — their overall location and baseline design are up to you, like sharp segmented crystals coming from between your shoulders, a crack in your waist that releases a inky-black substance, plain old octopus tentacles, or something else — whose maximum baseline length is 10 meters. Their overall functionality depends on their design, such as a mechanical tentacle being more durable than a ink one, but they all have the strength to shatter concrete and your senses extend through them, albeit duller — unless they have the appropriate equipment, such as eyes. Besides their length, you can also control their thickness anywhere between their base and super thin.

The durability and strength of your tentacles scales with that of your arms. Your dexterity and flexibility likewise benefit from the same.

title: (Changer/Master) Big Baby
description_plain:
You can generate and control a swarm of massive, grotesque infants connected to you by thick, sinewy umbilical cords. The cords are around 10 meters long, making that your effective range. These babies act as your limbs, lifting and moving you, manipulating objects, and overwhelming enemies with sheer numbers. Each one possesses unnatural strength and durability, making them as effective as monstrous hands and feet. Their immense strength lets them grasp and pin down even the most powerful foes, and their bloated, rubbery flesh absorbs impacts like living armor.

When your brood fully envelops a target, their combined strength begins an exponential crushing process. The moment at least three-quarters of a victim’s body is buried beneath the writhing mass, the force exerted upon them doubles every second, escalating until only indestructible remnants remain. If the victim manages to break free, even for a moment, the compounding force resets, requiring them to be fully trapped once more before the destruction resumes. Within moments, bodies are reduced to pulp, and within minutes, even metals and stone are ground into fine dust under the multiplying pressure.

title: (Changer) Flerken
description_plain:
You are able to open your mouth to immense sizes, allowing you to consume both objects or living beings with the help of tentacles within your maw. These tentacles grasp and pull anything within reach, ensuring nothing escapes your grasp. Your stomach also has changed, essentially becoming a personal pocket dimension, vastly exceeding the normal limitations of physical storage. You can consume anything no bigger than 5 times your size and/or weight.

This pocket dimension offers you complete control over what happens to the consumed items or creatures. You can choose to break them down for sustenance, converting them into nutrients to sustain yourself. Alternatively, you may place them into a stasis space, where time ceases to pass, preserving them indefinitely. This stasis can be used to isolate a single entity or even group multiple beings together, creating a suspended environment within your control.

Moreover, this power is not limited to mere storage. You have the ability to reverse the process, launching anything placed in the stasis space back out through your mouth with precision and force. In other words you can projectile vomit anything in your storage.

title: (Changer) Self-Biokinesis
description_plain:
You have total control over your internal biology and appearance, allowing you to alter your form at will. You are able to restructure your body into any possible biological expression—whether subtle adjustments like shifting facial features or extreme modifications like reshaping an arm into a snake while keeping it functional. Your power automatically resolves any conflicts between different biological structures, making sure that they work seamlessly.

Your control is limited to your own biomass; you can only reshape what mass you already have. Dead biological material, such as shed skin cells, hair, or nails, is no longer considered part of your body and cannot be manipulated. Similarly, body parts that are severed or otherwise detached from you can no longer be controlled or transformed.

You passively maintain a low-level awareness of your entire biology, allowing you to instinctively detect changes or issues. You can focus this awareness for greater detail when needed.

This can theoretically remove Case 53 mutations, but only if you alter your Corona Pollentia and Corona Gemma so they no longer restore your original mutated form, which if done incorrectly can result in worse outcomes.

title: (Changer) Kevin
description_plain:
By touching any specific material, you can transform your body into that substance while retaining essential human traits, such as motion and flexibility. For instance, by touching concrete, you gain its durability without sacrificing your ability to move, becoming a living fortress of stone. The transformation process is versatile, allowing you to mix and match different materials across your body, creating a patchwork of strengths. The transformation always begins with the part of your body in contact with the material.

Your power extends beyond inorganic substances—you can touch living beings and adopt their biological traits. By copying the physiology of others, you can enhance your physical abilities, such as gaining the agility of a feline or the resilience of a highly adapted creature. This even works on parahumans, allowing you to temporarily mimic their corona potentia, the key to their powers. However, while you can copy their abilities, the replication is never quite as effective as the original, producing a diluted version of the power. You can gain partial access to their abilities but cannot reach their full potential, and the borrowed power may have quirks or limitations that the original user does not face.

title: (Changer/Master) Bowser
description_plain:
You can transform into a bipedal Anklyosaurus that can breathe fire. You're moderately more durable and powerful than an actual historical Anklyosaurus, and you can regenerate at a moderate pace. You can also jump 30 meters into the air (~100 feet), break stones with ease, and order legions of summonable minions of varying abilities to do your bidding. They are loyal to you, but they hold their own wills, so they won't blindly obey all your orders.

Your insides are also filled with loyal, intelligent minions. If you swallow someone whole, they'll be transported into your gut, where they can help or hinder you in various ways, though your internal minions will fight against anyone that tries to harm you.

Some of the effects that can be activated from your inside include growing to be multiple times larger than Behemoth (and making you the strongest Brute recorded by a significant margin), overclocking any of your abilities (including non-super ones), controlling your body (in a very jittery manner), altering your digestion, putting you to sleep, waking you up, and resuscitating you.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Third Eye
description_plain:
You can see the supernatural: you can visually identify areas/objects/people being affected by parahuman powers (Glory Girl’s awe/fear aura, telekinetically controlled objects, a person with a passive Brute power, power generated material like Kaiser’s blades, areas under Thinker observation, etc.) as a “buzzing glow” around the affected area/object.

You can't distinguish what the powers are doing, just that they exist and the boundaries of them. You can, however, recognize and identify each unique effect to the point that you can tell the difference between two different overlapping or identical-looking effects, i.e., if there were two overlapping Shaker auras, you’d be able to tell where one ends and the other begins, as well as recognize one of those Shaker auras from having seen it elsewhere earlier.

This sight can't identify normal tinkertech or its effects, as they are not by default under the effect of any parahuman powers.

title: (Trump) Conviction
description_plain:
“Fill thy hollow fist with the Will to Protect; this power is called Conviction.”

Your strength is drawn from your beliefs, your emotions fueling both your body and any powers you wield. When acting in a way that aligns with your ideals—whether noble or selfish—you receive a significant boost, pushing past normal human limits. A hero fighting for others, a warrior chasing revenge, or even someone driven by sheer pride can all tap into this power. So long as you hold to your convictions with absolute certainty, they will strengthen you. This enhancement isn’t just a vague feeling—it translates into faster strikes, greater endurance, and an almost unshakable resilience as long as your resolve holds firm.

Beyond that, you can directly channel your emotions into your attacks, weaponising your determination, anger, or even sorrow to enhance your power. A punch thrown in fury might hit with the force of a sledgehammer, while a desperate last stand could grant you the endurance to keep fighting long past exhaustion. If you possess other abilities, this emotional drive amplifies them as well, making your flames burn hotter, your barriers more unyielding, or your speed nearly untouchable.

However, this strength is not without its limits. If your faith in your ideals wavers or your emotions are clouded by doubt, the boost weakens. Blind rage or reckless passion may grant power, but without direction, it can be wild and inefficient. To wield this ability effectively, you must understand yourself—what you stand for, what drives you—and be willing to commit to it fully. The greater your conviction, the greater your strength.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Hunters Mark
description_plain:
You have the ability to apply a Mark to anyone within your line of sight. You can only have one Mark applied, which can last for at most 8 hours. If you succeed in killing your Marked target, the Mark can be applied to someone else immediately, but if you fail, it has a "cooldown" of 4 hours until you can apply it again.

This Mark has multiple effects designed around enhancing your ability to hunt and kill your target. To better hunt a target who may run, you have the ability to sense the general direction and distance of your target. To better hunt a target who may hide, you have enhanced senses when searching for your target and are more resistant to Stranger effects that benefit your target. Lastly, to better kill a target who is strong, any attack you make against your target is 25% more effective.

title: (Trump) David’s Trash Can
description_plain:
You have a much, much weaker expression of Eidolon’s own Trump Power; this turns you into a facsimile of one of the most famous Trumps Earth Bet has ever seen, albeit a depressingly weak one.

You have a mental catalog containing all of the Tier 0 powers found in this CYOA, and from this catalog, you can manifest up to 10 Tier 0 powers at a time. It takes a minute to load a lesser power from this catalog; you can manifest multiple powers at once.

You can also create new Tier 0 powers not found in this CYOA and add them to your mental catalog. Each power takes 5 minutes to create, and you can only make one at a time.

You do trigger any addons between the CYOA’s Tier 0 powers, but you cannot make new addons between Tier 0 powers.

title: (Trump) Resistance Increase
description_plain:
Powers used against you will only deal half the damage they should normally do. Power-based flamethrowers will do less damage than normal flamethrowers. Resistance Increase also protects you from various forms of instant death, reality warping, and all forms of strange and esoteric effects. While it doesn't fully negate it, it makes it so it has less effect on you. To the point, you would survive a power that would normally kill you in an instant but only barely.

This can apply to Stranger, Trump, and Master powers as well. Although this power is less effective against All-or-Nothings.

title: (Trump) Jekyll and Hyde
description_plain:
You possess two distinct operational states, each enhancing a different domain of your being: one of intellect, the other of brute force. You must always be in either one or the other.

Jekyll mode is a transformation of the mind. Upon entering this state, you acquire a Thinker rating, and with it, the shackles of mental fatigue are utterly removed. Sleep deprivation, information overload, burnout—none of these apply to you anymore. Every facet of cognition—logic, empathy, memory, creativity—is elevated to the brink of parahuman ability, each function reinforcing the others in a seamless, ever-efficient mental engine.

However, in this mode your brain never stops. You’re always analyzing, always thinking, from running background calculations, deconstructing conversations in real-time, or making subconscious connections between seemingly unrelated data, your mind refuses to idle. This perpetual mental overclocking risks pulling you inward, the world can start to feel distant as your focus narrows, or worse—your thoughts spiral endlessly, looping in increasingly complex patterns you can’t quite shut down.

Hyde mode, by contrast, shifts all emphasis to the body. Here, you gain a Brute rating. Physical exhaustion ceases to exist as a concept; stamina becomes effectively limitless. Every biological function related to movement, strength, speed, and durability is elevated to the edge of parahuman capability. Muscles coil with explosive power, bones and sinew harden, reflexes sharpen to an almost predatory level.

The downside, however, is that your emotional regulation, empathy, strategic patience are cast aside. Your brain deliberately minimizes functions that don’t directly support immediate combat. You become driven by simple directives: fight, overpower, survive. Finesse and technique are deprioritized in favor of overwhelming power and instinctual aggression.

Note that this isn’t a case of dual personalities. You don’t become someone else. Rather, each mode reshapes your priorities and mental frameworks to better suit the context—intellectual or physical. If you possess Holding Back, you are granted a third option: to return to your baseline self, operating outside either mode. Otherwise, you must always exist as either the brilliant mind of Jekyll or the unstoppable force of Hyde.

title: (Trump) Secondary
description_plain:
You can copy permanently on touch, but you only gain the secondary powers of your targets. Secondary in this context means anything that isn’t part of the main powerset and wouldn’t by itself be categorized as a power, however, this doesn’t include things that are dependent on the power itself like power senses. Examples would be Brandish’s resistance to blinding lights, Glory Girls throws having more speed and force than they should, as well as not getting dizzy from high speed maneuvers and Aegis capability to deal with pain.

Capes whose powerset have several secondary powers to copy have more rules. With Circus as an example, it would be possible to copy all of their powers except for their pyrokinesis and storage space as they’re only enhancing something that you already possess, but you’d get much weaker versions at peak human level instead of superhuman and you could only copy them one at a time with a week long cooldown after each acquisition.

Parahumans that don’t have copyable secondary powers still grant benefits by improving the next secondary power you copy, giving it slightly more oomph. If you copy enough similar powers they can develop into a proper parahuman power, like spatial sense allowing you to perceive your surroundings even with your eyes closed.

title: (Trump) Get Here To Me!
description_plain:
You can redirect the effects and expressions of other powers away from their intended targets and onto yourself or something directly connected to you.

Whenever a power attempts to affect another valid target, you may forcibly alter its destination. Attacks, enhancements, sensory effects, movement powers, spatial distortions, status effects, summons, bindings, transmissions, or other manifestations can be rerouted so that they instead affect you, an object you possess, an area you occupy, or another target meaningfully associated with you.

This does not negate the power or weaken its effect. The expression occurs normally, only with its destination forcibly rewritten.

The redirection must remain broadly compatible with the original effect. A power targeting minds cannot be redirected into a wall unless that wall possesses a valid mental component, while a spatial effect aimed at a city block may instead be centered on your immediate surroundings.

Power effects redirected toward you are treated as willingly accepted for the purpose of hostile resistance, defensive rejection, or automatic countermeasures. This does not guarantee safety, merely successful transfer.

You cannot directly force powers to target completely unrelated destinations. The effect must always resolve onto you or something sufficiently tied to you through possession, proximity, ownership, influence, or direct association.

title: (Trump) Spark
description_plain:
With a single touch, you can grant someone a temporary superpower by forcing them to briefly experience an alternative version of their life where they underwent a trigger event. For one minute, they gain the power they would have developed in that alternate timeline and can use it as if it were their own.

This effect doesn’t depend on whether the person could actually trigger in the real world—if they can’t, the timeline you draw from adjusts reality just enough to create one where they could.

You don’t choose the power, and neither does the person receiving it. The only guarantee is that, for one minute, they become who they could have been—had things gone differently.

Each time you use your power on the same person, the result changes. You don’t pull from the same timeline twice. The trigger event you connect them to may be slightly different, wildly altered, or even completely unrelated to the previous one. As a result, the power they receive can shift in small ways—or change entirely—depending on which version of their alternate timeline you reach into.

If the person already has powers, the temporary one is added on top of their original set. These additions are usually synergistic, as both abilities come from the same shard.

title: (Trump) Limit Break
description_plain: It is possible to amplify your powers by pushing it past their limits, making them more potent and effective. However, doing so comes with significant consequences. As you continue to push your powers to greater heights, you will experience increased physical strain and pain. This could result in permanent damage to your body, making it more difficult to maintain and control your abilities. The increase in power is temporary, and it is recommended to not regularly use this power as the strain can kill you.

title: (Trump) "Panacea"
description_plain:
Your blood is now pitch-black and serves as a universal panacea for nearly every ailment. It purifies the body of viruses, purges toxins, cures cancer, reverses aging, restores lost limbs, and even physically cures Case 53s. However, these properties are only applicable after your blood leaves your body and is ingested. You can control the texture, taste, and density of your blood, with diluted versions have weaker healing effects. Regardless of the exact taste, your blood feels refreshing to drink, like an energy drink after a workout. You have an absurd regeneration rate for blood, allowing for you to be drained near endlessly.

Your flesh is also similarly "empowered." Consuming your flesh grants a qualitative improvement in every physical aspect, restoring individuals to the prime of their youth and permanently halting aging. Repeated consumption can grant a weak healing factor and turn the person into a low-level brute, though this caps out after a while. You don't have an inherent regeneration factor for your flesh.

You can consume both your blood and flesh to get the effects.

Good luck!

title: (Trump) The Imaginary Trump
description_plain:

You know the names of those being affected and what information they possess, and you can selectively exempt others from your power.

Powers that work specifically by damaging parts of your body via unknown means will instead heal you. All or Nothing powers will instead be nullified and not do anything.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Empowerment Conduit
description_plain:
You are a prime conduit for Type Two Trumps, namely those that can grant/partner/bond powers to others, as well as capes who can typically only grant powers to animals. When you become the focus of such capes, their power will be much more effective on you, this can manifest in various ways, whether in temporary powers lasting longer, powers carrying more potency, the Trump having more control over what kind of powers you’re granted or being an acceptable target for capes whose powers can typically only affect specific animals.

The effects of these empowerment will increase steadily with repeated exposure, improving in potency after each bestowal, though this won’t override any inbuilt power limitations and maxes out at double of the norm in each parameter. A cape whose granted powers typically last up to 5 minutes won’t have their powers last beyond 10 for you, no matter how often they empower you, things like power, range and control will likewise be capable of improving until they hit that limit.

This only partially protects you from the drawbacks that some of these empowerments come with, mainly by preventing you from being injured, permanently mentally or physically unbalanced or killed by your granted powers via enforcing the Manton-limit. Though this would not prevent any Mastering done by power granters.

To find these Type Two Trumps you’ve also got a Thinker sense for them, having a very general sense for their location in a city-wide radius and becoming more and more aware of their exact position and state the more often you’re empowered by them.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Endless Dream
description_plain:
You are able to enter a nightmare realm whenever you sleep. In this place, you can’t truly die, but every time you do, it still feels real—pain and all. Time flows differently here: while only a day passes in the real world, an entire year slips by in the nightmare realm. In other words, the time in the nightmare realm is 365 times longer than the real world.

Every day you spend the nightmare realm builds up a charge, and after a full year in the nightmare realm’s time, you can use the accumulated charge to step into someone else’s dreams. The target doesn’t need to be near your body, as long as you know their name or place of residence you can enter their dreams. You can even place certain requirements, such as “has heroic inclination” and enter a random dream that meets the requirements.

Inside their dream, you can grant the dreamer a power based on their dream. The more accumulated charge you have, the more powerful the ability, with a year worth of charge allowing you to make 3 SP powers, reaching up to a maximum of 15 SP with 5 years worth of charge (which in reality would be 5 days of constant sleep). You cannot use this to grant yourself powers—this ability only works for others.

Those you bless with powers will occasionally catch glimpses of the nightmare realm through your eyes when they sleep. They might even experience some of your memories from your time trapped in that world, whether they want to or not.

title: (Trump) Consumables
description_plain:
Your body now processes all consumables as if they were items in a game, granting temporary bonus effects beyond their usual properties. A well-prepared meal might grant a boost to endurance or slow health regeneration, an energy drink could enhance speed or increase stamina regeneration, and potent drugs could heighten reflexes, increase strength, or sharpen mental focus.

However, these benefits are strictly temporary, lasting only as long as the inherent potency of the consumed item allows. The better the quality of the food or substance, the stronger and longer-lasting the effect. A gourmet dish made from high-quality ingredients might provide significant recovery and stat bonuses, while hastily prepared or low-quality food may only offer minor boosts.

This also does not negate the natural consequences of consumption. While a high-energy snack might give a burst of stamina, overeating can still cause discomfort, and toxins or harmful substances will still affect your body. Drugs will still damage internal organs, alcohol will still impair judgment, and excessive stimulant use can still lead to crashes or addiction. Your body may benefit from these temporary enhancements, but you are not immune to their long-term consequences.

This ability is passive and activates on all things you eat.

title: (Trump/Striker) Gatekeeper
description_plain: When you touch a person, you can give their power a single-use trigger that decides when and how their power will go off. The owner of the power is unable to use their power until the trigger activates. This trigger can be anything, such as a simple timer, a speech-activated phrase, or even a complicated computer program, though any information it acts on will be based on what the owner of the power can perceive. There is no limit on how long a trigger can last until it activates, nor a limit on how many people can have a trigger at once, though a single person can only have one trigger at a time. Durational effects can last up to an hour, and cannot change what they are doing once activated, but are unable to be dismissed by the owner of the power.

title: (Trump) Future Figures
description_plain:
You possess the ability to temporarily drain resources from your future self, drawing on strength, vitality, or even intelligence from a point in your timeline yet to come. For instance, if you are injured, you can tap into your future vitality to heal instantly, recovering from wounds as if they had never occurred. However, this power is balanced by a cost: at an unpredictable moment in the future, the vitality you borrowed will be withdrawn, causing you to experience a temporary loss of life force, leading to sudden fatigue or injury. The same principle applies to other attributes—if you drain strength, you may gain a temporary boost now, but you will face a period of temporary weakness later on.

This ability isn’t limited to physical traits; you can also siphon knowledge, skills, or even mental sharpness from your future self, giving you a temporary edge in the present. However, this leaves your future self vulnerable to a temporary decline in those same areas. If you have other powers, you can even drain those temporarily from your future self, amplifying your current abilities at the expense of a weaker or less capable version of yourself down the line. Every drain is temporary, meaning the boost you gain now will eventually give way to a temporary drain in the future, ensuring that balance is maintained across time.

If you possess the perk Holding Back, you can designate a specific time for when the drain will occur, allowing you to prepare for its effects. You could even choose to spread it out over multiple instances.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Tuning Field
description_plain:
You have a 100-meter field around you in which you can sense a variety of particle movements, wavelengths, and chemical reactions. Your power automatically filters out the useless information and focuses primarily on enemy movements and parahuman-generated effects. The closer an effect is to you, the greater detail you can perceive it in.

If you perceive an effect for enough time, you can begin to reverse-engineer its composition. You have a secondary Thinker power which allows you to understand how to find flaws inside these compositions, and you can alter a secondary field around your body to the exact makeup to counter any effects.

This means that the longer an effect is used on/near you, the less effective it is against you until you become immune to it completely. More complex abilities take longer to adapt to, up to several hours for the most complex. Absolute abilities, such as Sting, cannot be adapted to.

These effects don't have to be parahuman in nature. For example, you could tune in to be immune to a normal flamethrower.

Your resistance works on the core mechanics of the powers themselves, so if you encounter a power that works on similar principles to one you are already immune to, you will likely have resistance to the ability.

Furthermore, your understanding of the inner workings of parahuman abilities makes you an expert on their exact usage and function. You can find new and creative applications of almost any power you encounter, as well as identify niche weaknesses that the user wouldn't ever normally encounter. For example, you might find out the true use of Parian's power within a couple of minutes of being around her while she uses the ability.

If you have any other powers/abilities, you can alter them to work more effectively against specific parahuman effects that you have tuned to without reducing their power.

title: (Trump) Quest
description_plain:
You can give yourself quests, which function as self-imposed challenges. Completing these quests grants you rewards, usually in the form of growth, skill improvement, or improvements of any abilities you have. The difficulty of the quest determines the quality of the reward—trivial tasks provide little to no benefit, while significant challenges yield meaningful enhancements. You can have up to five active quests at a time, each with its own objective and potential reward.

While you can create repeatable quests, the rewards scale accordingly. Repeating simple actions, like taking steps, will offer minimal to no benefit, but sustained effort toward meaningful goals—such as practicing a skill for a set amount of time—will grant better rewards. The nature of the rewards aligns with the quest completed.

You can abandon or replace quests at any time.
