title: (Trump) Deck of Cards
description_plain:
You manifest a shuffling deck of cards. From this deck, you may draw a single card at random. The suit and value of the card determine the nature and magnitude of its effect. Numbered cards range from 2 (the weakest) to 10, followed by face cards—Jack, Queen, and King—each stronger than the last. At the pinnacle of power is the Ace, representing the highest possible effect. Each suit corresponds to a unique type of effect.

Heart cards heal. A low draw, such as the 2 of Hearts, will seal cuts, mend bruises, or soothe minor injuries. But at the pinnacle of its power, the Ace of Hearts can reverse death—provided the target has been dead for less than a minute—restoring them not just to life, but to their absolute physical and mental prime.

Club cards manifest physical matter. A 2 of Clubs might generate a mundane object—like a pen, a rope, or a metal cup—nothing more complex or large than a common spoon. But the Ace of Clubs can conjure items such as a nanothorn.

Diamond cards serve as defense. A 2 of Diamonds might toughen the skin, rendering it leathery and resistant to cuts and minor trauma. An Ace of Diamonds offers a single moment of absolute invulnerability—a defense capable of withstanding even a stilling blast.

Spade cards embody offense. A 2 of Spades delivers a blow equal in force to a standard human punch. An Ace of Spades can shoot an attack on par with a full-force blow from Alexandria herself.

In addition to the 52 standard cards, the deck includes two Jokers. When drawn, a Joker can mimic the effect of any card in the deck—any suit of choice at a random value.

Drawing a card does not activate it. Instead, the card is added to your hand—your personal collection of drawn cards, visible only to you. You may continue drawing until your hand contains five cards, at which point it becomes full. Once your hand is full, you may activate the cards in any order you choose. Effects are instant and last for only a short while. Only after all five cards have been played or discarded can you begin drawing again.

Additionally, the combination of cards in your hand—your “hand strength”—can enhance the effects of individual cards. A weak card like the 3 of Spades may hit harder if it’s part of a flush or a straight. A 7 of Hearts may heal like a 10 if it completes a full house. The better the hand you hold, the stronger each card within it becomes.

title: (Trump) Human Resources
description_plain:
You mark someone by touching them. However, an unwilling target can break free of it later through sheer willpower, which takes exceptional mental strength and resolve. You can also voluntarily remove a mark anytime you choose.

Once marked, every person generates their own separate well of energy that represents their total capabilities: their strength, speed, intelligence, skills, stamina, everything they are. You can freely drain energy from any marked person's well and grant it to another, weakening the source and strengthening the recipient by the exact amount taken. The transfer is proportional: if you drain half of someone's total ability and give it to someone else, the recipient gains that full half on top of their own baseline. You can stack from multiple sources, so draining half from two different people and giving both halves to one target makes that target a composite of their original self plus the two halves.

If a marked person dies, their well doesn't vanish, it becomes permanently available to you with no living owner attached. You can drain it completely with no downside since there's no one left to weaken.

title: (Trump) Wordsmith
description_plain:
You can detect nearby Parahumans and receive a one-word generalization of their powers in a language you know — as an example: Statue, Flight, and Smart for Alexandria.

Within 5 meters you can also edit their powers through altering the description of it — although you are limited to three edits per Parahuman, and the result must be a valid word. The edit may do one of the following: add (Any -> Many), remove (Flight -> Light), substitute (Statue -> Status), or swap characters. You may also revert your edits.

title: (Trump) Cultivation
description_plain:
You gain the power to cultivate.

This can be applied to plants, as well as animals and people. You can cultivate specific traits and abilities in others or even yourself, encouraging and directing development in any biological system. While you don't have full control, your ability makes a significant impact, especially when your target is younger, thus more flexible to change. However, the rate of growth lowers over time and as the target ages. Cultivation isn't immediate, usually requiring weeks to months to develop a specific trait. The more specific the trait, the faster you can develop it.

Few examples of your capabilities are cultivating traits such as Confidence, Leadership, and Willpower, or boosting your target's biological attributes like Strength, Speed and Endurance to greatly surpass human limits. You can also use this power on yourself.

title: (Trump) Trophy Hunter
description_plain:
You can now empower the remains of living creatures into "trophies", that, when worn, modify at least one of your other powers based upon the abilities, identity and general danger of whatever your trophy came from.

So long as the trophy is a major part of a worn item (i.e. a wolf tooth necklace or a bull leather jacket), it will boost your other powers thematically; parts from a wolf might twist your powers to be better at coordination with others or, failing that, to be more aggressive; a bull's may boost the maximum amount of force you can take with your Brute powers, or give you a greater resistance to the backlash/cost of your other powers; a trophy made from a capes body may flavour your powers with elements of theirs, granting new capabilities or simply boosting where they overlap. If worse comes to worst and you simply have nothing that can thematically relate to the trophy, then it will grant you a decent standalone passive power based on the source instead (that can then be modified by your other trophies).

The size and integrity of the trophy has a logarithmic impact on the amount that it will boost you: a single hair as a trophy would pale in comparison to a leather garment, and a freshly skinned bodysuit would provide incredible benefits to your other powers. Wearing multiple trophies from the same or similar sources counts as a single trophy of their combined sizes.

title: (Trump) Hyperfocused
description_plain:
You can now choose to temporarily weaken one or more of your other powers to redistribute its strength out to any number of different powers, being able to choose roughly how much strength to take and give to/from each ability of yours.

The amount that one power boosts another is based upon the overall relative strength of the powers: Gifting 100% of a T0 power's strength to a paragon power would result in a nigh unnoticeable increase; while gifting even 1% of a paragon power to a T0 would result in an incredible boost.

The boost works based upon the power's concept, focusing on improving based upon emphasising its themes and strengths. If a pyrokinetic power is focused on the high intensity of its fire, most of the boost will go towards increasing that intensity further; if a Master power is focused on its range and control of many minions, then this power would focus on improving that range and, if it's control is already absolute, potentially even introducing thematically related ways to allow you to capture/create more minions; etc.

title: (Trump) Daimon
description_plain:
You can draw from the powers of Parahumans around you. This happens because within a 30-meter radius, you slowly draw [Energy] and copy [Data] from their Shards. Now, Shards are rather stingy with these so the higher yours is ranked the more and quicker you gain.

Through this ability, you can summon powers from these Shards, the strength, quality, and duration of which are all based on those you've drawn from. In the instant you choose to use your stored [Energy] and [Data], your power simulates a Trigger giving you a power for however long you have stored [Energy]. Stronger powers use up [Energy] quickly while weaker powers can last quite some time.

This manifestation, nevertheless, is not without limits; you can only keep up to three powers at a time. Even though discarding a power can allow you to save up [Energy] and [Data], the next time you draw from that stored [Energy] you'll manifest a new power altogether.

(If you have a Normal Shard, Shards will only send largely junk [Data] at a rate that would take 1 hour to retrieve the equivalent of 1 SP and enough [Energy] for 1 minute of a weak power. If you have a Vital Shard, Shards will only send partial junk [Data] at a rate that would take 20 minutes to retrieve the equivalent of 1 SP and enough [Energy] for 3 minutes of a weak power. If you have a Noble Shard, then Shards will never send junk [Data] at a rate that would take 5 minutes to retrieve the equivalent of 1 SP and enough [Energy] for 5 minutes of a weak power.)

title: (Trump) Third-Rate Tohu
description_plain:
You can manifest up to three replica powersets, each one being derived from any parahuman to have existed, whether past or present.

Your simulated powersets are capped at being up to 4 SP in overall potency. Your copied versions will either be weaker than, or on par with, their real life counterparts, but cannot exceed the original. You could combine Legend, Purity and Raymancer to emit searing blasts or blend Imp, Mantellum and Blindside into an elusive Stranger effect.

For example, you might select Eidolon and gain a lesser version of his ability to manifest multiple semi-random powers. Each of these powers would be proportionally weak, however, no more than 1-2 SP in strength. Alternatively, choose Shadow Stalker and you could mimic her full powerset with no handicap.

You cannot select yourself and are limited to one powerset per parahuman at a time, preventing duplicates. It is possible to partially circumvent this by using parahumans such as Glaistig Uaine and the like. It takes a minute to select and 'lock-in' a powerset before it's usable, but you can dismiss and switch out at will.

When mentally searching for a parahuman to mimic, you instinctively sense compatible powersets aligned with your intent. This intuition also provides a baseline understanding of each powerset’s capabilities, mechanisms and limits, but offers you no extra skill, experience or mastery.

description_plain:

title: (Trump) Training Montage
description_plain:
You are able to train and create 3 SP powers derived directly from your efforts. There is no limit to the number of powers you can accumulate, and they automatically synergize, enhancing each other seamlessly. The powers you develop are intimately tied to the specific training you undertake.

For example, rigorous physical conditioning might unlock a power that significantly boosts your strength or stamina, while intensive reflex drills could grant you a power that enhances your reaction time to superhuman levels. You are limited to powers that can be expressed physically such as regeneration, super strength, and enhanced senses, with most powers being passive powers. The process is intuitive—you simply decide the type of power you wish to acquire, and the necessary training regimen immediately materializes in your mind.

To make a power reach 3 SP will take at least a month. This can be used to enhance other powers you have to a limited degree, including those gained from this power, increasing it by 1 SP at best after a month.

title: (Trump/Striker) X Type Trigger
description_plain:
You gain the ability to trigger potential parahumans with a power from your selected power classification with a touch. This power can’t be used on beings who have already been triggered with a parahuman power.

With the first purchase, you can select a single type of power except the Trump category. On the second purchase, you can select two more categories on the top of your first, or the Trump power category. On the final third purchase, you will gain all twelve power categories, making you an Omni Type Trigger.

You can only use this once per being unless they somehow permanently lose their power while still retaining their ability to trigger with a new one. When you use your power, you can select a theme within the type of power you are granting but, in that case, you will always grant either a weak or average power within the Tier 1 power range. But if you let them trigger with the power most fitting for them within the type(s) of power available to you, the target will most likely gain at least an average or potentially even a top Tier 1 power. Your power also burns out because of the sudden power draw and proximity of the triggering process, which makes it require a few hours to recover after use, with a top Tier 1 taking about a full day to recover from.

If you have Shardless, then your granted powers will also be shardless in nature, giving you the ability to trigger any being with a power, optionally fitting into a power system you have access to, albeit the powers will still manifest within the power types you purchased. Like a tinker could translate into being a specific super genius or a Trump power could translate into inherent meta magics.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Duellist
description_plain:
You get a permanent copy of any Parahuman's power if you kill them in battle, within a simulation. You can pull Parahumans within your LoS into a simulation made by your power by saying “Challenge.”, while looking at them. They’ll be unaware of whatever happens within the simulations, only seconds will pass on the outside while within the simulation.

You will gain severely weakened versions of their powers, comparable to T0s, though how this downgrade manifests can vary, it generally introduces or increases limitations, like cooldowns or range, and is overall qualitatively and quantitatively worse than the original. You can fight each parahuman up to four times, though some weaker parahumans might have less challenges. The first and third can grant a new power, like Gallant giving you his emotion blasts and Thinker power separately with the second and fourth improving them to a 1 sp power, parahumans with only one apparent power, would instead have their power be upgraded to a 2 sp power after four Challenges.

You can have any number of these powers active, though you can only actively use one at a time, passive powers or ones that stay on after activation like Breaker powers don't count towards this limit. Challenging repeatedly physically exhausts you regardless of the outcome, and spending too much time in the Challenge world can lead to Thinker headaches.

When you Challenge a Parahuman you’ll briefly get informed of their Challenge modifiers, the max number of Challenges for this target and the timer until you can try again after failure, which becomes longer the higher the Challenge is, there's no cooldown if you win. The first Challenge will generally have only one modifier, the second and third two, and the fourth one three.

The modifiers are:
REAL- The target will behave as they would in the real world, without this they’ll be less capable, dumber and less observant, like not calling for reinforcements, or not realizing that you have a weapon or power because you hid them.
GANG- Gives the target allies that will aggro (becoming completely dedicated to killing you once they become aware if you) alongside them.
TIME- The Challenge has a countdown.
BLOODLUST- The target will be filled with bloodlust, go for overkill and not care about casualties or anything but killing you.
BERSERK- Turns the target into a berserker. Immune to pain, uncaring about damage, disability, etc. until they die.
ALERT- Instantly aggro's the target and gives them your starting Location.
HUNT- As soon as the target is aggroed, they will never lose track of you, always knowing your location.
ZONE- Greatly limits the area of play to a building, district or street, the target can escape which will count as a failure.
WORLD- Opens up the world as the playing field, very realistic NPC's and buildings. The internet also works sometimes.
CAGE- Puts both you and your target in a closed, white-room scenario. If nobody seems to be winning or one side is stalling, a weapon or gadget will spawn. As time passes the room shrinks.
EVENT- Where the goal isn't to kill the target, but to act out a given scenario of their past or hypothetical future and succeed in tasks until they’re complete. Usually one of the later Challenges.
CONTINUE- The Target remembers previous rounds fighting with you, if you showcase a power, they will remember it for next time.
PREPARATION- The target is ready for you, has information on your powers and is spoiling for a fight right out the gate, a Tinker would have Tinkertech specifically made to counter you for example or have trapped the area.
DANGER- The scenario will conclude with an imperfect reset that will allow facets of the opponent's abilities to linger once the challenge has concluded. Depending on their nature this can be things like memory alterations, damage to your psyche or Mastering.

There can be more modifiers, like FOCUS, CONTROL and DOOM, but the above are the most prominent ones. Within the simulation you can’t use guns. Parahumans with very strong powers, double-triggers, 2nd triggers, years of combat experience or other such boosts can have more Challenges, ranging from 5-8, with the same pattern as the Challenges 1-4, adding versatility, removing a limitation or allowing you to upgrade the power you've gotten from them in some way, though these Challenges are appropriately more difficult, often having more than three modifiers, or having much more difficult modifier combinations.

The fight within the Challenge will almost always be to the death, the target will come at you with full intent to kill, and you can only leave by either killing them, being killed, or failing to do what the modifiers demand. Your Simulations will be heavily AU, and as such will be useless for predicting the future, the only reliable information you’ll gain will be pertaining to the ones you Challenge and the world itself, like by scouting out buildings.

description_plain:
You gain access to a collection of minor powers called cantrips. On their own, none of those powers are particularly impressive, minor telekinesis, small illusions, a small dart of force or crystal, a weak burst of fire or electricity, etc. — they would be at best rated 1 or 2 on the PRT scale — but you have the ability to modify and upgrade them over time, provided you're willing to put in the work.

The first step is to create your own repository where you write down the formula for each cantrip on the pages of a book or a similar medium, like some sheets stapled together. One formula will entirely fill a sheet of A4-sized paper when written down. The formula include arrays of geometric shapes, mathematical formula, and symbols which follow an internally consistent set of rules. Your power provides your with a collection of 144 base formula, all distinct from each-other.

However, this power does not provide you an understanding of those rules, you will have to decode them by yourself. Once you do, you will be able to create more powerful versions or alternative variants of the base cantrips. The variants are organized into 10 tiers, where zero is the base version, and nine is the most powerful variant — which would be rated 6 on the PRT scale.

While you can have any number of variants written down, you can only have two sets of 6 cantrips prepared at once. To prepare your cantrips or swap them out, you need to meditate for 10 minutes while holding your repository. Each set can contain up to three rank 3 or lower cantrips, two rank 6 or lower cantrips, and one rank 9 or lower cantrip. It takes five seconds to switch the active set, during which you cannot use any cantrips. During preparation, your power will check the formula and reject invalid ones, however it will not give any reason why.

A cantrip takes one second per rank to cast — so a base variant will be instant and the maximum rank will take nine seconds — and takes two seconds per rank to recharge. Some cantrips will require a physical component to use; for example: to search for a person you'd need a strand of hair or drop of blood.

title: (Trump) Checkmate
description_plain:
You have 16 points. You regenerate points at a rate of 1 point per minute. Powers last 1 minute per purchase. You can deactivate powers early, but points only begin regenerating after the full duration expires. All abilities are activated by spending points from your pool. You cannot have more than one active at any given time, with Pawn being the only exception.

Pawn – 1 Point: Creates a perfect clone of you. The clone shares your memories, powers, and point pool. It can independently spend points to activate any power, including creating additional Pawn clones.

Knight – 3 Points: Grants Mover 3-level mobility. You are able to leap several stories high, balance on wires, parkour across nearly any terrain and dodge projectiles with ease.

Bishop – 3 Points: Grants enhanced vision, including telescopic, microscopic, thermal, and night vision. You can see the pores on a person’s skin from several kilometers away. Additionally, you can fire a kinetic blast from your hands that increases in power the farther it travels. Upon impact, you are instantly teleported to the point of impact.

Rook – 5 Points: Grants Alexandria-level durability and strength. You become impervious to bullets, blades, and most forms of trauma. You can also lift vehicles, punch through walls, and cause shockwaves with strikes. You cannot fly and are still limited by leverage.

Queen – 9 Points: Grants all effects of Knight, Bishop, and Rook simultaneously. You gain Mover 3 mobility, superhuman perception and teleporting energy blasts, as well as enhanced durability and strength.

King – 16 Points: Grants all effects of Queen. In addition, you create 3 Pawn clones. Each clone can transform freely between Knight, Bishop, and Rook forms without spending additional points. Clones last for the duration of the King effect.

title: (Trump/Master) Pseudo Cycle
description_plain:
You are now able to set up a cycle of your own.

How this manifests is gaining the ability to mentally compartmentalize various skills, attributes, and abilities you possess into “Shards” of your being. You can then further divide your Shards into fragmented lesser Shards that represent different percentages of the associated skill, attribute, or ability. This doesn’t negatively affect your ability to use your Shard’s associated capabilities, but it does factor into the rest of this power.

Namely, that you can set up mental parameters that if a person in the local multiverse meets, will bond that person with one of your Shards. This gives them access to the capabilities that Shard represents, while depriving you of the same while that Shard is handed out.

You can give different Shards different parameters to look for in hosts, and black list certain Shards from being handed out all together if you desire.

You can’t give out Shards you need to live, attempting to do so like giving out a Shard that represents all your physical strength will automatically fragment that Shard, leaving you with the bare minimum your body needs to function.

You can give out effectively infinite Shards at the same time, so long as you have enough skills, attributes, or abilities.

Someone who becomes host to one of your Shard will be able to use that skill, attribute, or ability as if it were naturally their own, all the while the Shard records and learns from ways it is used by its current host. You can set parameters altering the ways Shards first manifest in their hosts, so long as it doesn’t make the Shard stronger or involve capabilities you aren’t capable of with the unrestricted version.

You may at any time or distance retrieve Shards you handed out with a mental trigger, gaining any knowledge, skill, or power that the Shard accrued relevant to its associated skill, attribute, or ability. This has several applications, namely, if the right skills are given out to the right people, you’ll be able to acquire pseudo Tinker and Thinker capabilities even if this is your only power.

You’ll also automatically recollect a distributed Shard if its current host dies.

While a Shard is bound to a host, that host is slightly mentally influenced in ways that line up with your own interests and mentality. You also gain a general awareness of where that host is located and their activities.

title: (Trump) Hetairoi
description_plain:
With a touch, you can grant other people an Alexandria Package of your design.

First component of your gift is flight, with top speed of 100 miles per hour, nigh-instant acceleration and minor aspect of protection from motion sickness.

Second and third components of your gift are enhanced strength and durability, each rated at Brute 3 with precise details being up to you.

Final component of your gift is a minor auxiliary power, known as Distincta in some academic circles. It is rated at 2 in a relevant classification or overlap thereof, and may not have Trump or Tinker aspects.

Optionally you may choose for any of the components to be weaker than the maximum allowed. Precise details of the Alexandria Package you can gain are set upon gaining this power, and stay consistent between instances. You may instantly revoke any granted packages at will.

title: (Trump) Blueprint
description_plain:
You are able to grant powers to others—but only after you’ve built them from the ground up. You must design each power in full detail, specifying exactly how it works: the mechanisms it uses (electromagnetic pulses, kinetic manipulation, chemical reactions, etc.), what it does (such as stunning targets, generating barriers, enhancing senses), what its limits are (range, energy caps, trigger conditions, or Manton-style restrictions), and how it activates. The more clearly and thoroughly you define a power—down to its edge cases and exceptions—the more likely your Shard is to approve it. Once approved, you can assign that power to someone of your choosing. Once given you lose access to that power and can’t grant it to another.

There’s no limit to how many powers you can design or how many people you can empower, but each person can only hold one of your powers at a time. If someone already has powers of their own, you cannot override them. Instead, you may add an extra ability or modifier to their existing power, using the same detailed creation process. However, there’s a catch: once a power is created and approved, its core traits become locked out for future designs. The more a new concept overlaps in function, form, or mechanism with something you’ve already made, the more likely your Shard is to reject it outright.

You cannot grant yourself powers.

title: (Trump) Souls Leveling Maiden
description_plain:
With this power, you can see a sort of energy in people. This energy grows as they complete difficult challenges, especially those related to combat.

By touching a person, you can expend some of that energy to permanently empower various aspects of their existence. Things you can improve include mental attributes, physical capabilities, or aspects of powers they might possess.

The more you empower someone, the more energy is required to empower them further—encouraging them to seek greater and ever more dangerous challenges.

All people you empower gain a special sense that lets them understand how much of this energy they currently have and how much is required to empower themselves further. These individuals can also exchange energy between themselves.

You can also see this energy within yourself, allowing you to empower yourself just as you would any other person. The catch is that it takes far more energy to empower yourself than it does others—about a hundred times as much, in fact. It’s not all bad, though; whenever you empower someone else, you’ll receive one-tenth of the energy used for your own personal use. This encourages you to empower as many people as possible, as often as possible.

For a few examples of how this empowerment works: say empowering any statistic is represented in levels. While the first time you empower someone it might take 100 energy to increase a stat by one level, the next level could require 250 energy, with the required energy increasing for each and every further level.

People start off with stats between one and ten, representing human-level capabilities—one being exceptionally weak for a human and ten being peak human. These stats can be increased effectively infinitely, so long as the person can meet the energy requirements.

Leveling a stat gives an incremental bonus, increasing it slightly by small percentages of the human average (or other Parahuman powers, as the case may be). One or two levels may be mostly inconsequential, but a few dozen levels in a single stat would result in a noticeable change.

Energy gain is retroactive. If a person did anything in the past that would’ve increased their energy stockpile—even before meeting you, or before you gained this power—they’ll still have that energy stored.

title: (Trump) Trade!
description_plain: You can permanently swap the powers of two people you're touching. This has to be a 1:1 trade, so if you were touching Alexandria you could take her mental power and give back Captain America, as an example.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Trigger Bomb
description_plain:
If someone has the potential to trigger you will see them surrounded by a faint red mist. You can see and hear glimpses of their trigger event and the possible powers they can gain from it by looking at the mist.

You can force any potential parahuman you have seen to experience their trigger event. When you do this you and those you trigger form a cluster. Their primary power is the one they triggered with and they gain secondaries from everyone else on the cluster. The secondaries are weaker and often complement the primary or each other, sometimes a secondary is completely unrelated to all others.

The powers of those you trigger are slightly weaker than it would've been had they triggered naturally. The more members your cluster has the weaker their primary and secondaries will be, although the strength stops going down after a certain point.

You cannot add more members once you make a cluster. You can unmake the cluster anytime, everyone loses their secondary and regains the strength their primary lost. By draining the powers of a clustermate a member can keep their secondaries and even strengthen it.

You can select and adjust the kiss/kill dynamic between each clustermate. For instance, you could set the kill dynamic to maximum strength for two members turning them into eternal enemies. Alternatively, you could set the kiss dynamic to minimum strength for a pair making them more inclined to cooperate.

As you are a member of the clusters you make anything that applies to them apply to you.

title: (Trump) Wheel of Fortune
description_plain: You have three slots that every 24 hours will roll new powers; they can range from being very weak to decently strong, and every six days you gain 15 charges. For the cost of one charge, you can use it to re-roll a single power, and you can use two charges to determine either how powerful the power will be or what type of power it will be, or you can use three charges to determine both how powerful it will be and what type of power it will be, though that can only be done once per power slot every six days.

description_plain:

Whenever you are in danger or under attack, you will gain a new power to combat your attacker or protect yourself from danger, though you have no way of directly controlling what power you will receive. These powers are permanent but start weak, about as strong as a low T1 power. Through continuous combat and their need through those situations, however, they grow in strength to the level of a high T1 power.

However, if you have Negentropy your powers will start as strong as mid-T1 powers and will continue to grow as strong as the Cycle allows it.

title: (Trump/Shaker) Don't mess with a white mage
description_plain:
Every 5 seconds, you generate one mana up to a maximum of 24 (takes two minutes to fully regenerate). Using one mana, you can cast one of the spells below within 20 meters of yourself. However, they cannot be cast on yourself. When you cast a spell, it produces a visible and obvious effect on both you and the target person or area. Spells with effects that can stack are marked with (S) and are limited to 10 active effects on a single target. Spells marked with (A) can be cast as an area of effect variant with a 2 meter radius at the cost of 4 mana.

Malefic - Strikes one target within your range with an energy blast as strong as a full-power punch from you (without any power enhancements).
Combust - Applies a ghostly fire to one target within your range and burns them over 10 seconds. (Delivers the same amount of physical damage as Malefic.)
Gravity - Strikes every target within a 2 meter radius of one target with the same strength as Malefic.

Every time you win a battle, when your opponent is either incapable of fighting or disengages, after using any of your offensive spells the maximum strength of your offensive spells increases by 1% additively.

Prognosis - You obtain a summary health assessment for everyone in your range.
Diagnosis - You obtain a detailed health assessment for a single person.
Esuna (A) - This cures sickness and poisons, stops bleeding, and sanitizes wounds. This works on cancer.
Cure (A) - Fully heals the target of all injuries. While it doesn't cure you of illnesses, genetic or otherwise, it does cure the symptoms.
Regen (S, A) - You can give a person 5 minutes of high-speed regeneration. The speed at which a targeted person regenerates is visible, but only barely. Each additional stack of Regen increases the speed by 20% additively. This spell makes cancer worse.
Raise (A) - Stops arrhythmia or restarts the target's heart.
Shell (S, A) - You create a durable and shock resistant skin-tight barrier around someone for 30 seconds.
Holy - You can give a person incredible resistance and ability to harm anything that resembles (or actually is) something unholy for one hour. The Blessing is strong enough that Armsmaster would be able to definitively kill Leviathan with his Nanothorn halberd.  This blessing can only be active on a single person at once.
Bless (S) - You can double one of the following attributes for five minutes: speed, strength, dexterity, intelligence, charisma, or luck.
Curse (S) - You can half one of the following attributes for five minutes: speed, strength, dexterity, intelligence, charisma, or luck. In the case of luck, this effectively doubles bad luck.
Elemental - You can give someone resistance to an element as well as mid-level Shaker control over said element, lasts for 5 minutes. (It does not grant elemental creation.)
Purge - Undo all Parahuman effects on a person, regardless of whether they are active, passive, or part of their power. You can choose which effects are removed.
Remove - (Cost: 12 mana) Undo all Parahuman effects on a person and removes their power. You absorb an energy ball with their power stored in it.
Transfer - You can transfer an energy ball with a power stored in it to another person. The power will act similar to a Cauldron power, not giving them instinctive knowledge on how to use the power, but not messing with their mind either.

title: (Trump) Power Seed
description_plain: You may give someone a random 1 SP power with a theme of your choice that will grow with them at a rate of 1 SP/week. It will grow based on their actions and experiences, and will try to suit their needs similar to Dynamist Jr. When a seed hits 15 SP, it is no longer budding and it is now mature. When a seed matures, then it will stop growing at an enhanced rate, but it will continue to grow and adapt forever as if it were shardless. You may plant these seeds on an unlimited amount of people, but a single person can only have one budding seed at a time. At any point you may chose to take the power back, though it will lose it's enhanced growth rate as if is mature. You may have any number of these powers active at 50% power, but only one at 100%.

title: (Trump) Some for One
description_plain:
You are a true power thief able to permanently steal the powers of other Parahumans with a touch in order to empower yourself, stealing only their power instead of the Shard behind that power. This power works by taking the powers in question from that Parahuman’s Shard in a trade of information and resources, which is how you can steal powers from someone like Victoria Dallon without also taking their Shard in the process.

Part of the process of stealing powers involves recalibrating those powers to fit Some for One’s standards. In most cases this will involve little to no alterations besides Some for One doing its best to ensure powers you steal can synergize with one another or if that’s impossible at least not actively conflict with each other's functions.

However in the case of powers that are usually constantly passively active with no control on the users part this recalibration will universally include the ability to turn such powers off and on as desired, which among other things lets you treat stolen case 53 powers as Changer or Breaker states.

There are however few caveats to this, for one you can’t steal any powers stronger than 10 SP. You also only have a limited storage capacity of 200 SP with no way to remove any of your stolen powers to free up capacity and no way to steal more powers after reaching that limit. Lastly you may only use up to 50 SP worth of stolen powers at one time.

A consequence of not stealing entire Shards is the possibility of a Parahuman you stole from triggering again with new powers, in fact they’ll have an easy time triggering with more potent powers if their Shard likes them.

title: (Trump/Brute) Looks Matter
description_plain:
Appearances matter, and your power takes this literally. The better you look the stronger you get, both your physical strength and the strength of your powers. This factors in both your physical appearance and the appearance of your clothing and powers, so a fancy and artistic spread of lasers would be more effective than simply drowning an opponent in firepower.

Furthermore, the general theme of your appearance can also influence minor aspects of your powers or even grant minor powers of their own. This effect also scales with the appearance and quality of your outfit. For instance, a low quality wind or avian themed outfit might allow you to fall slower or make your Mover powers go faster, while an extremely high quality fire costume could grant decently powerful pyrokinesis.

This pairs extremely well with Tinker powers, especially (Tinker) Style, as normal materials and crafting methods alone are not enough to reach the highest levels of this power.

title: (Trump) Variant Copier
description_plain:
Choose any body part or function such as a claw, healing factor, bark, heat regulation, or brain and this power will be connected to a Shard that helps fulfill a similar if redundant function in the Entity this power originates from. Next choose a concept such as hard light energy, fire, space, or liquid swords. Essentially any concept you can think of and that concept no matter how simple or complex will somehow be critically involved in how this Shard functions and fulfills its role as an Entity body part.

As for actual powers this grants you, you have become a pseudo power copying Trump. How this works is whenever you touch another Parahuman your Shard will enter an exchange of Data with the other Parahuman’s Shard. Your Shard will then do its best to replicate that other Parahuman’s power using its own capabilities.

The body part or function your Shard acts as the equivalent of will determine a few concepts and general capabilities your Shard will be able to best manifest in these copies it makes. For example a claw Shard will excel at making powers that involve attack power, while the concept it’s functions generally revolve around will determine the means in which your Shard is best able to manifest those powers.

Consider if your Shard is a heart that functions off of the concept of steam. If you copied just about any Tinker power you’d probably receive a Tinker power that focuses on generating and using steam power, meanwhile the specific Tinker you copied will determine how that technology goes about generating and using that steam power.

So Kid Win would probably give you steam technology with modular components letting you easily modify and direct the way they generate and use energy, while copying Armsmaster could provide a Tinker power focused on the efficiency and miniaturization of technology that generates and uses steam power.

Your copies have a maximum strength limit of 10 SP, and you can use a maximum of 9 such copies at a time. Though your power can store a practically infinite number of those power copies for you to swap in and out of your active slots.

Note your copying isn’t absolute, trying to copy a Parahuman whose power is too complex or operates under principles incompatible with your Shard will result in a complete failure to copy their power.

title: (Trump/Brute) Selfish Love
description_plain:
You indiscriminately create a connection with anyone you have a relationship with — be it platonic, familiar, romantic, or whatever. Through this connection you can access anything of theirs — as long as its something in or on their bodies, meaning ther minds, body, possessions and even powers are yours to copy — though you lose access if they die.

A simultaneous boon and curse is that any harm that befalls you is instead divided across those connected to you, leaving you unharmed yet knowning someone you might care about is currently injured because of you. Also, any resources your copied powers might need are consumed from their user first before using your own supply; similarly, the consequences of using these copies are shunted to their original users.

title: (Stranger) The Words Are Silent
description_plain:
You have an interesting way of speaking, that is by not speaking at all.

You can project your words directly to those you choose, allowing them to hear you as clearly as if you had spoken aloud. To those who hear you, this seems completely natural, as though your silent words are no different from any other conversation. However, to those who cannot hear you, your silent interactions are strange. They can only see others responding to what seems like complete silence.

This works just like speaking aloud; while you don’t need line of sight to communicate, the person you’re addressing must be close enough to hear you as if you were speaking normally. It’s a one-way connection—you can project your words to others, but they can only respond in the usual way.

title: (Stranger/Shaker) Inviolable Shadows
description_plain:
You are able to take any existing shadow—no matter how faint or thin—and deepen it into pure, impenetrable darkness. So long as you are physically within the boundary of a shadow, you can activate your power. In an instant, it becomes absolute, turned into a pitch-black veil that swallows all illumination. No light escapes, no detail remains visible. The shape and borders of the original shadow are preserved, but what lies within becomes a void.

All this does is erase light. The transformation is total within the affected shadow—flashlights, lasers, ambient sunlight, even high-powered beams fail to pierce through.

This also negates any attempt to generate light from within. A flashlight flicked on inside the shadow emits nothing. The beam of a laser vanishes before it forms. Even high-powered floodlights or flare bursts die quietly the moment they try to shine. No wavelength of light survives inside the affected space.

You can see perfectly within the affected area. Your vision pierces the black as though it isn’t there at all, allowing you to move, observe, and react inside the sealed darkness without hindrance. It functions like a form of night vision, unaffected by the absence of light.

title: (Stranger) You Are A Dragon And That's Okay
description_plain:
No matter what your form or appearance is, people will consider it unremarkable.

This doesn't prevent people from recognizing parts of your body that aren't the norm (such as obviously being a robot or having blades for hands), they just won't judge you for that fact and consider it just another normal trait anybody can have, like having blue eyes or being a bit short. This effect extends to photographs, video or even verbal descriptions of your body.

This also doesn’t lead to people not noticing the effects of your strange biology on the world: if you’re constantly damp, and they see you leaving wet spots everywhere, people will still get annoyed at you; if your skin is acidic, people will try to avoid directly touching you; if you’re bigger than a building then people won’t automatically assume you’ll fit inside; etc. They just won’t consider these effects particularly unusual.

This only applies to your form, automatic power usage that is part of your form and any power usage necessary for normal day-to-day life if your form prevents you from doing those things the normal way. If you’re made out of fire people won’t find it weird, but if you then start shooting that fire out of your hands or flying around any more than the minor amount necessary for you to do things a mundane person can do, people will react to it normally.

title: (Stranger) Fake it Till You Make it
description_plain: You are able to seamlessly blend into your surroundings, fueled by the expectations of observers. When you appear to be in a place or situation where you are expected to be, others will automatically accept you as part of the environment. For example, if you're dressed as a civilian and in a public place, observers will see you as a random passerby without question. Similarly, if you adopt the appearance of someone within a group, observers will believe you're a member of that group. However, the effect falters if you're in a location where you're not expected to be, if your behavior deviates from the norm significantly, or if someone directly calls attention to the inconsistency. This can trick Thinkers, although they may be able to notice something is off.

title: (Stranger) Cry Wolf
description_plain:
Whenever someone would report you, your actions or your property to another person, be it a child, a parent or the police, the world will collude to hide any evidence of wrongdoings they try to bring forth and make the person reporting it seem like they’re crazy or lying, even if you’re actively doing that action.

It doesn’t matter how much they’re trusted by the person to whom they report, how convincing they are or what protocol would dictate, the person they report to will dismiss it when they see no evidence of anything being wrong. This can range from making it rain when people try tracking you, making a meteor hurl down to destroy the evidence, making the item fall onto a car and then be deposited next to you, or simply hiding the items behind various others while the person is investigating.

The specifics vary wildly, the only constant being that these ‘coincidences’ will stop your wrongdoings from being discovered. These events will never hurt anyone.

It doesn’t necessarily have to be a crime, as long as it’s something you don’t want discovered and are
actively working on.

This doesn’t protect against the first observer, only all others that follow. And you might sometimes have to stop your activity during the short period of inspection.

title: (Stranger/Breaker) The Man in the Wall
description_plain:
You become a questionable blip in reality, akin to a twisted specter, able to attach yourself to another person by touch and automatically follow and scrutinize their life. You’re completely unperceivable to others and vague to the trailed individual, only seeing shadows at the corner of their eyes or in the earshot, yet not sure of the cause.

The tertiary aspect comes from the twisting of certain emotions and thoughts when you whisper or utter a word, becoming the nagging voice in their head, the intrusive thought that’s hard to resist, the scraping erosion of their mind till they break. Once you’re finished with them, your Breaker state ends.

You can pursue this person at any time, toggling between your Breaker and human form, where you’ll quickly teleport to being their specter.

title: (Stranger/Trump) Evasive Manoeuvres
description_plain:
Nothing can target you unless you explicitly allow it. Targeting systems fail to lock onto you, homing attacks and abilities veer off course, and any powers that need a specific target for their effect fail to even activate.

This only makes you immune from being a target and does not affect the minds of people. It will prevent an energy blast from homing in on you, but it will not help you should you willingly stand in its way. It will prevent a heat-seeking missile from tracking you, but will not prevent someone from shooting a missile in your general direction.

title: (Stranger/Shaker) My Secret Life
description_plain:
Your secrets are protected and hidden by your power. For your power, a secret is any piece of information directly about yourself that you currently intend to hide, whether consciously or not; this includes your secret identity, a past crime, a medical condition, your real name, a relationship you keep hidden, or even a trivial preference like a disliked food if you actively want it concealed. The more personal weight you assign to that secret, the more your power prioritises it, and you can maintain multiple secrets simultaneously as long as you care about each one.

Your power hides each secret by manipulating probability around anyone searching for that specific information, making them overlook, forget, or fail to access it through a cascade of small improbabilities that never violate physical law: an investigator scrolling past the right file because they blinked, a witness suddenly unable to recall your face because a distraction occurred, a camera glitching at the exact second you passed due to a known hardware quirk, a conversation getting interrupted before the question is asked by a phone ringing, and each failed attempt makes the next attempt statistically less likely to succeed, with the probability of success approaching but never reaching zero, meaning a sufficiently persistent or lucky seeker could still find the secret by sheer chance.

Your power cannot erase a secret someone already knows before you designated it, cannot protect secrets about other people even if you care about them, offers no defense against you accidentally revealing the secret yourself, and weakens significantly if you subconsciously want to be caught or if you tell someone the secret willingly. Additionally certain Thinkers could skip over the process and thus would have an easier time at figuring out your secret.

title: (Stranger) Classified Information
description_plain:
If anyone tells you something, no one else can learn that information. The limitation on this is that the information cannot already be common knowledge; if more than about three-dozen people already know a piece of information, this power won't work on it. It also only applies to information that both parties believe to be true.

If someone tries to share this information, they'll be unable to. If someone tries to read the information, their eyes will just slide past it. If someone observes something that should clue them in, they'll dismiss it.

title: (Stranger) Catch Me If You Can
description_plain:
As long as you can escape any pursuers or combatants, you’ll never face the negative consequences of any actions you take.

Kill a man in broad daylight, as long as you escape the police and/or any other pursuers and stay out of sight for long enough, you’ve effectively gotten away with it.

They’ll never pursue a case against you regardless of how much evidence they collect, they’ll never harass you, or be used against you in any way.

Likewise you can do the same with any other kind of consequences, his brother won’t swear vengeance, you won’t face any issues with the public opinion of you, no gang members will try to take revenge, they won’t hold it against you as part of any negotiations, etc.

This doesn’t prevent people from realizing you did it of course, but merely lets you escape any consequences as long as you get away, both legal and otherwise.

This does allow you to still benefit from any positives that may come out of the actions, allowing you to somehow paradoxically be able to garner positive results, such as praise for saving a family from a house fire, while simultaneously avoiding negative repercussions from the same action, such as having set fire to the house yourself.

This follows for any action you commit, as long as you can escape and break the line of sight with anyone who is both aware of the action you’ve taken and is actively pursuing or engaging and is antagonistic because of it.

For this power to take effect you must have broke line-of-sight with any pursuers and must remain out of sight for 30 minutes. Thinker powers do not count for line-of-sight.

This power can be toggled to effect certain actions and not others, left on passively for everything, or simply turned off.

You possess the uncanny power to ensure that no matter what you do, you will always be forgiven for your actions by the individuals affected. Whenever you do something that would cause offence, resentment or hostility in any form, the people impacted will automatically, completely forgive you for whatever you did.

For example, you could verbally harass or even directly harm someone and they would absolve you. This doesn’t alter or erase an individual’s memories, it only ensures that they will not form a grudge or hold whatever you’ve done against you. This power will cause those affected to subconsciously justify or rationalise your actions, convincing themselves that your behaviour wasn’t that bad or that there was a good reason for it, but only to the point of indifference.

title: (Stranger/Shaker) Sensorium
description_plain:
You are capable of producing an invisible, intangible “fog” over a large area. This fog is capable of hijacking the senses of everything inside, living or artificial (like cameras and microphones), giving you the ability to access and override them at will to make them experience whatever illusions you desire, effectively turning the area into a holodeck. You are also capable of creating illusions of the same calibre that can be visible even to people outside the fog, although you will not get to access their senses or be capable of specialising the illusions to specific people like you would if they were inside.

You can range from giving everyone in the fog the same illusion to giving each individual person a different personalised experience, with their expectations and knowledge filling in the gaps for any details about the illusions you don't personally assign (how it breaks, what it looks like on the back, etc.).

Those inside the fog will instinctively act in such a way to maintain the illusions they’re observing (i.e. if they lean against an illusory wall they will unconsciously lean in such a way that they are still balanced and thus won't fall through it), if they push past these instincts and/or make mistakes the illusions automatically adjust to maintain realism and explain away any inconsistencies caused by the illusion in whatever way the subject thinks would make the most sense (i.e. if they tripped and fell through an illusory wall then the illusory wall will have “broken”).

Your power is even capable of hijacking and tricking exotic senses like thinker powers, although they take more focus to understand and manipulate.

Those inside the fog will instinctively act in such a way to maintain the illusions they’re observing (i.e. if they lean against an illusory wall they will unconsciously lean in such a way that they are still balanced and thus won't fall through it), if they push past these instincts and/or make mistakes the illusions automatically adjust to maintain realism and explain away any inconsistencies caused by the illusion in whatever way the subject thinks would make the most sense (i.e. if they tripped and fell through an illusory wall then the illusory wall will have “broken”).

Your power is even capable of hijacking and tricking exotic senses like thinker powers, although they take more focus to understand and manipulate.

title: (Stranger/Master) Eyes On Me
description_plain:
You have the ability to make those who see you become unable to perceive anything but you. Not only that, but it causes them to hyperfocus on you. Essentially, their senses won’t register anything that isn’t you—with the exception of themselves—and their thoughts and actions are solely focused on you. This means that if you used your power on a team, all members would not only lose sight of each other, but also forget they were fighting you together because they are too preoccupied with wanting to punch your face to remember they aren’t alone.

While this power allows you to essentially blind your opponents to the world around them—enabling things like setting up traps without detection—it has the side effect of making those affected by it highly perceptive of you, not even walls working as visual covers. This could lead to issues, such as them remembering your face very clearly, even decades later.

title: (Stranger/Shaker) Simulated Delusion
description_plain:
You have a power similar to Coil, the power to simulate two timelines where you take mutually exclusive actions. However, unlike Coil, your timelines only last 5 minutes, and you must choose which timeline happens when you activate the power. The main benefit from this power is that you may create a realistic, tactile illusion paired with a strong Stranger effect that makes everyone believe you chose the other timeline.

This allows you to, say, make your opponent think you charged right at them and engaged them in melee combat, even feeling 'your' blows, when in reality you snuck up behind them and stabbed them in the back, never even noticing their gaping wound. When 5 minutes pass, the illusion fades away, simulated injuries vanish and real injuries that were previously hidden appear, as everyone realizes that they were tricked.

If they know about the power ahead of time, they can try to act on how they think your real actions are, but the Stranger effect is hard to resist, constantly forcing people to consider that your simulated actions are real. Certain Parahumans like Alexandria or Weld who don't think with normal brains are completely immune to the Stranger portion, but the illusion still completely hides your presence and real actions even from power derived senses.

Your illusion has a selectable range between 10 and 1000 meters. You may selectively exclude people from the effect, allowing them to see the real timeline with the illusion appearing as a mostly translucent hologram to them just as it does for you.

title: (Trump) Manager
description_plain:
You can take/copy the powers of any Parahuman you touch, as well as give the powers you have taken/copied to others. You have fifteen slots to store powers and can have five of them active at a time. You can temporarily go over this limit, but you will suffer Thinker headaches that worsen rapidly the longer you are over your maximum limit.

Negentropy increases your active limit by 2 and your total slots by 5.

You can alter the powers in your possession by cycling through different expressions of the same power, modifying them by boosting one aspect at the expense of another or changing their restrictions. Multiple compatible powers can occupy the same slot and synergize together. Power compatibility depends on the power itself, not its expression.

This power works on Cauldron Vials and the Garden of Eden; you will get a random expression when getting those powers.

You can discard unwanted powers, but you will not be able to acquire them again unless you steal/copy them again. Copying powers can take a minute, but stealing them happens instantly.

title: (Trump) Prototype
description_plain:
You have 18 slots to store powers. You can only have 6 active at once, but you can instantly switch which ones are active. You can instantly empty a slot, but it takes 30 seconds to load a power pattern from memory.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (up to a maximum of 200 stored). You can use these charges to copy, create, and improve powers. You can use 1 charge to copy the power of a parahuman in your line of sight within 100m of you. You can use from 1 to 5 charges to create a new power; the created power will be random unless you constrain it. (1 charge would be around 3 on the PRT scale, 5 charges would be around 7). The more precisely you constrain a power, the weaker it will be.

You can expend more charges to tweak or improve the created powers further to your liking. The strongest power you can create would be equivalent to a Tier 3, weaker than Prototype. To prevent an overload, the number of active slots will reduce if you have powers stronger than Tier 2 active, down to only two if you slot the strongest power you can make. The only power you cannot reproduce is Eidolon, as your power already fulfills that function (that is, to select and interface with powers).

You have two secondary Thinker powers. One that allows you to perfectly recall power patterns, and one that allows you to understand the patterns, modify and combine them into new powers.

Negentropy increases your daily charges to 15 and your slots to 24.

title: (Brute) Avalon
description_plain: You regenerate near instantaneously, are far more durable than you otherwise would, have unlimited stamina and do not age past your prime, have no limits when it comes to how strong you can become through training, are beloved by nature and its inhabitants, and your willpower is increased.

title: (Shaker) It Gets Worse
description_plain: Few things can harm you. Not because you're an ultra Brute or so fast you can't get hit. No, you have impossible luck. No one harms you because they get hurt, humiliated or even killed because they tried. The harder, more seriously, and more violently they tried to hurt you, the worse the response from your power. You can still get hurt by accident, or if a sufficiently durable and determined person tries hard enough. They might even live long enough to regret it.

title: (Breaker) And the Void Stares Back
description_plain: Your whole body is a door to a pocket dimension. Your surface is a semipermeable membrane; you can choose what can pass and what can't. You can shift your shape, and using materials similar to skin, you can make yourself appear human. You can sound like whatever you want. If you let everything in, you become a very powerful vacuum. If you want, you can just walk through anything. You are completely invincible to all physical attacks, including Sting.

title: (Tinker) Revolution
description_plain:
You have access to every Tinker technology tree as well as understood technology dating back to the dawn of civilization(s). The closer to understood technology your inventions are, the less black-boxed they are. This limit can be raised if you study and analyze your own technology or if a technology you created is reverse-engineered and understood by scientists.

You can have 3 method specializations (modular, efficiency, etc), 5 broad specializations (lasers, waves, code, vehicles, etc.), and 9 narrow specializations (clockwork automata, personal equipment, prosthetics, surveillance, etc.) at once. It takes a minute to switch between specializations.

Note: Even if you build a replicator, the created items will still be black-boxed and need maintenance.

Note: Technology levels, your base technology level is based at least on 2010 technology and cannot be lower if you are in a world with a more primitive understanding.

title: (Thinker) Neural Network
description_plain:
You have access to a network of 512 Nodes (768 with Negentropy) that can be used for several purposes. For every 16 unallocated nodes, your thinking speed is increased by 25% additively.

Nodes can be used to store approximately 2.5 PB (petabytes) of information, which includes memories. One Node is sufficient to store a perfect snapshot of your brain.

Nodes can also be grouped into a Module. This allows them to be programmed to perform various functions like keeping track of time, automatically creating a backup of your brain, processing your vision to parse any text and store it in a node, and more. If it can be done with a computer, it can be done with a module. One node has roughly the same processing power as a high-end server.

You can also use Nodes to create a Cluster, which allows them to host Thinker powers. The power uses several nodes equivalent to the square of its rating (Thinker 2 takes 4 Nodes, Thinker 3 takes 9 Nodes, and so on). Your maximum rating is 9. The powers can only use information gathered from your own senses,  including any power-granted senses.

title: (Breaker/Trump) Self-Rewrite
description_plain:
You have the power to rewrite your own existence.

You can will yourself to change into another person, have any tier 2 power, and turn yourself into anything. You could will yourself into becoming metal, fire, water, space, time, and anything else you could think of.

You are capable of turning yourself more intelligent, stronger, and faster, all by your will alone. You are also able to teleport across the Wormverse Earth simply by wanting to be there. You can retain your consciousness no matter what you transform into.

(You can only turn into more esoteric things by buying the Esoteric Knowledge perk or being Shardless. You're also only able to go to other multiverses by having Homecoming).

title: (Trump/Tinker) Shards
description_plain:
You are a Tinker specialized in manipulating Shards, which allows for personal Shard editing/refining/researching and [Data] gain from nearby Shards.

[Data] gathering takes active combat with a Shardbearer to process and copy [Data], allowing your Shard to gain these powers or offshoots. You can cannibalize different [Data] to strengthen or weaken different powers, adjusting them with your Raw [Data] and [Resources].

You gain both passive Raw [Data] Acclimation, which accelerates depending on how much [Data] you have in your Shard (you can code and edit sweeping changes, on a much larger scale, with a more effective ability creation and incorporation, with a speedier pace depending on your [Data]’s quantity and variety you’ve copied from other Shards) and a passive [Energy] gain from, both from researching energy-efficient (energy-rich) methods and passively editing your Shard to implement this improvements, which will increase your Shard's life span if left unused.

At the same time, your Shard can be overtaxed if intensively utilized until it breaks in terms of raw [Energy] usage, though you will be warned. Having Negentropy will mitigate this risk, based by adding better methods of [Energy] usage, production, and allocation.

If offered direct access to inert Shards e.g. The Garden of Eden, you’ll freely manipulate these Shards with a touch, interfacing with them, plus a significant [Energy] expenditure, discover the methods of Shard Construction, and make powers from them, this analysis taking 72 hours of direct contact (with Negentropy or Shardless making this moot, bypassing this condition).

Shard Construction’s (by extension Power Creation’s) requirements will take up an incredible amount of Raw [Data] and [Energy] to assemble, configure, set up, and finally fine-tune up to your task, enough you take the serious risk of immediate Shard Death due to how [Data] and [Energy]-intensive it is (Negentropy neutralizes this risk, though). The Raw [Data] necessary for Shard Construction is about a year's worth of [Data] generation (equal to 20 fully [Data] replicated Shards worth for a full year as well left unused), with the Raw [Data] needed for Power Configuration being variable based on the Shard’s resulting specialization in question.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Stilling
description_plain:
You now have the ability to wield the power known as Stilling, an incredible power that allows you to negate and manipulate wavelengths.

Its versatility is immense, as it can be used for disintegrating molecular bonds, canceling heat and sound, slowing or stopping motion, and negating the effects of virtually any superhuman ability/power. It can even be used to heal and much more.

This power manifests as golden light, which you can shape into any form you wish. All of your "Stilling" effects are completely silent, can range greatly in power (from pencil-thin cutting beams to planet-destroying blasts), and have practically infinite range. Your light can even track and home in on targets, even curving in mid-air.

You are capable of manifesting a golden aura that grants you the ability to fly at immense speeds. Thanks to the aura itself, you can fly even through space and other hostile environments without any problems.

You can use your Stilling ability to "tune" your defenses to negate any power, even if they are far more powerful than you. You also have an automatic adaptive defense that makes you immune to anything used against you.

You can use the Stilling ability to its fullest potential even without knowing exactly how it works.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Fractal of Entropic Decay
description_plain:
You have in your hands the power to control what the Entities have been dreading and try to stave off to escape their inevitable demise against: the phenomenon of Entropy. In their efforts to understand it, they spend copious amounts of time researching this.

At first, it’s viewed more as bare temperature manipulation, yet that’s further from the truth; it handles the amount of expended or unavailable energy in a system. A system in the physical sense can apply to anything, but is best described as a portion of the universe where changes take place in response to a set of conditions or the environment, which is then studied. It can be complex, such as a planet, or simple enough to fit in a beaker, as the liquid within a glass.

The “system” thus utilized for this power is an area of three city blocks around the user. This, being Shard-based, is quite limited in scope for the Entities’ concerns about Entropy.

An inherent part of this ability is an extant Thinker power to perceive energy and levels of energy of any kind or measure. Once the current level of entropy is determined, you can adjust it, resulting in a change in the system. This applies to anything, such as a glass of ice, a room, or a living organism, including yourself.

A quirk of this ability is manifesting itself through a translucent stygian black energy field either as an aura or throughout your “system’s” range, and even somewhat a polar opposite to Stilling: ebony rays of unlight. Some applications are somewhat analogous to Stilling yet utterly antithetical in basis. Something to mull over…

The power is partitioned into three aspects: Containment, Diffusion, and Exhaustion:

Containment is the fine control or deceleration of Entropy to a microscopic and macroscopic level, which contains activation energy (the minimum amount of energy needed to initiate a reaction), among the chemical and physical phenomena that need energy to function or continue to occur. In turn, you can manipulate Entropy on a system or object to extend its timespan from its inevitable decay, violently disrupt a system’s integrity, and drastically cause system equilibrium by heating or freezing the system (or select parts).

Diffusion is the middle ground of Entropy, in which you diffuse, absorb, and assimilate energy through macroscopic control of Entropy. This is utilized as diffusing the area’s utilized energy (including the one’s parahuman powers use, effectively negating them), absorbing it to bolster the user’s physical and dynamic abilities, or assimilating the system’s resources in mass for various uses.

Exhaustion is the Entities’ fear, the only reason they stopped probing it: Entropy Acceleration. This is used to exhaust the system’s energy reserves responsible for structure and form, causing its breakdown, destabilizing anything within your range or particular liking, and having physical and radioactive effects. For example, on a smaller scale, you can decay anything from an appliance to a house if you let Exhaustion spread, weaponizing it to an anti-energy exponentially growing through propagation to any matter or energy on contact, or infuse it into a weapon for it to deteriorate anything the weapon damages or simply graze.

The only glaring weakness of having this power is its anathema: Negentropy. A Negentropic being can compete with you, yet depends on their energy generation/recovery: A negligible energy rate places the odds in your favor, while a formidable rate of energy recovery turns this into a battle of attrition in the Negentropic being’s favor.

title: (Shaker) The Ultimate Question
description_plain:
Your Shard contains information that is simultaneously the most priceless and worthless knowledge the Entities have. A burning desire that, despite over millions of years of research, they seem no closer to getting. Your shard contains the record of the closest they have gotten to Negentropy.

The basic theory was that since the Multiverse allows for infinite variation, it should be possible to harness infinite variations of energy. Unfortunately, the act of reaching out into the multiverse was simply too energy-exhausting, meaning that they absorbed less energy than they were expending. This doesn’t mean that this [Data] is useless, though; it just wasn’t what they were looking for. Ultimately, the information was repurposed to simulate and manipulate this energy for their own ends.

When using this power, a large 30-centimeter silvery white ring or “halo” will manifest itself around you, affecting things within a three-block radius. By default, it appears behind your head. You can change its location around you and even its size, but it will always manifest in your vicinity. This halo, while antithetical in application, is surprisingly analogous to Stilling in basis—a point of study, perhaps.

As stated previously, this power can be used in two basic ways known as [Simulation] and [Manipulation].

[Simulation] applies a constant rate of energy to an object or phenomenon. Originally designed to simulate how the universe’s energy generation works and how to possibly increase it, it has been repurposed to allow things like a bullet ignoring air resistance and gravity to fire in a perfectly straight line. If this sounds familiar, it should. This mechanic has been further refined into what modern Parahumans know as All-or-Nothing. Interestingly, it is possible to affect other Perfect powers within your radius, allowing you to increase their scope or even turn them “OFF,” so to speak.

[Manipulation] is the direct management of potential variations of energy within your area of effect. This is not energy control so much as potential energy manifestation. It transforms the unused potential energy, or zero-point energy, into other possible variations of said energy, such as electricity, seemingly making energy from nothing. It also allows you to effortlessly transform one type of energy into another, such as kinetic energy into thermal energy. It is also possible to return energy to its zero-point state. An example would be letting a nuclear bomb go off, only for the explosion to just disappear without leaving even a trace of radiation. When used like this, the added zero-point energy can be stored by your Shard to use on a later occasion. This potential energy absorption is the core mechanic by which Entities “feed” at the end of a [Cycle].

When using both [Simulation] and [Manipulation] together, it is possible to use [Simulation] as a framework through which to control energy changed by [Manipulation]. This allows you to focus the energy into specific directions and even release it outside of your range of control. This is a highly complex process, but you are given a minor Thinker power to help manage it all.

Should you possess genuine Negentropy, this power doesn’t change much. Rather, it becomes dedicated to managing your personal Negentropy, allowing you to finely control its framework and even increase its efficiency when affecting your other powers, enhancing all the benefits they may provide.

title: (Breaker/Shaker) Embodiment of the Supernova
description_plain:
You are able to transform into a person-shaped supernova, and in this state, you possess almost complete control over plasma and the ability to create a near-endless amount of it. You can create and manipulate plasma that is over a billion degrees Celsius and fire concentrated beams of plasma, along with creating and directing seas of plasma, with a mere thought.

You also gained immense control over gravity and radiation. Your gravity manipulation allows you to condense matter into black holes. Your control over gravity is such that you can prevent black holes from affecting matter. Your control over radiation is such that you can prevent others from being affected by your breaker state. create illusions by manipulating visible radiation and tapping into communications that use radio waves, and so on.
