title: (Shaker/Changer) Cocytus
description_plain:
Your power is to become, create, and manipulate ice; your body is naturally in a state of being a man made of ice, though you always look human.

This power allows you to ignore physical attacks by shattering around them, regrowing your ice body, or manipulating your body around the attack. Your body instinctually becomes ice when attacked; you can fight this.

You can create ice from nothing for up to half a mile in a sphere around you and freeze natural water for up to 2 miles (up to the molecular level). You have a secondary Thinker ability that allows you to sense all water in all its forms and create ice within your radius.

When more energy is expended, you can drop your ice's temperature to absolute zero. Killing all energy next to your ice immediately and making your ice strong enough to tank at least one hit from an Entity-level ability. If the focus is kept on the ice, the temperature will stay down, but if not, it will rapidly heat up to its normal temperature, superheating the area around it to a temperature above 15 °C.

It will take an immense amount of energy, but if you drop yourself to absolute zero, you gain the durability mentioned along with Alexandria-level strength. But your most notable ability is that time will freeze around you for as long as you stay at absolute zero. You can move and do things in this state, but it will expend more energy to do so and freeze those you hit during this time.

(This power will kill your Shard if used for more than 24 hours and rapidly decrease its life span when in use. Negentropy stops these negative effects.)

You can move and do things in this state, but it will expend more energy to do so and freeze those you hit during this time.

(This power will kill your Shard if used for more than 24 hours and rapidly decrease its life span when in use. Negentropy stops these negative effects.)

title: (Master/Trump) The Friend Bringer
description_plain:
You gain the ability to summon and resend Alternate versions of Shardbearers that you meet, clones of the originals as well.

These summons will be perfectly loyal, but will still hold their personality, they will be given a general understanding of both your world and you upon summoning. They will sacrifice themselves and their morals to protect you and do what you say. Their powers start at 50% strength and after a full 1 month of being summoned, they are boosted to 200% of their normal strength from then on (This only happens once).

You are given a Thinker ability which allows you to perceive a mental rotating list of currently useful summons for the tasks you need done. You are given an Aura of 30 feet which counts as your range for the "meet" condition.
Endbringers and Entities can be summoned, alternates and clones alike, but only under the condition that you touch their core for Endbringers and for Entities to seriously injure them (To summon a clone or Alt. Leviathan you would need to touch its core; to summon a clone or Alt. Scion you would need to seriously injure his real body).

Every summoning takes Shard power and requires focus to keep active after they complete their original task, summoning Endbringers is an immense drain of both Shard energy and mental focus and will do serious damage to your Shard if held too long while Entity summons will instantly drop your shard to less than 1 week of energy left and knock you unconscious for at least 1 hour, they will shatter your Shard if summoned for longer than their task takes.
Summon's initial energy and focus requirements are substantially higher than continual summoning post-task. (Negentropy will completely nullify all the shard-based drawbacks of this power and half all mental drain).

This power will allow you to perform this ability with any "powered" individuals in the multiverse if taken with Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless

You can manifest an invisible phantom at any location on the planet that can interact with the world.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Ouranos
description_plain:
You gain the ability to manipulate all oxygen within a 3-mile radius sphere around yourself, up to the atomic level. With powers of notable specificity aside (Cocytus being specified to Ice only, for example, but a normal waterbender isn't specific enough), you are the absolute authority when anything oxygen-based is involved, from air to water to certain acids, even with people up to 10 times your power.

You gain a secondary Thinker ability, which gives you knowledge (atomic position and bonds, and things directly interacting with it, like people walking through air, for example) of every Oxygen atom within your range.

This ability inherently lacks the usual Shard Manton Limit, allowing you to do things such as take or add oxygen to/from people or control them using their blood, etc.

Notable uses of this power include weather control in both the air and water involved, water manipulation (all forms) like the creation of Tsunamis and hyper-compressed water attacks, popping heads by filling them with oxygen, unbinding every Oxygen atom in your range, creating a 6-mile diameter sphere of desperately unstable atoms, and splitting or fusing the atoms in your range.

Your best attacks, from world-changing weather phenomena made by your power to nuclear detonations made by you splitting or fusing oxygen atoms, easily damage/destroy Endbringer, and do significant damage over large areas to even Entities.

title: (Mover/Breaker) Time Out!
description_plain: You can manipulate how fast time flows for you, in either direction, as much as you want. In other words, you can speed your perception and movement up to the point where time appears stopped, or slow it to the point where years pass in minutes, or more. You can interact with objects normally, as though they weren't frozen, or you can choose to have objects simply refuse to move. Strength is not increased despite your speed, but you can apply your normal force multiple times in a row for roughly the same effect. You are not able to rewind time with this power. If you speed up your perceptions, your aging is slowed to account for it in a way that you age as though the appropriate amount of time passed, instead of however much you experienced. If you are about to die, this power automatically stops time for you.

description_plain:
You can instantly learn and understand the workings and mechanics of anything, understand the complexity and exactness of organisms, objects, etc. without the need for long-term or special education, regardless of how simple or complex. This only helps with understanding the underlying mechanisms of the thing in question, it doesn't give any skills you didn't already possess.  Your shard obscures your ability to learn anything related to The Entities, such as the workings of the Cycle, but with enough time or if you have a good relationship with your shard, you can understand their workings.

title: (Breaker/Trump) Golden Form
description_plain:
You’ve gained the ability to change into a powerful breaker form, converting your body into semi-solid/liquid energy, with its initial form resembling you in a full-body cloak of golden flames. All your abilities are massively enhanced from your previous form. A normal human would be capable of overpowering Alexandria in strength and durability, sheer speed to run from one side of the planet to the other in a minute, and a reaction time to easily handle that kind of speed. This enhancement is extended to all your abilities, including other powers. The breaker form can be confined to a single part or individual parts of your body if you wish, and switching between your normal form and breaker form will instantly heal any injury.

Alongside this is the ability to manipulate the energy your body is made from, allowing you to freely shape it into whatever you desire such as massive hands, a large animal form, or even weapons. The energy your body produces and is made from can be expelled as powerful blasts or used to imbue any other abilities you possess to further enhance them. You can channel any abilities you possess through your energy form as if they were your own body. You also possess a secondary ability allowing you unlimited multitasking in regards to your energy form.

You cannot access any of the abilities from the form without using your Breaker form and can choose to change the colors of your breaker form at will. The transformation between forms is instantaneous.

title: (Breaker/Shaker) Hellfire
description_plain:
Flames can only burn so hot. The highest temperature recorded is two trillion kelvins. A supernova can exceed 100 billion degrees, and you're hotter than that.

Your body temperature has a secondary breaker effect that can be manipulated as a sort of field to contain your heat, extending upwards of 100 meters.

Your heat is enough to even start the deconstruction and softening of Endbringer cores, very likely to even turn an Endbringer into nothing more than a gas.

Your range is as your eye can see, and your abilities mean you are completely immune to the very idea of heat. No amount of heat can scar or burn you. Your infernos are all under your control.

You can scale this temperature down.

You have no brute or breaker powers allowing you to survive extremes, but you are immune to any malignant effects heat might cause to your health. This includes smoke from fires.

title: (Brute/Shaker) Seed of Yggdrasil
description_plain:
You are a seed of the tree that holds the worlds together. You have immense control over the entire Kingdom Plantae. All plants of your choice naturally flourish and provide endless bounty within 1000 miles of your location.

Within 100 miles of your location, you can force plants to grow in unnatural locations; blanket an entire city in green algae, grow an oak tree in the middle of an office, etc. The speed you can cause plants to grow in this range is fast enough for entire trees to grow within minutes.

Within 10 miles of your location, you have absolute control over all plant life. You can grow entire redwood trees faster than a blink of an eye. Any plant within this range can be used to express any of your other abilities. You can grow plants within people to gain access to their powers and control their actions. You are no longer limited to terrestrial plants in this region; you have free reign to combine, alter, or create brand-new plants within this area.

You have a Thinker ability that allows you to sense plants within your range relative to your level of control and a level of multitasking to match. You can interdimensionally connect the roots of your plants, allowing you to travel between them at your leisure; the interdimensionality of your roots can be extended to singular plants within your absolute range, allowing you to bypass barriers and other insurmountable defenses.

You can assume the properties of plants in any combination. At a minimum, you have a brute rating that grants you the strength to treat a pair of redwoods as mere chopsticks. Your durability resembles that of the cumulative durability of the plants within your absolute range. By adopting the properties of plants, you can grow your body into various shapes and sizes. So long as there are plants in your absolute range, you can recover from any injury that doesn't destroy your Corona Pollentia.

title: (Trump) Shard Supply Store
description_plain:
You have an endless selection of powers in an archive of sorts. These powers are standardized components instead of finished products and can’t be used by themselves. You have the ability to fuse, modify, and forge these components together, creating greater powers from lesser shards.
You can hold onto and use a limited number of these constructed powers at once or grant them to other people.

In order to swap powers you must either deconstruct a power or grant it to another person.
Your power will in time construct new components to replace any given away.

If you focus on making the strongest power you can it will be equivalent in strength to a tier 3 weaker than Shard Supply Store and completely fill your capacity for powers but if you focus on quantity above all else you will be able to construct around forty powers equivalent to low to mid-level tier 1 powers.

The construction of Trump powers follows different rules as Shard Supply Store does not directly allow the construction of powers that permanently alter its own rules or permanently connect to, copy, steal, or create other powers as a way to sidestep Shard Supply Store's limited capacity for powers, temporary or limited effects are allowed though. Powers are created while under the effect of an alteration to Shard Supply Stores rules and the effects of those powers are eliminated when the effect ends and can’t be given to others.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Be the Butterfly effect!
description_plain:
At any time, you may enter a completely accurate simulation of the past created by your power; however, there is no past version of you in this simulation. Despite this, your presence is remembered, and any effects you had on the world at that point are maintained. You may choose to simulate any time within the last year. The simulation automatically ends if enough time passes in the simulation to reach the time you created that specific simulation. No time passes in the present while you are in the simulation. You enter this simulation in the past of the location you were at in the present if that space is unoccupied; if it is occupied, you appear in the nearest empty space. You are free to move around to any location in the simulation even across the universe or local multiverse, and if you end the simulation, you appear in the nearest empty space to the location you were at in the simulation. Being killed in the simulation automatically ends it returning you to the present unharmed.

You may interact with the simulation with your body and powers, with everything and everyone within reacting just as the original would to anything you do. Changes you make to the simulation ripple out and affect the present within a few city blocks of your exit point, as if what you did in the simulation actually happened in the past.

For example, if you kill or save the life of somebody in the "past", but their body isn’t within a few blocks of your body in the present, then nothing happens to them. This can’t be used to create temporal clones of people, so if you trap someone in a location they would not be at in the present and end the simulation at that location, but the original's body isn’t nearby in the present, then they won’t remember being trapped there or interacting with you at that time, and there won’t be a copy of them at that location.

title: (Breaker/Shaker) Reality Sculptor
description_plain:
You have absolute control over reality within a personal radius of 250 meters. You can manipulate matter and energy at will, essentially creating or transforming anything you can imagine into existence.

You can also create sentient beings, constructs, and even alternate versions of yourself or others. You have inherent knowledge and understanding of all matter, energy, and even conceptual beings and can instantly create or manipulate them as you please.

You can take a form analogous to a visual representation of an infinitely complex Mandelbrot set.

title: (Thinker) Path to Victory
description_plain:
You can see the steps needed to accomplish any goal you wish, provided it’s feasible, and you can execute each step perfectly. You can choose to let your power take over to follow each step in your place.

You can have as many paths as you wish, capable of removing, altering, or adding to them at will. You can view the entirety of the path without actually following it, allowing you to use it as a method of gaining information.

Your power will understand the spirit of your goals instead of merely the letter, accounting for things you may have forgotten to think of.

This power operates by peering into the infinite possible paths through time and finding one where your goal is accomplished, as such it is true precognition.

title: (Tinker) Clarketech
description_plain:
Your Shard held a very important purpose, that being collecting and storing data on technology and tinkertech that has broken previous cycles and could break future cycles. This was obviously never meant to be distributed in a cycle without heavy restrictions. Oops. As a result, you hold a Tinker specialty unlike any other, the incredibly broad and potent specialty of Clarketech, technology so advanced that it is indistinguishable from magic.

Machines hidden away in pocket dimensions creating holographic interfaces in the air serving as the equivalent to smartphones, zero-point energy-powered flying broomsticks, nanotech-based healing potions, and multidimensional structures are just the tip of the iceberg as you begin making technology that blurs the line between the possible and impossible.

Negentropy enables you to make use of negentropy in your own Clarketech.

title: (Shaker/Breaker) Sleeper
description_plain:
"Do not wake the Evil while it is quiet"

You’ve gained the ability to create, manipulate, and turn into an incredibly powerful storm, a cloud that shimmers in rainbow colors and cracks, pops, and boils.

Your storm allows you to subvert everything inside it, gaining the ability to control and manipulate it freely. This allows you to reshape and manipulate anyone and anything inside of your storm, including yourself. This also grants you awareness of everything inside your storm.

From the manipulation of matter and energy to simple master effects on others, all falls under your domain. The effects do not fade when the storm disappears, the effects remaining permanent until undone.

Incredibly powerful All-or-Nothing of absolute attacks and defenses can resist subversion for a while, however if they stay in the storm for too long even they will fail.

The speed at which things are subverted to your own use is instantaneous, barring All-or-Nothing effects, for which they’ll have to spend a few minutes inside before they too fall under your control.

You’re also capable of shifting your body into a breaker state made up of your storm, which will allow you to reform yourself anywhere inside the storm, reshape, harden it, or manipulate its properties as you wish. You can even manifest and reshape your storm as a coat of armor and weapons. When shifted into your breaker form you also become capable of directly manifesting your power’s effects outside the storm itself, such as launching powerful blasts of lightning.

When shifted into your breaker form you also become capable of healing any damage to yourself, capable of reforming near instantly, and while in the breaker form itself any damage to the storm is not reflected to your own body, instead forcing it back into human form no worse for wear if your storm is completely annihilated.

When shifted into your breaker form the speed at which your storm swells also grows, and you become able to move your storm. The storm can remain active constantly even without your direct input, covering the same area forever, even while you sleep if desired.

You can manifest your storm anywhere within a large initial 10km radius around yourself, however it can swell up in size incredibly quickly, capable of growing to envelop multiple settlements or even large portions of a megacity within minutes. The storm’s size will grow at the same rate, capable of growing faster the more it grows.

If you possess an ability that allows you control over the weather, storms, and/or clouds, your range’s initial radius is increased to whatever you the largest range is among those powers. You are able to use the storm’s ability to its fullest potential even without knowing exactly how it works.

title: (Breaker/Changer) Ash Beast
description_plain:
You’ve gained an unexplored yet incredibly potent form of matter-energy/energy-matter conversion, best explained by Einstein’s Theory of Special Relativity, where it is posited energy and mass (matter) are interchangeable, being different forms of the same thing.

As normally uncontrollable as this power would be, both in usage and premise of “the more Shard gives in power, the more it takes in mind” to the point where you experience a case of ego death not unlike Khepri or Night Hag, you miraculously maintain both your sanity and control at the cost of the full capacity of this power being locked behind conscious input.

You have a Breaker form generated and comprised from your constant transmutation of energy and matter, being energetic in nature it gains side benefits such as superhuman conditioning; survival without oxygen, diseases, and contaminants; and flawless and constant regeneration; all of this is possible through your Breaker form constantly replacing and rearranging itself amidst your explosions and replenishing itself from ambient or surrounding energies, absorbing it like fire, to maintain and augment this form.

In your Breaker form, you incessantly produce near-uncontrollable explosions around your surroundings from the constant conversion of matter-energy, with the advantage of changing your shape or form from tearing and putting yourself back together from steady explosions.

Mover powers based on portals and teleportation face difficulties in working their powers on when transformed in your Breaker form, as it chaotically disrupts any grip it has on you.

To reiterate, thanks to being in your control, it has halved its potency, recovering its past benchmark to a sheer outpouring of energy, exhausting your reserves, or simply letting your power loose.

Being a question in regards to the lengths this power is capable of, there are some undiscovered applications that anybody hasn’t thought of or gone unsaid.

title: (Thinker/Master) Burning Bridges
description_plain:
You see glowing strings coming out of everyone, those strings connect to everyone that a being has interacted with. Looking at the strings gives you insight on those connections, like whether the connection is friendly, hostile, or nonexistent, or things like when it started or why it ended.

Through those strings you can doom a connection, you can decide what will be the outcome but not how it will be achieved or you can leave the outcome as random, the outcome could be something like "Being B decides to kill Being A" or "Being A ends their friendship with Being B by destroying their family heirloom", or even "Being B kills Being A fiance and Being A triggers with the power to raise undead". How it happens is by Being A and B and every being that was/is around them in the past and present have their decisions and actions subtly influenced in a way that achieves the desired outcome. You decide to doom Being A and Being B's friendship and sometime later Being B discovers their significant other has had an affair with Being A, resulting in that friendship ending.

Touching someone allows you to see and interact with their strings even when they are on the other side of the world, and gives you access to their connection to those they haven't interacted with. You could make the entire world hate a single person and no one would even know it was you.

title: (Trump/Master) Chrysalis
description_plain:
You gain the capacity to sense sentiments and desires within 100 kilometers of you. By concentrating on the sentiments/desires someone is feeling, you gain knowledge of what caused them and can hear what they are currently thinking.
 
You are able to create white butterflies that you can sense through and command them by giving them orders telepathically, though this telepathic link only works within the range of your emotion sense. Within you, there's a large pool of energy that you can imbue into one of your butterflies through touch. This turns that butterfly into a Kamiko, and their colour becomes black with highlights of a colour of your choice. The pool regenerates slowly, but eating food fills it completely, and with time, it will grow in size. Kamikos are extremely flexible, giving them the capacity to pass through very small gaps and be able to sense emotions in a much smaller range than yours. You can only have one Kamiko at a time; trying to make another one will just result in you wasting the energy from your pool.

Your Kamiko can possess an object that someone has an emotional connection with; the possessed object becomes black, a mental connection with that being is established, and their sentiments/desires are amplified and reinforced. This connection allows you to access their senses and telepathically communicate with them. Every time you do that, a glowing (with the colour of the highlight of your Kamiko) outline of a mask in the shape of a butterfly appears in front of their and your faces. You can offer them a transformation that will change their body, make them have unlimited stamina, and give them powers (being able to amplify and change existing ones), together with a name for this transformation. If they agree to it, their body will be engulfed by a bubbling energy of the colour of your Kamiko, upon which the change is made, and they will become your Champion. If their object breaks, their transformation ends, and all their active power effects will cease to exist. The same applies if you make the Kamiko leave its object. Although you normally can only have one Champion at a time due to your Kamiko limit, if multiple people share the same object and their sentiments and desires align, they will become multiple Champions or fuse into a single one. You can only retrieve a Kamiko and communicate with your Champion within your emotional sense range.

The powers from the transformation are fueled by your pool of energy, and the stronger they are, the more energy they consume, while the maximum strength of the powers you can give is 30 SP total. The transformation must align with your Champions sentiments/desires, the context behind those feelings, and themselves. You can't give someone who refuses to hurt anyone under any circumstances a power that can only be used to hurt, nor can you give someone who is tired of running away from their problems sentient minions that they can command from another city, but you could give the first one a power whose capacity to hurt is secondary or give the second one the capacity to create clones that house his consciousness. If you Champion yourself, you won't be able to change or amplify Chrysalis, and if a Champion has the capacity to amplify or grant powers to others, it must be either temporary, limited to only 1 or both.

If you have Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge, your pool of energy will instead be magic aligned with the concepts of Transmission, Influence, and Change, with each concept giving you an extra ability; with Transmission comes the capacity to temporarily transfer to your Champions any of your powers with the exception of Chrysalis; with Influence comes the capacity to compel someone to accept your offer of Championship and with Change comes the capacity for a transformation to become permanent. If your Champion stays transformed for a long time, the stronger the Champion the more time they need. If a Champion becomes permanent, they no longer need your Magic to use their powers, and you can use your Kamiko on someone else. You are still able to communicate with them as if they had a Kamiko. Besides that, it allows your Champions to actually have esoteric abilities like magic instead of imitations, and with time and effort, you can develop new capabilities based on those concepts or enhance ones that you already have (like making your Kamiko phase through walls). Those capabilities will use your pool of magic to function.

title: (Changer/Striker) Echidna
description_plain:
With some alterations, you gain the horrific ability to clone anything you touch. Clones will typically resemble their source template but will still be distinctly different. You only have to have touched something once to make clones of them.

Things you clone are generally more powerful than their sources, typically healthier, and overall better in almost every way.

In the case of parahumans those you clone will typically possess a greater and/or alternate version of their source's power. You can choose what category they fall in or leave it entirely up to chance.

You can shapeshift into a giant, monstrous new form looking like a gray and red glob. This form is where you generate the clones, creating them directly inside the glob and releasing them. Your changer form can start incorporating the features of those you’ve cloned, becoming more mobile and powerful over time.

Clones will typically possess personalities similar to their sources, but will be innately loyal to you and won’t act against you, your goals, or instructions regardless of other factors. Note that this does not exclude them from being tricked or mastered to do so, only that they won’t do so willingly. If you’re Shardless or possess Esoteric Knowledge you can choose to make any of your clones Shardless as well.

title: (Stranger) Shroud
description_plain:
You can become completely undetectable both from a conventional and parahuman standpoint. This power comes from an endeavor to refine and specialize a Cloak Shard toward survivorship through imperceptibility from other Entities while being a culmination of different Stranger Shards into one. Being selectively customizable to your needs or concerns, the methods can vary according to one’s environment and opposition.

From a standard perspective, anyone is unable to perceive or recognize you in any shape or form, on a physical aspect, your power shrouds you off the electromagnetic spectrum turning translucently invisible, subtly canceling vibrations in your vicinity turning you inaudible, masking your scent to blend with the environment, dispersing your temperature signature, retroactively modifying any existent records or media as if you never appeared, your physical presence is essentially muted to the point of turning you selectively intangible; mental aspects such as using perceptive amnesia, distorting anyone’s memories, awareness and perceptions as to obscure your profile or mislead them to cover-up your intentions or actions; this can be used offensively for surprise and unperceivable attacks in combat situations.
From a parahuman perspective, Thinker powers enhancing and expanding the sensorial and intellectual range find themselves struck out from the power’s concealment, effectively removing you from their sights as if you weren’t there to begin with. Thinker powers based on simulating, data crunching, postcognition, pericognition, and precognition come up blank when assessing you, selectively obscuring aspects of yourself to either be a non-person to their powers or simply unsuspecting, effectively employing antimemetic mechanics.

The parahuman aspect is adaptive, appraising the probable vulnerability in the face of detection and responding accordingly.

This is feasibly regarded as the epitome of Stranger powers, with their mechanics using multiple methods of stealth, from physics to multi-dimensional exploitation to camouflage. Despite all this, the weaknesses you’ll encounter are Endbringers and Entities, which come from circumventing your abilities through the Cycle’s rules.

title: (Trump) Rival
description_plain:
You are the enemy of all, for you become stronger the more opponents you have. This happens with your power adding the capabilities of everything that is opposing you or that is within 10 meters of yourself; if your opponents can do something, so can you. Intellect, bio-tinker augmentations, stamina, powers, visualization, multi-tasking, teleportation through tinkertech, and much more are yours to have.

Mundane Physical capabilities will only come from the one who has them the most while Mental and Abnormal (compared to average humans) capabilities will come from everyone, the same applies to equipment. Strength, Speed, and Stamina are an example of the first while Skills, Knowledge, and Powers are examples of the second. If an opponent’s physical capabilities weaken compared to others, you’ll draw from the next most capable opponent. For example, if you fought a mob of mooks and their leader’s stamina dropped significantly, you’d start absorbing the stamina of the mook who had the most. And if you faced someone with a gun, you’d find yourself able to shoot bullets at the same rate as them—whether from your fingers, palm, or thin air.

However, all these capabilities vanish the moment the opponents stop opposing you and move out of your range.

title: (Trump) Jailbreak
description_plain:
You’ve gained the ability to access and control the abilities of others and yourself in a broad but imprecise manner.

This will allow you to remove restrictions, enhance abilities, alter them in broad strokes, and more. However this comes with inherent risks, one that must be carefully managed lest it kill it their wielder’s, and more importantly you.

The power works through touch and line of sight.

The power works through three major methods. Power Amplification, Aspect Infusion, and Category Expansion.

Power Amplification is the simplest method, through which you simply amplify the powers existing aspects. For example a telekinetic would be able to generate significantly more force and/or possess much more fine control.

Category Expansion allows you to add additional capabilities to the power expression directly, allowing it to manifest new features. For example by adding a Master component to a pyrokinetic power it could allow the user to create sentient fire constructs.

Aspect Infusion adds new aspects to the theme of a power, creating a new dimension to the overall power. For example by adding an aspect of weakening to a Trump focused on amplifying others, it could allow them to instead directly attack others by striping them of strength instead of enhancing them. This can also be used to remove specific limitations such as the Manton limit.

These alterations can only be chosen in a broad manner, how many times it affects someone, how potent the effects are, and what categories and aspects are added, but the specifics on how these amplifications manifest are uncontrollable.

Each modification carries inherent risks that escalate with proximity of each successive alterations. For Power Amplification, a quintupling of the power’s potency can be considered enough to hit the end requirements of the first phase, with the multiplier’s maximum to hit the next phase doubling for each additional phase.

The first phase, the initial alteration, will typically result in no alteration to the mechanics of the powers.

For the second phase, Trigger Happy, the power will start to activate on its own at times.

This can lead to unforeseen and potentially disastrous consequences, there aren’t many things one can say to explain why while in their civilian identity their heat vision activated all of a sudden and eviscerated a swath of innocents.

For the third phase, Instinct Erosion, normally instinctive control over powers is lost.

The user will need conscious effort to preform actions that were once reflexive. Brute powers that enhance your strength may have you accidentally ripping the arm off of someone you tried to shake the hand of, and powers that require a high degree of precision will be a nightmare to deal with.

For the fourth phase, Protection Nullification, inherent safeguards are stripped away,

This greatly increases the risk of self harm or unintended consequences in the environment. This can result in your own powers burning you, cutting you, potentially backfiring in a permanently damaging if not lethal manner.

For the fifth phase, Volatile Surge, results in the powers becoming incredibly volatile, risking catastrophic failure and complete loss of control.

One progresses through each phase for each successive alteration within three months of the previous one, and will drop to the previous phase if one manages to avoid further alterations within three months.

Each phase also doubles the power’s potency without counting towards the phase’s alteration threshold, this increase in power is permanent.

The fifth phase, Volatile Surge, is repeated for each subsequent alteration after the fifth if it falls within the three month period, becoming increasingly unstable and chaotic the more alterations there are.

The effects of each phase, except for Volatile Surge, can be partially mitigated with rigorous and focused training, but only by managing to get to a lower phase or out of the phases can the drawbacks be completely eliminated.

If one manages to drop to a lower phase or out of the phase entirely you can improve upon their power again. In the same manner, allowing you to continuously improve their abilities.

Be warned however that shard powers can be burned out by this, as the shard will need to reveal more and more power to its host, and potentially burn an incredible amount of energy to create new features.

This drawback is removed if you are Negentropic/Shardless, and will allow you to use your own energy source to make their improvements and/or share the secret to Negentropy with their power source if you wish.

These alterations can only be chosen in a broad manner, how many times it affects someone, how potent the effects are, and what categories and aspects are added, but the specifics on how these amplifications manifest are uncontrollable.

Each modification carries inherent risks that escalate with proximity of each successive alterations. For Power Amplification, a quintupling of the power’s potency can be considered enough to hit the end requirements of the first phase, with the multiplier’s maximum to hit the next phase doubling for each additional phase. 

The first phase, the initial alteration, will typically result in no alteration to the mechanics of the powers. 

For the second phase, Trigger Happy, the power will start to activate on its own at times. 

This can lead to unforeseen and potentially disastrous consequences, there aren’t many things one can say to explain why while in their civilian identity their heat vision activated all of a sudden and eviscerated a swath of innocents. 

For the third phase, Instinct Erosion, normally instinctive control over powers is lost. 

The user will need conscious effort to preform actions that were once reflexive. Brute powers that enhance your strength may have you accidentally ripping the arm off of someone you tried to shake the hand of, and powers that require a high degree of precision will be a nightmare to deal with.

For the fourth phase, Protection Nullification, inherent safeguards are stripped away, 

This greatly increases the risk of self harm or unintended consequences in the environment. This can result in your own powers burning you, cutting you, potentially backfiring in a permanently damaging if not lethal manner. 
 
For the fifth phase, Volatile Surge, results in the powers becoming incredibly volatile, risking catastrophic failure and complete loss of control. 

One progresses through each phase for each successive alteration within three months of the previous one, and will drop to the previous phase if one manages to avoid further alterations within three months. 

Each phase also doubles the power’s potency without counting towards the phase’s alteration threshold, this increase in power is permanent. 

The fifth phase, Volatile Surge, is repeated for each subsequent alteration after the fifth if it falls within the three month period, becoming increasingly unstable and chaotic the more alterations there are. 

The effects of each phase, except for Volatile Surge, can be partially mitigated with rigorous and focused training, but only by managing to get to a lower phase or out of the phases can the drawbacks be completely eliminated. 

If one manages to drop to a lower phase or out of the phase entirely you can improve upon their power again. In the same manner, allowing you to continuously improve their abilities. 

Be warned however that shard powers can be burned out by this, as the shard will need to reveal more and more power to its host, and potentially burn an incredible amount of energy to create new features. 

This drawback is removed if you are Negentropic/Shardless, and will allow you to use your own energy source to make their improvements and/or share the secret to Negentropy with their power source if you wish.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Nexus
description_plain:
A core aspect of the Entities' cycle is the distribution of their shards across a vast number of alternate universes. Thanks to shards' inherent multi-dimensional nature, despite being physically spread out on alternate worlds, they're also present and linked within a semi-virtual dimension called the 'Shardspace'. This dimension acts as a network in which shards can directly communicate and interact with the hosts they are connected to along with other shards.

Your shard is vital to the Entities, being solely centred around the construction, maintenance and operation of this Shardspace. From this, you have gained the power to access an alternate version of this Shardspace. Your version of this dimension is completely empty with no shards present and has effectively nigh-infinite size. You possess a full mental awareness of everything that occurs within this dimension.

You can permanently warp space inside the dimension to a certain extent, allowing you to manipulate the distances between objects and locations or adjust gravity in specific areas to walk upside-down, for example. The passage of time within this dimension is also completely separate from that of real space and you can modify it as you wish, either rapidly accelerating time in this dimension or slowing it.

Thanks to its semi-virtual nature, you have full control over the landscape and environment of this dimension although it must possess the same basic conditions needed to support life as that on Earth. You cannot create sentient life. You could potentially construct huge cities, create forests that cover planets and support the existence of entire civilisations within this dimension.

The real strength of this power lies in its ability to act as a connecting dimension across the multiverse; you can use this dimension and open portals from it to access almost any place within your shard's range limit such as alternate universes and other dimensions. You can open portals of any size and shape from real space to this dimension and vice versa as you wish. Due to its semi-virtual nature, transporting large amounts of energy or matter that was created in this dimension into real space will cause your shard to run out of energy as it attempts to substitute for it. Selecting Negentropy or Shardless negates this possibility.

This power even allows you to open portals into typically blocked-off worlds and dimensions from interdimensional travel such as worlds which host a shard's main body as well as the Shardspace dimensions used by Entities and their shards to communicate, including your own Shardspace. This means you could potentially interact with your own Shard directly as well as others. Note that an Entity's home dimension containing its core shards is still inaccessible to you without a direct link to it.

This dimension possesses strong safeguards to block interdimensional intrusions from outsiders, preventing unwanted access. While this is sufficient to block normal shards and Endbringers, Entities can quickly break through its barriers after some effort.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Firmament
description_plain:
Do you know there’s a place where Shards roost and establish themselves the moment they connect with their [Hosts]? You sure do, your Shard spilled the beans the moment it reached out, a peek of the plane where the magic happens.

Your Shard has arranged your connection to the Firmament as part of your power’s parameters: You get mental access to the Firmament every time you consciously request it, appearing almost immediately over your Island to embody your connection between you and your Agent. The Firmament is a semi-virtual space composed of a multiversal lattice, where the sightseeing attractions are your fellow Parahumans and their respective Islands.

At first, you possess no abilities outside of checking your connection with your Passenger and the settings thereof, such as your awareness of personal power parameters and expressions, and your semi-immortality derived from your Shard’s memory banks, being fashioned a “body” from the vitreous substance of your Island the moment you “enter”. A biological respawn, so to speak.

The more you cultivate and attune your bond with your Shard, though, you set a personal foothold for more overt functionalities allowed by your Shard: your access grows to be fully physical, freely managing your Connection without being involved in directly operating the [Data] or [Basis] of your powers, and merge with your Shard-Avatar for more applications.

Merging with your Shard grants a mix between [Query][Response] and Power Sight modulated for your comprehension (your Shard translating for you) while on Shardspace. You’ll perceive any Shard Communication as how we usually communicate, being more natural to your sensibilities, with any [Data] or [Broadcast] being partly decoded for your understanding with sufficient context on where to place a dialogue, such as other Shard’s designations, hosts, and roles in the [Cycle].

(Still, There are limits: you can’t influence or use your Shard’s received or historical [Data] for personal use unless you convince it otherwise).

Shardspace Access and Shard Merging is only merely the tip of the iceberg: for what’s an Island without an Ocean? Once you reach the pinnacle of your connection you come to be a “gateway” for your Shard’s Island, overlapping between Shardspace and Realspace, partially or fully materializing into the untamed sea that is reality.

Partially materializing your Island causes surrounding matter to transmute into raw Shardmatter you can manipulate and make use of as a raw resource for both personal and parahuman use: piggybacking from it to enhance your Shard’s connection for a stronger bandwidth and ending up with a more potent power expression while temporary, or directly manipulate it to ensnare or trap any unlucky cape, easily tuning in their Shard.

(This pairs quite well with Connection, Override, Manager, Gestation or any other Shard power fully utilizing Shard Manipulation.)

Fully materializing your Island brings it forth as it has always been: a full representation of your Shard’s domain of influence, rank, and specialization blending with your mental landscape, representing your connection with your Shard Avatar looming over, ever watchful. Any Parahumans close by will find a light cognitohazardous effect by directly gazing at your Shard Avatar, they aren’t supposed to know or be aware of [Cycle] secrets, after all.

This full manifestation offers Shard Merging applied to Realspace, truly unleashing your Shard’s full expanse from the possible power expressions you could’ve gained from different possibilities, and a freedom of [Data] collection from nearby Parahumans, akin to a temporary Ascension. Retaining your Partial Materialization abilities will always be in store.

Lastly, if you go as far as attacking an Island and succeed in damaging it, it reflects on the Host through glitches in their power, broken power expressions, or even potential fatal brain damage.

title: (Master/Trump) Endbringer Engine
description_plain:
To the inhabitants of Earth Bet, you have been given perhaps the most terrifying power to exist—the power to create Endbringers.

However, while you possess the power to create Endbringers, the power is not quite as potent as its most notable user.

Thus, you have been given the ability to create completely loyal monsters that start weaker than their brothers and sisters. Each Endbringer you create will start with a core and enough spatial and dimensional folding energy to create the standard folding spatial flesh that all Endbringers use to protect their cores.

These weaker Endbringers will start with roughly 30 SP worth of power and can handle a couple of strikes from their fully grown brothers and sisters, but not much more.

They will then improve over time, growing bigger, stronger, and more durable at the rate of roughly 1 SP a month until they are fully grown and can match the strength of Behemoth and Leviathan (roughly 60 SP). You have complete control over the abilities they spawn with and how they will evolve.

A fully grown Endbringer may be given any group of Shard-based powers that total 60 SP and is not a power-granting or power-growing ability. Any power selected can be scaled up or down according to its chosen SP, so long as the total of all powers given to an Endbringer does not exceed 60 SP. Esoteric Knowledge allows an Endbringer to be given non-shard-based powers.

However, the construction of each Endbringer is extremely energy and processing-intensive, meaning that, while you start with an available slot, only 1 additional (or replacement) Endbringer can be made every month (can be reduced to a week with Negentropy) and only 7 can be alive at the same time. Also, if you spawn too many Endbringers in total without Negentropy, you run the risk of completely depleting your Shard.

title: (Changer/Trump) Intra
description_plain:
You have complete and absolute control of yourself. And I do mean complete, down to the molecular level. This grants you a multitude of benefits, one of them being an absolute immunity to outside influences on your body, including master effects, biological manipulation, and even molecular disintegration. This absolute control of your body means that you can fashion yourself into a living weapon; anything is possible, from making your skin as durable as if it were part of an Endbringer to reinforcing your muscle filaments to be so strong that they could easily contend with the strongest Brutes, rewriting the neural pathways of your brain so that they work better than most thinker-based abilities by sheer processing power. All of that and more, from growing wings to transmuting your blood properties to be as or even far more toxic than even the greatest Tinkertech poisons. title: (Breaker/Trump) Miraculous
description_plain:
This is strangely familiar, perhaps you were obsessed with a certain show before you triggered?

You have a breaker state that augments your body and gives you access to a suite of powers tied to concepts. The Breaker State changes your clothing and appearance, though the clothing can only be what can be made in a mundane manner and the appearance change is limited to minor alterations. You can only change the default appearance of your Breaker State when you aren't in it. Living beings can't connect your Breaker State appearance with your normal appearance, even if they were extremely similar or hid nothing.

The body augmentation consists of an increase in strength and durability — enough to carry easily and tank being hit by a car —, greater sight, smell and hearing equal to cats and dogs, and an increase of reflexes, agility and flexibility.

These powers tied to the concepts are the default but you can exchange them for new ones as long they aren't stronger than the default and are still tied to their concept. The switch will take 5 minutes to take effect whether you are changing the powers to another or bringing them back to their default. You can only safely use 6 of those powers at a time, the more you go over 6 the greater the strain upon your body, you could straight up die by using all 20 at the same time, switching takes 10 seconds to take effect.

Destruction: Cataclysm allows you to destroy anything through touch. The destruction starts at the point of contact and spreads up to 1 meter. You can control the spread to a certain extent, like making it slower, stopping it at certain points instead of going the full 1 meter, shaping the spread, selecting what is being destroyed, and even changing how its being destroyed.

Creation: Lucky Charm creates what you need to achieve a desired outcome—being limited to the mundane and non-living—, whatever is made will have a red/black color scheme. You are limited to having one creation at a time, trying to summon a new creation will just change the existing creation into the new one. The creation appears either in your hands or close to you. Power Nullifiers can unmake those creations.

Transmission: Kamiko allows you to create and control butterflies that are able to possess objects. By possessing an object someone is in contact with you can telepathically communicate with them, and if they agree you can alter their clothing in a major way and their appearance in a minor way, and either give them copies of your powers, the strength of your powers or a mix of both. With the exception of the telepathy, you can only do this to a single target at a time.

Emotion: Sentibeing allows you to sense emotions and turn an object someone has an emotional connection with into a projection that embodies whatever emotions and desires they have ever felt. The powers and appearance are based on the desires and emotion used in the making of the projection. The powers can only add up to 15 SP. Only one of those projections can exist at a time. The durability of the projection will be the same as the object used to make it unless it has a power that increases it. You have a telepathic connection with the projection in order to command it.

Submission: Venom allows you to imbue a sharp or pointy object with an effect that paralyzes living beings and halts the motion of non-living objects. Once you paralyze something you need to re-imbue the effect into the pointy/sharp object. The paralysis lasts 5 minutes.

Protection: Shell-ter allows you to create a small green orb from your fingers, the orb follows the area it was created at but you can at will fire it as a projectile. You can choose a shape and then will the orb to change to it, turning it into a green forcefield, once it acquires that shape it cannot be changed. The forcefield is made of hexagonal shapes and you can only have one of them at a time. You can selectively choose what can pass through the forcefield. The forcefield can be bound to something inside it, meaning that if it was for example surrounding someone's head it would follow the head if the person walked.

Illusion: Mirage allows you to create fragile visual illusions that may affect the other senses. Their fragility comes from any physical contact harder than a poke dispelling them. Illusions that are disrupted that way will disappear as orange smoke. Once an illusion is created it cannot be altered. Those illusions can't last more than 5 minutes.

Multiplication: Multitude allows you to create clones of yourself by sacrificing your size, every time you create a clone your size is reduced by 1% non-cumulatively. The created clone will have the same size you will have after your sacrifice to make it. Your clones can also use Multitude, but their size is reduced cumulatively.

Determination: Resistance allows you to cover yourself with a skintight forcefield that makes you completely immune to the powers of others. The forcefield is normally invisible but briefly reveals its blue color when initially activated and whenever a power tries affecting you.

Elation: Clout allows you to gather a massive amount of concussive force on your fists in the form of a swirling purple and yellow energy. You can release this energy by punching, which causes an explosion-like shockwave capable of destroying buildings. You can control and shape the output, allowing you to for example gather only enough energy to heavily damage a car or concentrate the energy into a blast that explodes when it hits something.

Evolution: The Burrow is a spherical pocket dimension the size of a bedroom that you access through a cyan circular portal, you exit it by opening the same portal in the location you were before you entered the Burrow. The walls of the Burrow are full with circular windows that allow you to see across time and space. Each window has an easier time showing certain locations and times while having a harder time showing other locations and times.

Perfection: Elemental Dragon allows you to become Wind, Water and Electricity. You can only be one of those elements at a time. When you are your chosen element you can control more of that element by being in contact with it, the maximum range being 20 meters. When you become your chosen element you can generate more of it.

Intuition: Second Chance allows you to set up a point in time where you can return to every time you use this power again. Returning too many times in a short period will cause injuries from past returns to start bleeding over in your current time.

Migration: Voyage allows you to shoot a blue projectile that becomes a cyan portal to any location you desire, the blast doesn't need to hit something to create the portal. Hitting someone with the projectile will open the portal right on top of them and make the portal move itself to "shallow" them — sending them to the location you had in mind when you made the portal — and then immediately closing. This portal cannot be bigger than 3 meters. You can only have one portal at a time. You can make the portal suck anything close to one side to bring to the other side.

Passion: Genesis allows you to create objects by drawing on air a 3D white outline of them. While the outline itself needs to roughly conform with the object, the size doesn't need to be the same. The object doesn't need to be created right on the exact place you drawed its outline, it just needs to be in the same direction. You can create anything mundane without the necessary knowledge of how they are made, and can create anything beyond the mundane as long as you have the knowledge to do so or you have powers that you could engrave on rhe object at the time of its creation, like arrows that can apply Cataclysm on whatever they hit. Power Nullifiers can unmake those objects.

Derision: Uproar allows you to create a orange orb that causes the power of the target hit to temporarily be disrupted and malfunction, lasting 5 minutes. In order to hit the target with it you need to physically throw it. You can only have two orbs at a time, though once you hit someone with it you can create a new one.

Pretension: Sublimation allows you to have any single power up to 10 SP. Those powers are fragile and may stop working with usage, needing to be summoned again.

Adoration: Fetch allows you to create balls you would typically use to play with dogs, hitting an object with it applies a tag, which you can use to teleport it to you.

Jubilation: Gift can be used in two ways, through eye contact and through touch. Through eye contact you can temporarily substitute someone's senses with something they desire. Through touch you can trap someone on a endless dream where their desires are granted, the only way for them to wake up is through outside interference or by them reality its all a dream. The touch version warps the sense of time of the targeted, a few seconds of real life would be decades of living in the dream.

title: (Stranger/Breaker) Informatio
description_plain:
You are attuned to the essence of information—no, more than that, you are information incarnate. Every byte, every whispered word, every pixel in an image that pertains to you forms a vast network, a web of existence you navigate with ease. You live within these threads, making homes out of the records and memories of your existence. Your awareness extends to the whispers of your name, the trace of your image, and the mere idea of you. The essence of who you are resides in the data scattered throughout the world, and this makes you more than a mere being—you are a living, breathing entity woven into the very fabric of knowledge itself.

Your understanding of the world comes from the information it holds. When it concerns you directly, you possess complete and intimate knowledge—nothing is hidden, nothing is obscure. A mention in a conversation, a line in a database, a photograph on a screen, or a memory in someone’s mind—all these are extensions of yourself. If someone mentions you, you feel it like a vibration in the web that makes up your consciousness. Their words become another anchor point, another node in the expansive network of your existence.

The extent of your awareness is more nuanced than mere omniscience. While you have a complete understanding of information directly tied to you, your sense stretches beyond to include anything tangentially related. If you are blonde, you gain a faint, yet undeniable, awareness of every other blonde individual in the world. Their lives do not unfurl before you as an open book, but their presence is a hum, a flicker in your perception. It’s like standing in a crowded room where only certain voices rise above the din—you hear their whispers, sense their existence, but the details are vague unless you focus your attention. You are bound by threads that extend beyond the self, connecting to the broader world in a web of faintly glowing lines.

This power allows you to move through these connections, appearing anywhere where information about you resides. A rumor passed between lips, a photograph pinned to a wall, a digital footprint in a remote server—each of these points becomes a doorway. You do not travel through space as others do; instead, you fold reality along the lines of information. Where your name is thought of or your likeness is stored, you may manifest, a living ghost moving through the data streams of the world. To those who witness such appearances, it is as though you slip through the cracks of reality, emerging from the shadow of a mention or the reflection of a thought.

Beyond movement, you wield the power to manipulate the very essence of information. Information itself is malleable to you, like a sculptor shaping clay. You can destroy it, leaving a void where it once was. When you choose to destroy information, you can induce a Stranger effect, erasing the traces of that knowledge from reality. People forget details, files become corrupted, and memories fade. The information is removed; however, this doesn’t change what already happened, simply altering known history to make it that whatever information you destroyed never existed. The absence you create is more than a hole in memory; it is a shift to accommodate the new narrative you impose. It’s important to note that you do not warp Information in the sense of altering history itself; rather, you manipulate the knowledge and memories of others, subtly adjusting their perceptions so that they align with the narrative you create.

Your nature as living information means you are not bound by a singular identity. You can graft new information into your very being, shaping yourself according to the knowledge you possess. If you decide to adopt the information that you are a ginger, then you gain the same semi-awareness of all gingers as if this trait had always been yours. Your awareness extends to those who share that characteristic, creating a faint hum in your perception of every ginger person in existence. In the same way, you can graft other aspects—traits, experiences, skills, even entire histories—transforming yourself with each new piece of information you integrate.

However, you are limited by the physical reality you inhabit. You cannot hold contradictory truths within yourself simultaneously; if you are currently a ginger, you cannot also be blonde at the same time. But this limitation doesn’t bind you entirely. Instead of discarding contradictions, you store them within a mental vault, like files archived for later use. You can switch between these traits, activating or deactivating them as needed. If a situation requires you to adopt a different appearance or characteristic, you can draw upon the stored information, effectively rewriting your own existence. To the outside world, this change is seamless—people perceive you as if you had always been this way, with reality subtly adjusting around the new narrative.

This means that while your external appearance or traits may shift, others will not notice any inconsistency. They will remember you as a blonde if that is what you choose to be, even if you had been a ginger the moment before. Photographs, memories, and even written records will warp to align with your current state, ensuring a complete integration into the fabric of reality. You can shift from being a seasoned warrior to a charming socialite, and the world will remember you accordingly. It’s as if the very history around you is rewritten to match your current self, smoothing over any discrepancies.

Your ability to graft information is not limited to physical traits. Skills, experiences, and even personal relationships can be absorbed into your being, becoming a part of your new self. You could integrate the combat techniques of a master martial artist, the scientific knowledge of a renowned researcher, or the memories of a seasoned traveler. These aspects become part of your identity until you choose to store them away, allowing you to seamlessly adapt to different roles and challenges. When you assume the knowledge or skills of another, it feels as though you’ve always possessed them, your body moving with the instinctual ease of long-practiced motions.

You have no fixed form, no unchanging nature. Instead, you are defined by the sum of the information you have chosen to integrate and the echoes of all the selves you have stored. This makes you as fluid and adaptable as the information that defines you, always changing, always evolving, yet anchored in the awareness of every aspect that has ever been part of your existence.

In a sense, you are both a storyteller and the story itself—reshaping the narrative of who you are and what you can be, bending reality to match your chosen role. Those who encounter you might think they know you, but that knowledge is always subject to change, always malleable. You walk through the world as a living enigma, a presence that is both ever-shifting and eternally present, defined by the information you hold and the secrets you choose to become.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Cheat Shard Engine
description_plain:
Your Shard has a specialized role within the network: monitoring every conceivable variable it can detect. This ranges from the distance between two Shards, the number of atoms in a planet, quantum fluctuations over time, and even the exact wavelengths of various effects. Your Shard has complete access to the data observed by all Shards on the network, allowing it to perceive space, time, matter, energy, information, digital space, consciousness, technology, more—and crucially, to alter those variables. This means you can fine-tune, search, amplify, or even freeze specific parameters at will.

Your ability to control these variables manifests in various ways. For example, you could ensure a cup is always half full, regardless of how much liquid is added or removed. You could fix the distance between objects or prevent atoms from moving, freezing their electrons in place despite external forces like electromagnetic fields, gravity, or chemical reactions.

Your Shard's vast observational capability can be overwhelming. Initially designed to function independently, it was not optimized for use by a [HOST]. As a result, your field of vision is sometimes cluttered with overlapping data that may seem nonsensical. However, you can focus this abstracted information by concentrating on specific objects. At low levels of abstraction, you’ll perceive familiar concepts such as vectors, temperature, spatial coordinates, rigidity, and hardness. At higher levels of abstraction, you’ll see more complex information: atomic numbers, relative positions of objects, radiation signatures, and covalent bonds. At the highest abstraction, you’ll access phenomena like the Cosmic Microwave Background, quantum foam, and even inter-universal relations. The downside is that unless you're skilled at multitasking, you can only focus on one variable at a time, and it takes a moment to interpret what you're seeing.

When targeting a Parahuman, your power automatically "zooms in" on their Shard, providing essential data such as Shard-Host distance, power bandwidth, and wormhole metrics on the corona. You can adjust, amplify, or stabilize these variables—or even lock them to specific values. By manipulating the "think and do stuff" variable in their Corona, you can temporarily shut down their powers, holding this effect until you release it.

Additionally, you can locate the Shard's resting Earth, disconnect it from the Network, or reconnect it if desired. Beyond individual powers, you can impact Shards on a broader scale: "fix" Case 53s, reconnect dormant Shards to Zion's network, or supply energy to a Shard by modifying its "Total Energy" variable.

You can also manipulate physical reality—creating a miniature, self-sustaining star, forming a singularity that doesn’t pull matter, or binding atoms to simulate nuclear pasta's unbreakable density. On a smaller scale, you could keep a bank account balance permanently fixed, set surface friction to zero, turn diamond into a truly unbreakable material, make plastic a superconductor, or freeze your phone battery at 1%.

title: (Master/Trump) Drawing Board
description_plain:
You can create and summon life. Your power allows you to create characters and companions with a wide variety of histories and powers. You can summon them through your will and imagination alone, or you may use a medium for a boost.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (15 if you’re Shardless/Negentropic). You can use a single charge to create a character(s)/creature(s) that’s roughly on par with a normal human.

This can be a single creature or a group of creatures, although their combined power/danger level will be roughly the same as a single creation.

By spending more charges, whether during its creation or after, you can enhance its abilities and powers, widening its repertoire of abilities and enhancing its existing capabilities.

A single charge will allow you to grant them an ability that’s roughly a 3 on the PRT scale, with 2 charges needed to increase its rating by 1, to a maximum rating of 10 on the PRT scale for a single ability. They can hold up to 6 powers at the start and will be able to hold one additional ability with every month that passes after their initial creation. There is no limit to what kind of ability you can give them.

You can also spend a charge to grant them near superhuman skill in a specific skill; there is no limit to how many skills you can do for a single creation.

Their abilities can synergize and benefit from other factors, such as other trump abilities you possess, without it counting towards their limit on the charge improvements.

You can create and summon characters/creatures using nothing more than your will, but by utilizing mediums, the cost of producing them is significantly lessened, depending on their quality and type used. The medium is not destroyed or altered if used; it simply exists as a reference point for your power.

You may also spend a charge to rework them, altering/reshaping them into something else, although it will not increase their power by doing so, serving more as a rewrite of them than an improvement.

Poorly drawn images in crayon may yield almost no benefit, but a realistic 2D drawing could let you summon a version that’s already mildly superhuman and with one or two low-level powers with a single charge. A 3D sculpture could yield a much more powerful creation, even potentially granting it extra space for abilities or increasing the limit on how many charges you can use on them.

You do not need to create the media/medium; you may use existing ones to summon them, including the use of the creations of others for this. When using existing media as a reference, you can choose to alter it as you wish, so it’s not a 1:1 copy, if at all, using it simply as a reference for appearance, personality, and/or powers.

Regardless of what personality you give them, they’ll be intrinsically loyal to you, although you may find some interesting interpretations of commands depending on personality.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Displacement
description_plain:
You have become the quintessential example of what is often called a ‘Blink’ Mover, a sub-classification centred solely around teleportation, thanks to your shard’s focus on the shifting and transportation of space.

You can employ two distinct types of spatial teleportation. The first is a two-way ‘swapping’ teleportation in which two areas, along with any matter and energy within, are switched in location. The second is one-way teleportation; this effectively erases any matter and energy in the receiving area, replacing it with the incoming space, while creating a vacuum in the original location. For example, you could teleport away a section of air, leaving a vacuum, with that section of air then erasing and overlaying anything at the destination.

This power has no specific range limitations, aside from standard shard constraints, allowing you to remotely teleport space around the world and even across dimensions. You do, however, have a limited total spatial volume of what you can teleport at once, equivalent to that of a sphere 1 km in radius. Within this limit, you can freely decide the dimensions of the space you wish to teleport and can teleport numerous separate areas simultaneously, though you are limited by your multitasking and overall maximum volume.

This power is not Manton Limited and acts as an All-or-Nothing effect, capable of spatially cutting matter on an atomic level. While it can affect Endbringer flesh, Endbringer cores remain immune due to their safeguards and spatial warping properties. This power automatically accounts for and compensates for factors like momentum, planetary rotational velocity, energy transfer, etc.

To aid in its use, you possess a secondary thinker ability that grants you conscious spatial awareness of everything in the area that you want to teleport from as well as the area that you wish to teleport to, though you need a clear mental image of both locations involved. This clairvoyant sense can even remotely scout out areas you have a clear awareness of. Finally, this ability also provides excellent innate finesse, fine enough that you can teleport complex 3-dimensional shapes, like cutting out a keyhole from a wall.

title: (Trump) Another
description_plain:
You can one time per week create a white pocket watch-like object called Record. A Record can engrave in itself the story of a Parahuman, their past, present, and future. By pressing its button you can insert the Record on someone, allowing them to become an Another—a distorted version of the recorded Parahuman. A Record is nigh-indestructible, the only way to destroy it is through the Parahuman they recorded, either through their powers or identity.

The engraving can be done in three ways. The first method is by being in the presence of the Parahuman. The second method is by being in the presence of something affected/made by their power. Finally, the final method is being present in a location significant to their story.

Whenever the power of the recorded Parahuman is used it will be weakened, if the power is completely gone then history alters itself so that their cape identity is erased from existence and only their civilian identity remains, with anything they did as a cape being attributed to others. But this alteration isn't 100% reliable, echoes of their existence remain, and some people might have vague memories while others remember them outright.

An Another is separated into two Transformations. The first is based on the civilian identity of the Parahuman, while the second is based on their cape identity, meanwhile, the Another can only be one at a time they can easily transition from one to the other. Those transformations are distorted, having physical mutations reminiscent of Case-53s and often incorporating elements from significant parts of the story of the Parahuman, like their allies and enemies, the way they died, etc. The cape transformation is much more monstrous than the civilian one. The civilian transformation has the name of Parahuman and the year of their trigger engraved in it, while the cape transformation has their cape name and the year of its creation engraved in it.

The transformations are accompanied by transitions based on their powers, like bursting into flames and dissipating to reveal the transformation. Transforming into the cape identity causes those nearby to hear the name of the Parahuman that originated that Another.

If an Another uses their transformations too frequently or for too long—with both at the same time accelerating the consequences—, they will start to have their mind slowly merged with a distorted mirror of the mind of Parahuman, with that mind eventually having a greater focus. While normally the merging could be undone by not transforming for a time, once the distorted mind becomes the focus the only way to undo the merge is by the record being destroyed. What is meant by "distorted mirror" is that mirrors appear to invert something yet do not quite do so, that's what happens with the mind of an Another, for example, a kind Parahuman results in an Another that is cruel by being kind.

Anothers have a slightly stronger manifestation of the power of the original. These variations will often incorporate elements from the significant parts of the recorded story. With time new powers based on the story are acquired and the existing powers gradually increase in strength through effort and use.

The civilian transformation has everything enhanced to the human limit, while the cape transformation is 3x that. Anothers can only be killed using the powers or identity of the recorded Parahuman—they aren't just revived though, they are reset back to peak condition, meaning that any fatigue acquired in battle (or possible damage to their powers) is removed—, thought when that happens the record will be broken instead of the Ex-Another dying.
